text: You will see a lot of **cylinder-shaped water tanks** on the roofs of buildings.
NOTE: This is less common in Montenegro.
Some parts of Turkey also have a lot of similar-looking water tanks.
text_zh: 你會看到許多 **圓柱形水塔** 在建築物的屋頂上。
注意：這在蒙特內哥羅較不常見。
土耳其部分地區也有許多類似的水塔。

text: Albania has a lot of **Italian-style buildings**: pastel colours, orange tiled roofs, and blocky shapes with lots of balconies.
text_zh: 阿爾巴尼亞有許多 **義大利風格的建築**：顏色柔和、橘色瓦片屋頂，以及帶有許多陽台的塊狀結構。

text: Alpine architecture is common in Austria and other countries in the Alps. Houses commonly have distinct **light **coloured walls, with **wooden **elements such as balconies or panelling around the top floor, with dark-coloured wooden roofs that extend outward. The roofs can sometimes be angled downward at the front and back. In addition, houses are also often multi-storeyed.
NOTE: Germany uses similar architecture in its southern states.
text_zh: 阿爾卑斯山建築風格在奧地利和其他阿爾卑斯山區國家很常見。房屋通常具有獨特的**淺 **色牆面，頂層帶有陽台或牆板等**木製 **元素，並配有向外延伸的深色木製屋頂。屋頂有時前後向下傾斜。此外，房屋通常為多層建築。
註：德國在其南部各州也使用類似的建築風格。

text: Many houses throughout Brazil have **orange tiled roofs**.
text_zh: 巴西各地的許多房屋都有**橘色瓦片屋頂**。

text: Brazil often uses metal trash baskets outside houses. In Acre and Rondônia, however, it is much more common to see them made of **concrete**.
text_zh: 巴西人經常在房屋外設置金屬垃圾籃。然而在阿克里州和朗多尼亞州，更常見的是用**混凝土**製作的垃圾籃。

text: Lamps in Ceará often have a **fancy and colourful arm**, whether as lampposts or attached to utility poles. It sometimes says the town on the arm.
text_zh: 塞阿拉州的路燈無論是獨立路燈桿還是附掛在電線桿上，通常都帶有**華麗且色彩鮮豔的燈臂**。燈臂上有時會印有城鎮名稱。

text: Buildings in the southern states, mainly Santa Catarina, can be of **European influence** (typically vaguely German) in design and style.
text_zh: 南部各州（主要是聖卡塔琳娜州）的建築在設計與風格上可能受到**歐洲風格影響**（通常隱約帶有德國風格）。

text: Wooden houses on stilts are very common in the state of Acre.
NOTE: They are also seen more rarely in low-lying Amazonas and Pará, as well as various other countries.
text_zh: 高腳木屋在阿克里州非常常見。
註：在地勢低窪的亞馬遜州和帕拉州，以及其他一些國家，這種建築也較為少見地出現。

text: **Water towers** in towns across the United States and Canada are typically very tall, and sometimes have the name of the town on them.
text_zh: 美國和加拿大城鎮中的**水塔**通常非常高大，有時上面會寫有城鎮的名稱。

text: Houses with thick, dark **wooden poles** supporting the upper floors are common in the northernmost parts of the country.
text_zh: 用粗而黑暗的**木柱**支撐上層樓的房屋在該國最北部地區很常見。

text: French architecture largely consists of stone houses, which will normally be either unpainted or painted in greyish or yellow pastel colours. The roofs will typically have a simple [gable](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gable_roof) design, with orange tiles or less commonly black slates. Townhouses will often lay wall to wall along the road.

Do note that France has some of the most diverse regional architecture of any European country, so don’t be surprised to see towns that look significantly different from the previously described architecture.
text_zh: 法國建築主要由石造房屋組成，通常未漆漆面，或是漆成灰色或黃色的粉彩色調。屋頂通常採用簡單的[山形牆](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gable_roof)設計，搭配橘色瓦片，或者較少見的黑色石板。連棟房屋通常沿著道路緊密相連。
請注意，法國擁有歐洲各國中最多樣化的區域建築風格，因此看到與前面描述的建築風格有顯著差異的城鎮時，請不要感到驚訝。

text: House numbers in France are most commonly blue, typically written in a serif font with slightly exaggerated shapes. This is most useful when differentiating from Italy, which almost never uses blue house number signs.
NOTE: Similar designs can be found in all other neighbouring, as well as many other, countries.
text_zh: 法國的門牌號碼最常見的是藍色，通常以帶有稍微誇張造型的襯線字體書寫。這在區分義大利時非常有用，因為義大利幾乎從不使用藍色門牌號碼標誌。
注意：類似的設計也可以在所有其他鄰國以及許多其他國家找到。

text: Cuboid barriers made of** stones** and mortar are commonly found on Corsica. While by no means unique to Corsica, it is good to consider the island when you see them in rounds with a plausible Mediterranean landscape.
NOTE: Stone barriers with a [rounded top](https://maps.app.goo.gl/VJ9vC1KXSVHkmqHbA) are not found on Corsica.
text_zh: 由**石頭**和水泥砂漿製成的長方體路障常見於科西嘉島。雖然這絕非科西嘉島獨有，但當你在看起來像地中海景觀的回合中看到它們時，考慮這個島嶼準沒錯。
注意：帶有[圓頂](https://maps.app.goo.gl/VJ9vC1KXSVHkmqHbA)的石造路障在科西嘉島上是找不到的。

text: **Black shingle roofs** are primarily found in the northwest, the rough cutoff being the Loire river. Other areas include near the Belgian border, the south-centre, and the Pyrenees, making black roofs a good clue for Alps-Pyrenees toss-ups.
text_zh: **黑色石板屋頂**主要分佈在西北部，粗略的分界線是羅亞爾河。其他地區包括比利時邊境附近、中南部和庇里尼亞斯山脈，這使得黑色屋頂成為在阿爾卑斯山與庇里尼亞斯山脈之間難以抉擇時的一個好線索。

text: **Brittany** has one of the most recognizable and consistent architectures in the country. Common elements include, in addition to black roofs, [edge chimneys](https://maps.app.goo.gl/aAhwWVjHEPsQPH9T6), [black slate walls](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HepcAWsvqucqhSpb6) and [stones surrounding doors and windows](https://maps.app.goo.gl/aMX5LbsbQsab7LmT9). The walls will be either very light coloured or made of stone.
text_zh: **布列塔尼**擁有該國最容易辨認且一致的建築風格之一。常見元素除了黑色屋頂外，還包括[邊緣煙囪](https://maps.app.goo.gl/aAhwWVjHEPsQPH9T6)、[黑石板牆](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HepcAWsvqucqhSpb6)以及[環繞門窗的石頭](https://maps.app.goo.gl/aMX5LbsbQsab7LmT9)。牆壁顏色非常淺，或是由石頭砌成。

text: Roofs in the south of the country will often be made up of rounded tiles overlapping one another, often varying in colour.
text_zh: 該國南部的屋頂通常由相互重疊的圓形瓦片組成，顏色往往有所不同。

text: Rows of dark red brick houses, most similar to Flemish architecture in Belgium, are unsurprisingly found near the Belgian border. The individual bricks may be outlined by white mortar.
text_zh: 成排的深紅色磚造房屋與比利時的法蘭德斯建築最為相似，毫不意外地出現在比利時邊境附近。個別磚塊的邊緣可能會用白色的水泥砂漿勾縫。

text: In and around Toulouse, mainly in old towns, you will commonly find **bright orange brick buildings**. They differ from brick houses near Belgium by the bricks being brighter, as well as somewhat Mediterranean looking architectural features, such as [wooden shutters](https://maps.app.goo.gl/1Bp6ctTT9uJVuXX67), being common.
text_zh: 在土魯斯（Toulouse）市區及周邊，特別是在老城區，你會常看到**亮橘色的磚造建築**。它們跟比利時附近的磚造房屋不同之處在於磚塊顏色更亮，並且常見一些帶有地中海風格的建築特徵，例如[木製百葉窗](https://maps.app.goo.gl/1Bp6ctTT9uJVuXX67)。

text: Walls made of uneven **cream coloured **to **orange stones**, glued with mortar and often incorporating **red brick details** can be found in the towns surrounding Paris. Note that the city of Paris itself generally does not have this architecture.
text_zh: 在巴黎周邊城鎮可以找到由不規則**乳白色**至**橘色石頭**建成、以水泥黏合且常帶有**紅磚細節**的牆壁。注意，巴黎市區本身通常沒有這種建築風格。

text: The [French Riviera](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/French_Riviera) will mirror many characteristics of Monaco. Rich areas with planted **palms** and light coloured multi story buildings with **wide balconies** are good indications you’re in this area, with the rest of the southern coast and Corsican Bastia sharing similar vibes.
NOTE: Just like Monaco, several cities host [boat trekkers](https://maps.app.goo.gl/KMhr7HRhd1ch44jR6) in their harbour.
text_zh: [法國蔚藍海岸](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/French_Riviera)（French Riviera）會反映出許多摩納哥的特徵。種植了**棕櫚樹**的富裕地區，以及帶有**寬敞陽台**的淺色多層樓建築，都是你身處此區域的好線索，南部海岸的其餘部分以及科西嘉島的巴斯蒂亞（Bastia）也有相似的氛圍。
注意：就像摩納哥一樣，有幾個城市在他們的港口有[船隻trekker](https://maps.app.goo.gl/KMhr7HRhd1ch44jR6)。

text: White houses with, often colourful, timber framing are a staple of Basque architecture that extends beyond the Basque speaking area. The timber frame colour (in this case red) will be consistent with other wooden elements, like window shutters and gates.
NOTE: They’re also common in parts of Northern Spain, where the timber frames are usually unpainted.
text_zh: 帶有通常色彩繽紛之木造構架的白色房屋是巴斯克建築的主體，這種風格延伸到了巴斯克語區以外的地方。木造構架的顏色（在此例中為紅色）會與其他木製元素（如窗戶百葉窗和大門）保持一致。
注意：它們在西班牙北部部分地區也很常見，那裡的木造構架通常沒有漆上顏色。

text: Alpine architecture, unmistakable for its light coloured base and extensive **wooden** elements, is unsurprisingly found in the Alps.
NOTE: Similar houses can be found in the [touristic parts of Pyrenees](https://maps.app.goo.gl/gBufc9meA3Qc2Z7eA).
text_zh: 阿爾卑斯山建築以其淺色基底和大量的**木製**元素而辨識度極高，毫不意外地可以在阿爾卑斯山區找到。
注意：類似的房屋可以在[庇里牛斯的旅遊景點](https://maps.app.goo.gl/gBufc9meA3Qc2Z7eA)找到。

text: Many elements of** Germanic architecture** are concentrated in Alsace, such as **timber framing** and [half-hip roof](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hip_roof#Half-hip_roof). Furthermore, roofs with [fish scale tiles](https://maps.app.goo.gl/awYyavUYj1kHHdVX7) are more common in this region.
Beware that these elements are sometimes incorporated into [architecture](https://maps.app.goo.gl/c72CRemeuSDxuZfE8) in other parts of France, and are most reliable in conjunction with one another.
text_zh: **日耳曼建築**的許多元素都集中在亞爾薩斯（Alsace），例如**木造構架**和[半歇山頂](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hip_roof#Half-hip_roof)。此外，帶有[魚鱗瓦](https://maps.app.goo.gl/awYyavUYj1kHHdVX7)的屋頂在該地區更為常見。
請注意，這些元素有時也會被納入法國其他地區的[建築](https://maps.app.goo.gl/c72CRemeuSDxuZfE8)中，當它們互相搭配出現時才是最可靠的線索。

text: [Mansard roofs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mansard_roof), also known as French windows, are a very common feature of Parisian architecture. They’re made up of steep black shingle roofs with inserted dormer windows. While not unique to Paris, it is a good clue in abundance and on wide boulevards.
text_zh: [孟莎閣樓](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mansard_roof)（Mansard roofs）又稱為法國窗，是巴黎建築非常常見的特色。它們由陡峭的黑色瀝青瓦屋頂組成，並嵌有老虎窗。雖然這並非巴黎獨有，但由於數量繁多且常見於寬闊的大道上，是一個很好的線索。

text: On the Breton island** Belle-Île-en-Mer** you can find houses typical for Brittany combined with colourful façades and outlines, superficially similar to houses in Portugal.
NOTE: The entire island was only covered with an often oversaturated Generation 2 camera.
text_zh: 在布列塔尼的**貝爾島**上，你可以看到布列塔尼典型的房屋，並結合了色彩繽紛的立面與輪廓，表面上看起來與葡萄牙的房屋相似。
注意：整個島嶼的街景僅有通常色彩過飽和的相機世代 2（Generation 2）覆蓋。

text: These painted fences are typically found on Sulawesi. They will be mostly painted white with blue or red.
text_zh: 這些漆過的柵欄通常出現在蘇拉威西。它們大多漆成白色，配上藍色或紅色。

text: **Green** paint can often be seen on the side of bridges in South and Central Kalimantan.
text_zh: 南加里曼丹與中加里曼丹的橋樑側邊經常可以看到**綠色**漆。

text: Tiled roofs are most commonly found on the island of **Java**, and sometimes nearby regions such as southern Sumatra, the Lesser Sunda Islands, and South Kalimantan.
NOTE: The tiles on roofs in South Kalimantan and Jambi look [slightly different](https://goo.gl/maps/BpZ43LPt2nDBJrHD9). The tiles are usually less rounded but flatter.
text_zh: 瓦片屋頂最常出現在**爪哇**島，有時也會出現在鄰近地區，例如南蘇門答臘、小巽他群島以及南加里曼丹。
注意：南加里曼丹和占碑的屋頂瓦片看起來[略有不同](https://goo.gl/maps/BpZ43LPt2nDBJrHD9)。瓦片通常較不圓潤而更為平坦。

text: Plain sheet metal roofs are more commonly found toward the north, where tiled roofs are **not **found. They are most commonly found on Kalimantan, Sulawesi and Sumatra.
text_zh: 平金屬板屋頂較常在找不到瓦片的北方地區被發現。它們最常出現在加里曼丹、蘇拉威西和蘇門答臘。

text: **Sheet metal roofs** with this shape, a **symmetrical** triangular shape with **two levels of sloping**, can be found mainly in Sulawesi, but can be found elsewhere in Indonesia.
text_zh: 具有這種形狀的**鐵皮屋頂**，也就是呈現**兩層坡度**的**對稱**三角形，主要可以在蘇拉威西找到，但在印尼其他地方也能找到。

text: These** horizontal slots** inside the **triangles **of the roofs are almost unique to Southern Sulawesi.
NOTE: They can rarely be found in East Kalimantan and West Nusa.
text_zh: 屋頂**三角形**內部的這些**水平開口**幾乎是南蘇拉威西特有的。
注意：它們在東加里曼丹和西努沙非常少見。

text: You can find these distinct roofs with uniquely **high-pitched peaks** on Sumba.
text_zh: 你可以在松巴島上找到這些屋頂頂端有著獨特**高聳尖頂**的特色建築。

text: **Architecture in Bali** is unique because it was influenced by old Balinese culture and Hinduism. The most important thing to look for are these [crown-like roof pinnacles](https://goo.gl/maps/9v5HBGbiGDczWKYn7), found everywhere in Bali. [Guardian statues](https://goo.gl/maps/CB1pcgrABdjsc3Y88) and [slit-drum towers](https://goo.gl/maps/xPNMsB3rqDjjWZi39) are common too. Andesite, a dark, volcanic rock, is a common building material in Bali. You can often see [gates](https://goo.gl/maps/StCdo1UxpSMXfA388), [walls](https://goo.gl/maps/KF7GweCfsicZyQpN7), and other [intricately carved ornaments](https://goo.gl/maps/9DHCZvKStsqSXG8RA) built from this material.
text_zh: **峇里島的建築**非常獨特，因為它受到古代峇里島文化和印度教的影響。需要尋找的最重要的事情是這些在峇里島隨處可見的[皇冠狀屋頂尖頂](https://goo.gl/maps/9v5HBGbiGDczWKYn7)。[守護神雕像](https://goo.gl/maps/CB1pcgrABdjsc3Y88)和[獨木鼓樓](https://goo.gl/maps/xPNMsB3rqDjjWZi39)也很常見。安山岩是一種深色的火山岩，是峇里島常見的建築材料。你經常可以看到用這種材料建造的[大門](https://goo.gl/maps/StCdo1UxpSMXfA388)、[牆壁](https://goo.gl/maps/KF7GweCfsicZyQpN7)和其他[雕刻精細的裝飾品](https://goo.gl/maps/9DHCZvKStsqSXG8RA)。

text: West Sumatra features these distinct **boat-shaped** roofs.
text_zh: 西蘇門答臘具有這些特色的**船形**屋頂。

text: North Sumatra features similarly distinct **boat-shaped** roofs, however the roofs are **less angled** upward and they do not feature spires.
NOTE: These roofs are most commonly found near Lake Toba, due to its sacred history.
text_zh: 北蘇門答臘也有類似的特色**船形**屋頂，不過這些屋頂向上**傾斜的角度較小**，且沒有尖塔。
注意：由於其神聖的歷史，這些屋頂最常在多巴湖附近找到。

text: On Kalimantan, you can find these unique roofs made out of **wooden **chips.
text_zh: 在加里曼丹，你可以找到這些用**木**片製成的獨特屋頂。

text: Roofs with **gable horns** can be found most commonly in [South Sulawesi](https://maps.app.goo.gl/THNEUGSHTyvnPqjn8), [Riau](https://maps.app.goo.gl/5JbZ5ryhrAygBQDB9) and [Central and South](https://goo.gl/maps/6JtUHKh3dccA8cvw6) Kalimantan.
NOTE: Horned roofs are often found with Bugis roofs in South Sulawesi. Use this tip along with other clues to determine which region you are in.
text_zh: 帶有**山形角**的屋頂最常出現在[南蘇拉威西](https://maps.app.goo.gl/THNEUGSHTyvnPqjn8)、[廖內](https://maps.app.goo.gl/5JbZ5ryhrAygBQDB9)以及[中加里曼丹與南加里曼丹](https://goo.gl/maps/6JtUHKh3dccA8cvw6)。
注意：有角的屋頂經常與南蘇拉威西的布吉人屋頂一同出現。請結合此提示和其他線索來判斷你所在的地區。

text: A small region of South Sulawesi, around the city of Rante Pao, features these very unique houses, called [Tongkonan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tongkonan), that have **saddle-shaped roofs**. The houses themselves are also **elevated from the ground**.
text_zh: 南蘇拉威西的一小片區域，即蘭特包（Rante Pao）城市周邊，有著這種非常獨特的房屋，稱為[東庫納](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tongkonan)，具有**馬鞍形的屋頂**。房屋本身也**挑高於地面**。

text: Indonesia is religiously a **Muslim **majority country, so seeing churches, and other Christian signs, is a good clue for these regions.
text_zh: 印尼在宗教上是**穆斯林**占多數的國家，因此看到教堂和其他基督教標誌，是辨識這些地區的好線索。

text: **Steeply** **pitched** roofs made of palm tree leaves can sometimes be seen on Nias Island, south west of North Sumatra.
text_zh: 印尼北蘇門答臘西南方的尼亞斯島（Nias Island）上，有時可以看到用棕櫚樹葉建造的**陡峭**斜屋頂。

text: A **white **SUV with black bars and a wooden plank on the roof can rarely be seen in eastern Bali.
text_zh: 在峇里島東部，很少見到一台帶有黑色橫桿且車頂放有木板的**白色**休旅車（SUV）。

text: Italian architecture mainly consists of pastel coloured stone houses, generally with terracotta roofs. Houses will very commonly have wooden shutters, which will typically be divided in two and open sideways.
text_zh: 義大利建築主要由粉彩顏色的石屋組成，通常配有紅土屋頂。房屋非常普遍有木製百葉窗，通常會分成兩半並向側邊打開。

text: A lot of buildings in and around Tuscany are made of irregular **unpainted brown-grey bricks**.

NOTE: A similar style of architecture can be found in northeastern [Spain](https://www.google.se/maps/@42.1527702,0.814623,3a,75y,79.59h,97.61t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sBIg-H1KNLM2FxWRl-hDEVQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656).
text_zh: 托斯卡納（Tuscany）內外有許多建築是由不規則的**未漆棕灰色磚塊**製成的。
注意：在東北部的[西班牙](https://www.google.se/maps/@42.1527702,0.814623,3a,75y,79.59h,97.61t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sBIg-H1KNLM2FxWRl-hDEVQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656)可以找到類似的建築風格。

text: **Alpine architecture**, which typically features large buildings with white stone walls and wooden details, are found in the Alpine region.
text_zh: **阿爾卑斯建築**通常具有帶有白石牆和木製細節的大型建築，可在阿爾卑斯地區找到。

text: Buildings in Aosta Valley are often built with **grey uneven bricks**, with an Alpine look.
NOTE: This can look superficially similar to Andorran architecture.
text_zh: 瓦萊達奧斯塔的建築通常是用**灰色不平整的磚塊**建造的，具有阿爾卑斯風貌。
注意：這在表面上看起來可能類似安道爾建築。

text: **Solid wooden shutters** with black metal hinges is a common feature in the northeast of Italy, particularly in Veneto.
text_zh: 帶有黑色金屬鉸鏈的**實木百葉窗**是義大利東北部（特別是威尼托〔Veneto〕）常見的特徵。

text: Houses in the Apulian region are generally very light coloured, and have **flat roofs**, typically with two to three floors. The architecture is sometimes reminiscent of the Middle East.
text_zh: 普利亞地區的房屋通常顏色非常淺，並且有**平屋頂**，通常有兩到三層樓。這種建築風格有時讓人想起中東。

text: This particular style of roof, called a **trullo**, is unique to the Itria valley in southeastern Italy. It is particularly common in and around the town of [Alberobello](https://goo.gl/maps/DwAPahJnQNW1BMY2A).
text_zh: 這種稱為**特魯洛**（trullo）的特殊屋頂風格是義大利東南部伊特ria谷地（Itria valley）所特有的。它在[阿爾貝羅貝洛](https://goo.gl/maps/DwAPahJnQNW1BMY2A)城鎮內外特別常見。

text: Venice can typically be recognized by its many **canals** running through most of the city.
text_zh: 威尼斯通常可以藉由貫穿城市大部份地區的許多**運河**來識別。

text: The island of Pantelleria is a volcanic island southwest of Sicily. Dark volcanic rocks can be seen in the many rock walls of the island, as well as on some houses. It is fairly common to see **yellow lichen** covering the rocks. The island also has a very large amount of cacti.
text_zh: 潘泰萊里亞島（Pantelleria）是西西里島西南部的火山島。島上許多石牆以及一些房屋上都可以看到深色的火山岩。看到覆蓋岩石的**黃色地衣**相當常見。該島也有大量的仙人掌。

text: A lot of Kazakh infrastructure, from pedestrian signs, poles, houses, to bollards, is very similar to what you see in Russia.
text_zh: 哈薩克的許多基礎設施，從行人標誌、電線桿、房屋到路樁，都與你在俄羅斯看到的非常相似。

text: Generation 3 coverage in Kenya often features a **visible roof rack ** and a **snorkel**. Some Generation 3 coverage has [no visible car](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UGBAo7hH2mhLsUv46).
text_zh: 肯亞的 Generation 3 街景通常帶有**明顯的車頂架**和**進氣 snorkel**。部分 Generation 3 街景則[看不到車子](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UGBAo7hH2mhLsUv46)。

text: **Red brick architecture** is common in the western part of the country and a large area east of Nairobi.
text_zh: **紅磚建築**在該國西部和奈洛比以東的大片區域很常見。

text: Houses that are made of **mud and sticks** are commonly seen around the western part of the country and the coast.
text_zh: 由**泥土和木條**製成的房屋常見於該國西部和沿海地區。

text: These **light color bricks** with **excessive amounts of mortar** are found along the coast. [Walls](https://maps.app.goo.gl/k9LPg72T65jHNfLi8) made of these bricks are commonly seen in this area.
text_zh: 這些帶有**大量水泥砂漿**的**淺色磚塊**常見於沿海地區。此區域普遍可見由這些磚塊建造的[牆壁](https://maps.app.goo.gl/k9LPg72T65jHNfLi8)。

text: Durmitor National Park can be recognized by a distinct landscape consisting of **grassy, treeless mountains** with a high-altitude feel.

The town of [Žabljak](https://goo.gl/maps/ityFp93bD3WQweCq5) is situated in this national park, and can be recognized by the landscape but also by the [unique](https://goo.gl/maps/1dyUEW1YaCgDS1SU9) [architecture](https://goo.gl/maps/wQFbfwF88LLTbie77).
text_zh: 杜米托爾國家公園的辨識特徵是具有高山風情、由 **長滿草且無樹木的山脈** 組成的獨特地景。
[扎布利亞克](https://goo.gl/maps/ityFp93bD3WQweCq5)鎮就位於這個國家公園內，可以透過地景以及 [獨特](https://goo.gl/maps/1dyUEW1YaCgDS1SU9)的 [建築風格](https://goo.gl/maps/wQFbfwF88LLTbie77)來辨識。

text: Podgorica is the capital and **largest city** in Montenegro, and can be recognized by the modern buildings, wide roads and modern infrastructure.
text_zh: 波德里查是蒙特內哥羅的首都與 **最大城市**，其特徵是現代化建築、寬敞的道路和現代化基礎設施。

text: Skopje is the capital and by far the largest city. If you see any **large apartments **or **buildings**, you are almost guaranteed to be in Skopje.
text_zh: 斯科普里是首都，也是遠為最大的城市。如果你看到任何**大型公寓**或**建築物**，你幾乎可以保證自己身在斯科普里。

text: Panamanian architecture often reflects **Spanish colonial influences**, featuring vibrant colours, and some ornate detailing. The most common type of building has **painted concrete** or sometimes brick** **walls with red metal sheets or tiles for a roof. Many** **windows have bars on them for security.
text_zh: 巴拿馬的建築通常反映了**西班牙殖民影響**，特色是鮮豔的色彩和一些華麗的細節。最常見的建築類型擁有**漆成混凝土**或有時是磚製的**牆壁，配有紅色金屬板或瓦片屋頂。許多**窗戶都裝有鐵欄杆以策安全。

text: Panama City can be recognised by the large number of **white high-rise buildings**.
text_zh: 巴拿馬市的特徵是擁有大量**白色高樓大廈**。

text: Colón features a lot of **warehouses **and **rundown multi-storey buildings**.
text_zh: 科隆（Colón）有許多**倉庫**和**破舊的多層建築**。

text: The vast majority of urban housing in Russia are large rectangular apartment buildings made of simple concrete. [Newer buildings](https://goo.gl/maps/qSWTTiaLytipTyBd7) in wealthier areas appear more modern.
text_zh: 俄羅斯的絕大多數都市住宅都是由簡單混凝土製成的大型長方形公寓大樓。較富裕地區的 [較新建築](https://goo.gl/maps/qSWTTiaLytipTyBd7) 看起來更具現代感。

text: Rural housing in Russia consists mostly of a **basic wooden structure** with metal roofs.
text_zh: 俄羅斯的鄉村住宅主要由**基本的木造結構**和金屬屋頂組成。

text: This style of **richly decorated window frames** is commonly found on traditional Russian homes, especially on log cabins. They are often painted blue.
text_zh: 這種**裝飾豐富的窗框**風格常見於傳統的俄羅斯房屋，特別是在木屋上。它們通常被漆成藍色。

text: Buildings made of **white limestone brick** are indicative of Dagestan, as well as adjacent regions.
NOTE: Brick architecture is more consistent the more brick structures you can see in the round.
text_zh: 由**白石灰岩磚**建造的建築是達吉斯坦以及鄰近地區的指標。
注意：如果你環視四周能看到越多磚造結構，磚造建築的線索就會越一致。

text: Buildings made almost entirely of **red brick** are mostly found in the south, with Magnitogorsk, Orsk, and Omsk being notable exceptions.
NOTE: This clue is more consistent the more brick structures you can see in the round.
text_zh: 幾乎完全由**紅磚**建造的建築多見於南部，其中馬格尼托哥爾斯克、奧斯克和鄂木斯克是顯著的例外。
注意：如果你環視四周能看到越多磚造結構，這個線索就會越一致。

text: While mosques can be found everywhere in Russia, they are by far most common in areas with a Muslim majority, mainly in much of south Russia as well as Tatarstan and Bashkortostan.
text_zh: 雖然清真寺在俄羅斯各地都能找到，但它們在穆斯林占多數的地區（主要是俄羅斯南部大部分地區以及韃靼斯坦和巴什科爾托斯坦）絕對是最常見的。

text: Historical buildings in Mari El often have a unique architecture style. You will frequently see design patterns that include **green roofs**, red brick sprinkled with white stone details. [Local churches](https://www.google.com/maps/@56.2884468,46.2917123,3a,42.4y,279.05h,107.04t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1s5uTfNmrvJwCTQn0915srvw!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3D5uTfNmrvJwCTQn0915srvw%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D9.734652%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) commonly feature a similar style.
text_zh: 馬里埃爾的歷史建築通常具有獨特的建築風格。你會經常看到包含**綠色屋頂**、點綴著白石細節的紅磚等設計圖案。[當地教堂](https://www.google.com/maps/@56.2884468,46.2917123,3a,42.4y,279.05h,107.04t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1s5uTfNmrvJwCTQn0915srvw!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3D5uTfNmrvJwCTQn0915srvw%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D9.734652%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)通常也採用類似的風格。

text: Rwandan architecture features a lot of brick and concrete. Most houses in Rwanda are single family houses, which can have rather steep roofs. Houses also often have fences for protection. The most notable feature of Rwandan architecture is the ‘[ventilation bricks](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tFoLkC6fLrWChAwQ8),’ which are present in many houses.
text_zh: 盧安達的建築特色包含大量磚造與混凝土結構。盧安達大多數的房屋都是獨棟住宅，屋頂通常較陡。房屋也常有防護用的圍欄。盧安達建築最顯著的特色是「[通風磚](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tFoLkC6fLrWChAwQ8)」，許多房屋都有這種設計。

text: Villa neighbourhoods often have a lot of tall **security fences and walls**.
text_zh: 別墅區通常有許多高大的**安全圍欄與牆壁**。

text: Much of the Kigali coverage is in the richer neighbourhoods. You will see a lot of **luxury villas**.
text_zh: 基加利的大部分街景覆蓋都在較富裕的社區。你會看到許多**豪華別墅**。

text: **Small, rectangular manufactured homes**, also known as mobile or ‘trailer’ homes, are popular in rural areas of the US. In general, mobile homes are more common in the Southeast, but they can be seen anywhere in the country.
NOTE: This style of home can sometimes be seen in Canada, but to a much lesser extent.
text_zh: **小型長方形組合屋**（也稱為移動房屋或「拖車」房屋）在美國鄉村地區很受歡迎。大體來說，移動房屋在東南部更為常見，但你在全國各地都能看到它們。
注意：這種風格的房屋有時也可以在加拿大看到，但數量少得多。

text: The Appalachian mountain range is a low mountain range that runs through the eastern states. The general landscape consists of **low, forested mountains**, with beech and oak trees being a common sight.

NOTE: Houses in the south generally have [less storeys](https://goo.gl/maps/7MwjHjPstb8UBtvk8). [New England architecture](https://goo.gl/maps/rZWceRbXuLC9BBo76), commonly consisting of wood panelling, high roofs and a porch, is also more common toward the north, especially in New England.
text_zh: 阿帕拉契山脈（Appalachian mountain range）是一條貫穿東部各州的低矮山脈。整體景觀為**低矮且林木茂密的山區**，常見山毛櫸和橡樹。
注意：南方的房屋通常[樓層較少](https://goo.gl/maps/7MwjHjPstb8UBtvk8)。[新英格蘭建築](https://goo.gl/maps/rZWceRbXuLC9BBo76)通常具有木製外牆、高屋頂和門廊，這在北方也較為常見，特別是在新英格蘭地區。

text: In rural areas of Connecticut, Rhode Island, Massachusetts, and New Hampshire, **short rock walls** are commonly visible adjacent to the road.
NOTE: These rock walls can be found rarely in adjacent states.
text_zh: 在康乃狄克州、羅德島州、麻薩諸塞州和新罕布夏州的鄉村地區，道路旁常見到**矮石牆**。
注意：這些石牆在鄰近的州很少見。

text: **Dark-coloured wooden fences** with several horizontal wooden supports are common in farming areas of central and southern Appalachia, stretching from Pennsylvania to Georgia.
NOTE: These types of fences can be found elsewhere to a lesser extent, so use other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 帶有多個水平木質支撐的**深色木柵欄**在中南部阿帕拉契亞的農村地區很常見，從賓州一直延伸到喬治亞州。
注意：這類柵欄在其他地方較少見，因此在猜測前請使用其他線索。

text: **Stilt houses** can sometimes be seen on the coast. These are especially common toward the south, and on the Atlantic and Gulf coasts.
text_zh: 有時在海岸可以見到**高腳屋**。這些在南部以及大西洋和墨西哥灣沿岸特別常見。

text: Similar in style to aforementioned stilt houses, houses with much shorter stilts are common in the western and central Gulf Coast. These houses typically feature short stilts made of concrete or wood (**1-3 feet off the ground**) and are primarily found in areas near the coast and any adjacent rivers.
text_zh: 風格與上述高腳屋相似，立柱矮得多的房屋在墨西哥灣沿岸西部和中部很常見。這些房屋通常採用由混凝土或木材製成的矮立柱（**離地面 1-3 英尺**），主要分佈在海岸附近及任何鄰近河流的地區。

text: Buildings with very **large, sloped roofs** are most common in the states of Oklahoma, Texas, and Louisiana. They can also be seen in neighbouring states to a lesser extent.
text_zh: 擁有非常**大且傾斜屋頂**的建築物最常出現在奧克拉荷馬州、德州和路易斯安那州。在鄰近各州也能見到，但較少見。

text: Houses in coastal New England often feature **shingle walls**, which are layered wood panels overlapping each other.
A similar style of panelling can also be [seen](https://goo.gl/maps/kvoJgHw9fLZTCAYy8), however, having a wider range than the one shown above.
text_zh: 新英格蘭海岸的房屋通常採用**木瓦外牆**，這是層層重疊的木板。
然而，類似風格的拼板也可以[看到](https://goo.gl/maps/kvoJgHw9fLZTCAYy8)，不過分佈範圍比上述的還要廣。

text: Older **three storey wooden houses**, also called ‘[stacked triplexes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Three-decker_(house)),’ are very common in urban areas of the Northeast. They are most prevalent in New York, Connecticut, Rhode Island, and Massachusetts.
NOTE: These types of houses are also somewhat common in cities in [Atlantic Canada](https://maps.app.goo.gl/XKdZcqHCu2YhDXZp7).
text_zh: 較舊的**三層木造房屋**（也稱為「[疊層三拼屋](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Three-decker_(house))」）在東北部的都市地區非常普遍。它們在紐約州、康乃狄克州、羅德島州和麻薩諸塞州最為盛行。
注意：這類房屋在[大西洋加拿大](https://maps.app.goo.gl/XKdZcqHCu2YhDXZp7)的城市中也算常見。

text: Brownstone buildings are typically row houses or government buildings made out of various types of **brick** and **sandstone**. They are most commonly found in dense urban areas of the Northeast US, as well as Chicago.
text_zh: 褐砂石建築通常是由各種**磚塊**和**砂石**製成的連棟房屋或政府建築。它們最常出現在美國東北部的密集都會區以及芝加哥。

text: Buildings with **red metal rooftops** are most commonly found in the Mid-South and Southern Appalachia states of Virginia, West Virginia, Ohio, Kentucky, Tennessee, Arkansas, and North Carolina.
NOTE: These types of rooftops can be found in other areas, so use other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 擁有**紅色金屬屋頂**的建築物最常出現在中南部和南阿帕拉契亞各州，包含維吉尼亞州、西維吉尼亞州、俄亥俄州、肯塔基州、田納西州、阿肯色州和北卡羅萊納州。
注意：這類屋頂也可能出現在其他地區，因此在猜測前請利用其他線索。

text: **Very narrow, one-storey** houses made out of wood are called ‘shotgun houses.’ They are most common in and around New Orleans (LA,) Houston (TX,) Louisville (KY,) and the state of Mississippi.
text_zh: 由木頭建造、**非常狹窄且僅有一層樓**的房屋被稱為「槍管屋（shotgun houses）」。它們最常出現在紐奧良（路易斯安那州）、休士頓（德州）、路易維爾（肯塔基州）及其周邊地區，以及密西西比州。

text: Pueblo Revival style houses are commonly seen in New Mexico. They are typically constructed of adobe or brick and concrete. They have **rounded edges** and **flat roofs**, and are usually sand-brown in colour.
NOTE: Pueblo style houses can also be seen in Arizona and Colorado to a lesser extent.
text_zh: 普韋布洛復興風格房屋在新墨西哥州很常見。它們通常由 adobe（土坏磚）或磚塊與混凝土建造。它們具有**圓潤的邊緣**和**平坦的屋頂**，通常呈沙褐色。
注意：普韋布洛風格的房屋在亞利桑那州和科羅拉多州也能見到，但較少見。

text: Spanish Colonial Revival Architecture can be categorised as buildings with **lightly-coloured stucco walls** and **red clay-tile roofs**. They can be found in the desert southwest states of California, Nevada, Arizona, and Texas. You can also find similar types of buildings in Florida and coastal Georgia.
text_zh: 西班牙殖民復興建築的特點是擁有**淺色 stucco 外牆**和**紅瓦屋頂**。它們可以在西南部沙漠各州（加州、內華達州、亞利桑那州和德州）找到。你在佛羅里達州和喬治亞州海岸也能找到類似類型的建築。

text: Houses and commercial buildings in the interior Western US are often made of lots of **dark wooden boards and timbers**. Buildings at high elevations also commonly have [metal roofs](https://goo.gl/maps/cKmgYwdVFZv6WfTf9), to avoid snow build-up.
text_zh: 美國西部內陸的房屋和商業建築通常由大量**深色木板和木材**建成。高海拔地區的建築也普遍採用[金屬屋頂](https://goo.gl/maps/cKmgYwdVFZv6WfTf9)，以避免積雪。

text: As part of a promotional campaign, the TransAmerica Trail from Oregon to North Carolina was covered by a **Ford Bronco**. The car can be recognised by its unblurred black roof and red hood, and is mostly found on unpaved rural roads.
Looking [backwards](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Zb8pFNSX2FFoRmK98), you will see two other Ford SUVs escorting the camera car.
text_zh: 作為宣傳活動的一部分，從奧勒岡州到北卡羅萊納州的跨美洲步道（TransAmerica Trail）是由一輛**福特野馬（Ford Bronco）**所拍攝的。這輛車可以透過其未模糊的黑色車頂和紅色引擎蓋來識別，主要出現在未鋪裝的鄉村道路上。
往[後方](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Zb8pFNSX2FFoRmK98)看，你會看到另外兩輛護送相機車的 Ford 休旅車。

text: Many bridges are used to connect the various neighbourhoods of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. These expansive, **steel bridges** are commonly painted **bright yellow**. Additionally, Pittsburgh is easy to identify because of it being flanked by 3 rivers and [steep bluffs](https://goo.gl/maps/c1aDMCziomL5iJ3F6) on all sides.
text_zh: 許多橋樑用於連接賓夕法尼亞州匹茲堡的各個社區。這些寬廣的 **鋼製橋樑** 通常被漆成 **亮黃色**。此外，匹茲堡很容易辨認，因為它四周都被 3 條河流和[陡峭峭壁](https://goo.gl/maps/c1aDMCziomL5iJ3F6)所環繞。

text: Row Houses and other buildings in San Francisco are often in the style of Victorian architecture, with many **bay windows, turrets, and ornate exterior details**. These homes are built close together and can be very colourful.
text_zh: 舊金山的連棟房屋和其他建築通常採用維多利亞式建築風格，帶有許多 **凸窗、小塔樓和華麗的外觀細節**。這些房屋建得很緊密，而且色彩可以非常豐富。

text: Neighbourhoods all around the city of New Orleans feature many **colourful, historic, shotgun-style houses.**
Buildings in central areas of New Orleans often feature colourful facades with second storey wrap-around balconies**.**
text_zh: 紐奧良全市各地的社區都有許多 **色彩繽紛、歷史悠久的槍管屋（shotgun-style houses）。**
紐奧良市中心地區的建築通常具有色彩繽紛的外牆以及二樓環繞式陽台**。**

text: Historical areas of Miami and Miami beach are home to many historical, **multi-storey art deco** buildings. These buildings are commonly painted in bright colours and are located near the coast.
text_zh: 邁阿密與邁阿密海灘的歷史街區擁有許多歷史悠久的 **多層裝飾藝術（art deco）** 建築。這些建築通常漆成明亮的顏色，且位於海岸附近。

text: The Alaskan towns in the Alexander Archipelago, on the British Columbia border have a unique look. Tall mountains with **lush green forests** can be seen in the background, with the majority of buildings made of wood. In addition, [Generation 2](https://goo.gl/maps/YU3fykwkkhwSeihP8) coverage is often overcast and misty.
NOTE: Coastal areas of [Oregon](https://goo.gl/maps/JUuhjUojP42eQrsF7) and [Washington](https://goo.gl/maps/LikUSJBshaMjidcK6) can have a similar appearance in terms of landscape and foliage.
text_zh: 位於與英屬哥倫比亞省接壤處的亞歷山大群島阿拉斯加城鎮，外觀獨特。背景可見高聳且**綠意盎然的森林**山脈，大部分建築物為木造。此外，[第二代相機](https://goo.gl/maps/YU3fykwkkhwSeihP8)的街景覆蓋通常陰天且多霧。
注意：[奧勒岡州](https://goo.gl/maps/JUuhjUojP42eQrsF7)和[華盛頓州](https://goo.gl/maps/LikUSJBshaMjidcK6)的沿海地區在景觀和植被方面可能外觀相似。

text: Prudhoe Bay, the northernmost town in America covered by street view, can be recognized by **cold, dead** landscape, overcast clouds and lack of tall buildings. A second Google car can sometimes be seen.
text_zh: 普魯德霍灣 (Prudhoe Bay) 是美國最北端有街景覆蓋的城鎮，可以透過其**寒冷、荒蕪**的景觀、陰沉的天空以及缺乏高樓大廈來辨識。有時可以看到第二輛 Google 車。

text: The general landscape consists of **green, tropical** mountains with many palm trees. Small roads are often made of [concrete](https://goo.gl/maps/GENv4jmjUzvkSbp38). Most houses are one storey, and have a simple box design. Plain **metal sheet** roofs are also very common.
text_zh: 整體地貌由**綠意盎然的熱帶**山脈和許多棕櫚樹組成。小路通常由[混凝土](https://goo.gl/maps/GENv4jmjUzvkSbp38)製成。大多數房屋為一層樓，採用簡單的箱型設計。樸素的**金屬板**屋頂也十分常見。

text: Ofu Airport is small with a **concrete** runway. The Google Car covering it has two **orange straps** on the roof. Many palm trees can also be seen on the other side of the runway.
text_zh: Ofu機場是個小型機場，跑道是**混凝土**的。拍攝該機場的Google 車車頂有兩條**橘色綁帶**。跑道另一側也能看到許多棕櫚樹。

text: Andorra has a lot of these **stone** buildings. They can be seen almost everywhere in the country.
NOTE: These buildings can also be found close to Andorra, in the French and Spanish Pyrenees.
text_zh: 安道爾有許多這類**石造**建築，幾乎全國各地都可見到。
注意：這些建築在安道爾附近，法國和西班牙的庇里牛斯山脈也能找到。

text: A tripod featuring the exterior and [interior](https://goo.gl/maps/s9oJFd4Q8Vuretn89) of a small wooden cabin with a **grey metal roof **can be found south of the eastern tip of Ross Island.
text_zh: 在羅斯島東端以南，可以找到一個展示小型木屋外部和[內部](https://goo.gl/maps/s9oJFd4Q8Vuretn89)的三腳架，該木屋有**灰色金屬屋頂**。

text: McMurdo Station is the largest research station on Antarctica, and can be recognized by the **dark brown soil**, **many buildings**, American infrastructure and sunset coverage.
NOTE: A lot of the coverage around McMurdo Station has the sun setting in the south, which shouldn’t lead you to guess in the northern hemisphere.
text_zh: 麥克默多站是南極洲最大的研究站，其特徵是**深棕色土壤**、**許多建築物**、美國基礎設施和日落街景覆蓋。
注意：麥克默多站周圍的許多街景覆蓋都有太陽從南方落下的情況，這不應讓你誤判為北半球。

text: You can also find tripod coverage inside [several](https://goo.gl/maps/Pa8CQWgr7CmcTBvt7) [buildings](https://goo.gl/maps/JLbjTgt5ibVGp7SF8) at McMurdo Station.
text_zh: 在麥克默多站內，你也可以找到 [幾棟](https://goo.gl/maps/Pa8CQWgr7CmcTBvt7) [建築物](https://goo.gl/maps/JLbjTgt5ibVGp7SF8) 內部的三腳架街景。

text: In Mar Del Plata and surrounding cities (such as Miramar and Necochea), a unique style of architecture can be found. Its main features include **quartzite** **stoned facades**,** orange tiled roofs**, attached garages, and vault shaped porches.
text_zh: 在馬德普拉塔及周邊城市（如米拉馬爾和內科切亞），可以找到一種獨特的建築風格。其主要特色包括**石英岩****石砌外牆**、**橘色瓦片屋頂**、相連的車庫和拱形門廊。

text: The northern QLD city of Cairns is distinct due to its **tropical **vegetation and big green mountains around the city.

NOTE: To differentiate Cairns from other northern Queensland towns, Cairns has many high rise buildings and should feel quite urban. [Divided roads](https://goo.gl/maps/3HjnCsgmbsdWAFMA9) are also common in downtown Cairns, and only commonly seen in Mackay further south, where it is less tropical and more flat.
text_zh: 昆士蘭北部的城市凱恩斯以其**熱帶 **植被和城市周圍綠意盎然的大山為特色。
註：若要將凱恩斯與昆士蘭北部的其他城鎮區分開來，凱恩斯有許多高樓大廈，都市感相當強。凱恩斯市中心也很常見[分隔道路](https://goo.gl/maps/3HjnCsgmbsdWAFMA9)，而這種道路只在更南邊的麥凱（Mackay）較為常見，但麥凱的熱帶感較少且地形更為平坦。

text: Houses in the Azores are typically one or two stories, with an orange tiled roof. They are painted **white** or in **pastel colours**, and dark green shutters on windows are common.

While you can also find [yellow](https://maps.app.goo.gl/eKrCqxAGLvi8JfKr8) or [blue](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tztY4hFYy1q7exjYA) highlights like in mainland Portugal, **grey highlights** are almost exclusive to the Azores.
text_zh: 亞速群島的房子通常是一到兩層樓，帶有橘色瓦片屋頂。牆面塗成**白色**或**粉彩淺色**，窗戶上常見深綠色的百葉窗。
雖然你也可以像在葡萄牙本土一樣找到[黃色](https://maps.app.goo.gl/eKrCqxAGLvi8JfKr8)或[藍色](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tztY4hFYy1q7exjYA)的裝飾外框，但**灰色邊框**幾乎是亞速群島獨有的。

text: **Tin roofs** are commonly found in Bangladesh.
NOTE: Due to the humid climate, many countries in South and Southeast Asia use tin roofs.
text_zh: **鐵皮屋頂**在孟加拉很常見。
註：由於氣候潮濕，南亞和東南亞的許多國家都使用鐵皮屋頂。

text: Bangladesh has several distinct roof styles that create an **east/west** divide in the country.

The west, particularly the divisions of Rajshahi, Khulna and Dhaka, is dominated by [hip roofs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hip_roof) made of sheet metal. The states of Rangpur and Chittagong tend to have mixed roofs.
text_zh: 孟加拉有幾種不同的屋頂風格，在該國形成**東/西**差異。
西部（特別是 Rajshahi、Khulna 和 Dhaka 行政區）以鐵皮製成的 [四坡屋頂](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hip_roof) 為主。Rangpur 和 Chittagong 邦則傾向於混合型屋頂。

text: In the east, you will commonly see sheet metal roofs with a** triangular "window"** just below the ridge of the roof. The state of Sylhet will exclusively have this style, which can also be seen in Chittagong, Mymensingh, eastern Rangpur and northern Dhaka.
text_zh: 在東部，您經常會看到屋脊正下方帶有**三角形「窗戶」**的鐵皮屋頂。Sylhet 邦幾乎清一色是這種風格，這種風格也可以在 Chittagong、Mymensingh、Rangpur 東部和 Dhaka 北部看到。

text: **Tiled roofs** are uncommon in Bangladesh, but the ones you do see are of West Bengal origin, and are thus only found on the Indian border in the state of Khulna.
text_zh: **瓦片屋頂**在孟加拉並不常見，但如果你看到了，它們多半源自西孟加拉邦，因此僅見於 Khulna 邦的印度邊境一帶。

text: The Minsk trekker features a **historic part of the city**, with well-maintained classical European architecture. Many buildings have white or pastel coloured walls. Most of the roads you see are pedestrian-only.
text_zh: 明斯克的徒步拍攝展示了**該市的歷史區域**，擁有維護良好的古典歐洲建築。許多建築都有白色或粉彩色的外牆。您看到的大多數道路都是行人專用道。

text: A lot of houses in Belgium are made of distinctive **red bricks**.
NOTE: This is more common in the North and West of the country.
text_zh: 比利時的許多房屋都是由獨特的**紅磚**造成的。
備註：這在該國北部和西部更常見。

text: Houses in the South of the country use a lot of stone, have gray tones and generally look more French.
text_zh: 該國南部的房屋大量使用石頭，呈灰色調，整體看起來更有法國風格。

text: Bus stops are always marked by **yellow signposts**. Bus shelters often have **yellow roofs**.
text_zh: 公車站總是標有**黃色站牌柱**。公車亭通常有**黃色屋頂**。

text: After Germany, Belgium is the next country in which you can find the most **blurred houses.**
text_zh: 繼德國之後，比利時是你能找到最多**被模糊處理的房屋**的國家。

text: Many parts of the Belgian **North Sea coast** are lined by apartment blocks, in a manner that is often derisively referred to as a “wall” of buildings by locals.
Near the coast, you will also sometimes be able to spot a [dune landscape](https://goo.gl/maps/oM2uuPVVeUfEZt839), with low bushes, long grass and sandy soil.
text_zh: 比利時**北海海岸**的許多地方都排滿了公寓大樓，當地人常嘲諷地稱之為建築「牆」。
在海岸附近，你時不時也能發現[沙丘景觀](https://goo.gl/maps/oM2uuPVVeUfEZt839)，帶有矮灌木、長草和沙質土壤。

text: The most typical look of Bermuda is somewhat dense vegetation, consisting of fairly small trees and a lot of bushes, combined with single family houses strewn across the landscape.
text_zh: 百慕達最典型的景色是稍微密集的植被，由相當矮小的樹木和大量灌木組成，並散落著獨棟住宅。

text: Most buildings on Bermuda are single family stone houses painted in **pastel colours**. They will almost always have **completely white roofs**.
text_zh: 百慕達的大多數建築都是塗上**柔和粉彩**的獨棟石造房屋。它們幾乎總是有**全白的屋頂**。

text: Hamilton is by far the largest town on Bermuda, and as such, the downtown area is distinct due to its many large, densely built **multi-floor buildings**.
text_zh: 漢彌爾敦是百慕達最大的城鎮，因此市中心區域因其許多大型且密集的**多層建築**而非常獨特。

text: The northwestern tip of Bermuda can be recognised by the many large buildings made of **unpainted grey brick**.
text_zh: 百慕達西北端可以透過許多由**未刷漆灰色磚塊**建造的大型建築來辨識。

text: The traditional Bhutanese architecture is very distinct. Most of the houses have **tin roofs** and **wooden painted frames, **which give them a unique look.
text_zh: 傳統的不丹建築非常獨特。大多數房屋都有**錫製屋頂**與**繪有圖樣的木製框架**，這給了它們獨特的外觀。

text: Taxis in Bhutan have **yellow** licence plates and **yellow** roofs.
text_zh: 不丹的計程車有**黃色**車牌和**黃色**車頂。

text: Many buildings in Bolivia consist of** large red bricks**. Buildings often have an ‘unfinished' look.
NOTE: This style of architecture is also common in parts of Peru.
text_zh: 玻利維亞的許多建築都是由**大型紅磚**建造的。建築物通常看起來有種「未完工」的感覺。
注意：這種建築風格在秘魯的部分地區也很常見。

text: Bolivia has a **second official flag**, called the [Wiphala](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wiphala). It is a square patchwork of seven diagonally arranged colours. It is sometimes seen on government buildings and project signs.
text_zh: 玻利維亞有一面**第二官方國旗**，稱為 [Wiphala](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wiphala)。它是一個由七種對角排列顏色組成的方形拼布旗幟。有時可以在政府大樓和工程標誌上看到它。

text: Downtown La Paz is the only place in Bolivia where you will find **very tall buildings** (10+ storeys).
text_zh: 拉巴斯市中心是玻利維亞唯一能看到**非常高的建築物**（10 層樓以上）的地方。

text: El Alto is situated on a very **flat, highland plateau**. It looks much drier and dustier than La Paz. The layout of its streets is also more regular and grid-like.
The city appears like an unending mess of semi-finished red brick buildings, even more so than other cities in Bolivia. Some neighbourhoods have a very rundown, desolate look.
text_zh: 埃爾阿爾托部位於非常**平坦的高山高原**上。它看起來比拉巴斯乾燥且多灰塵得多。其街道布局也更加規整、呈棋盤格狀。
這座城市看起來就像綿延不絕的半成品紅磚建築群，甚至比玻利維亞的其他城市更為明顯。有些社區看起來相當破舊荒涼。

text: In El Alto, you can sometimes see a local type of architecture referred to as [**Neo-Andean**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neo-Andean). Buildings in this style are colourful, with elaborate, futuristic-looking façades. The style is really unique and is almost completely limited to El Alto.
text_zh: 在埃爾阿爾托，你偶爾可以看到一種被稱為[**新安地斯風格**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neo-Andean)的當地建築。這種風格的建築色彩鮮豔，具有精緻且富未來感的外觀立面。這種風格非常獨特，且幾乎完全僅見於埃爾阿爾托。

text: Sucre has a well-preserved **historic city centre**, with lots of old colonial buildings. The downtown area can be recognized by the white walls, orange tiled roofs, and generally more historic look than other places in Bolivia.
text_zh: 蘇克雷擁有保存完好的**歷史城區中心**，有許多古老的殖民時期建築。市中心區域可以透過白牆、橘色瓦片屋頂，以及比玻利維亞其他地方更具歷史感的外觀來辨識。

text: **Sajama National Park** was covered by this unique Google car: it has a black roof rack with a series of metal bars.

The coverage is on an unpaved road surrounded by fluffy bushes. The Nevado Sajama volcano is always [visible](https://goo.gl/maps/31GHyyrBPvTCCVtF7). The car briefly drove through the small village of [Tomarapi](https://goo.gl/maps/9V7ug4DXpnJbr6CW6), which can be recognized by its traditional buildings with adobe walls and thatched roofs.
text_zh: **薩哈馬國家公園**是由這輛獨特的 Google 車拍攝的：它有一個帶有一系列金屬桿的黑色車頂架。
街景位於一條周圍環繞著蓬鬆灌木叢的未鋪柏油道路上。薩哈馬火山始終[清晰可見](https://goo.gl/maps/31GHyyrBPvTCCVtF7)。Google 車曾短暫駛過小村莊[托馬拉皮](https://goo.gl/maps/9V7ug4DXpnJbr6CW6)，該村莊以其擁有adobe泥磚牆和茅草屋頂的傳統建築而聞名。

text: Typical Botswana houses range from small impoverished shacks to comfortable middle-class bungalows. Some buildings have exposed grey bricks. On occasion, you might find traditional round huts.
NOTE: All of these house styles are also found in the other southern African countries.
text_zh: 典型的波札那房屋樣式從貧困的小棚屋到舒適的中產階級平房都有。有些建築物有外露的灰色磚塊。偶爾你也可能會發現傳統的圓形茅草屋。
註：所有這些房屋樣式在其他南部非洲國家也能看到。

text: **Blue Fortlev water tanks **are often seen on Brazilian roofs.
text_zh: 巴西的屋頂上經常可以看到**藍色的 Fortlev 水塔**。

text: Most houses in Bulgaria have orange tiled roofs, with distinct **patches of **[**mortar**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mortar_(masonry)) along the corner tiles.
Famously, Bulgarian roofs often seem **poorly constructed**: the roof tiles and mortar tend to be uneven, especially when compared to other European countries.
text_zh: 保加利亞的大多數房屋都有橘色瓦片屋頂，沿著屋角瓦片有明顯的**一塊塊**[**灰泥**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mortar_(masonry))。
保加利亞的屋頂著名地看起來經常**施工品質不佳**：屋瓦和灰泥往往不平整，特別是與其他歐洲國家相比時。

text: Buildings with features similar to Alpine architecture, such as **white walls** with **brown wooden details** are commonly found in and around the Smoljan region in the south.
text_zh: 具有類似阿爾卑斯山建築特徵的建築物，例如帶有**棕色木質裝飾細節**的**白牆**，常見於南部斯莫梁地區及其周邊。

text: The old town of Nessebar, and to a lesser extent Sozopol, can be recognised by the well-preserved old buildings made of a combination of unpainted stone, white stone walls and brown wood. Most of the streets are paved with cobblestone.
text_zh: 內塞伯爾古城（以及較小程度的索佐波爾）可以透過保存完好、結合未漆石材、白石牆與棕色木材的老建築來辨認。大多數街道都是鵝卵石鋪成的。

text: **Wooden houses on stilts** are common. Walls are often made of vertical planks. Many homes have [double or triple roofs](https://goo.gl/maps/21wWXJpTT8z9E3ua9).
text_zh: **高腳木屋**很常見。牆壁通常由垂直木板製成。許多住宅擁有[雙層或三層屋頂](https://goo.gl/maps/21wWXJpTT8z9E3ua9)。

text: In addition, traditional Cambodian wooden stilt houses tend to have very recognizable **colour schemes**.
- Walls are commonly painted dark red-brown, light blue or an ochre orange.
- Doors, windows and other architectural details are often painted bright blue.
NOTE: More modern houses tend to have a wider variety of colour schemes.
text_zh: 此外，傳統柬埔寨高腳木屋通常有非常容易辨認的**配色方案**。
- 牆壁通常塗成暗紅棕色、淺藍色或赭橙色。
- 門、窗戶與其他建築細節通常塗成鮮藍色。
注意：較現代的房屋通常會有更多元化的配色。

text: Many traditional homes have **tiled orange or red roofs**, sometimes with ornaments on the ridges and corners. Corrugated and plain metal roofs are also common.
On other, more modern buildings, you can see a wider variety of roof colours and materials.
text_zh: 許多傳統住宅鋪有**橙色或紅色的瓦片屋頂**，屋脊和屋角有時帶有裝飾物。浪板和平整的金屬屋頂也很常見。
至於其他較現代的建築，你可以看到更多樣化的屋頂顏色與材質。

text: The majority of Cambodians are **Buddhist**. Temples are common throughout the country. Temple architecture is highly decorative, with ornamented roofs. You might also see [Buddhist flags](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buddhist_flag).
NOTE: Thailand and Laos are also majority Buddhist. Temples in these countries can look similar.
text_zh: 大多數柬埔寨人信仰**佛教**。寺廟遍布全國各地。寺廟建築極具裝飾性，帶有雕飾的屋頂。你也可能會看到[佛教旗幟](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buddhist_flag)。
注意：泰國和寮國也以佛教為主。這些國家的寺廟看起來可能很相似。

text: **Angkor Wat** is a massive temple complex built by the historical Khmer Empire. It is located just north of Siem Reap and has extensive trekker coverage. It can be recognized by its dark, weathered stone buildings. While this location is unlikely to show up in competitive maps, it is extremely common in GeoGuessr’s official Cambodia map.
text_zh: **吳哥窟（Angkor Wat）**是由歷史上的高棉帝國建造的巨大寺廟群。它位於 Siem Reap 正北方，擁有廣泛的徒步拍攝（trekker）街景覆蓋。它可以透過深色、風化的石造建築來辨認。雖然這個地點不太可能出現在競技地圖中，但在 GeoGuessr 的官方柬埔寨地圖中非常常見。

text: Nain is a small town on the Northeastern coast of Labrador. The town features **colourful wooden houses**, and **trees **in and around the town. To the north, a [big hill](https://goo.gl/maps/UeGydx1F6QdyViVg7) is usually visible. And to the south, [rocky cliffs](https://goo.gl/maps/YPww4ALKREgUZNrj6) can be seen on the other side of the bay. Additionally, kids can sometimes be seen walking beside the trekker.
text_zh: 內恩（Nain）是拉布拉多東北海岸的小鎮。該鎮的特色是**色彩繽紛的木屋**，且鎮內及周邊有**樹木**。朝北通常可以看到[大山丘](https://goo.gl/maps/UeGydx1F6QdyViVg7)。朝南則可以在海灣對岸看到[岩石峭壁](https://goo.gl/maps/YPww4ALKREgUZNrj6)。此外，有時候可以看到小孩走在跟拍車旁邊。

text: Red Bay is a town on the southern coast of Labrador, and as such, the **coast **is always visible. It features slightly **red soil**, and most of the houses are painted white.
text_zh: 紅貝（Red Bay）是拉布拉多南海岸的一個城鎮，因此**海岸**總是清晰可見。這裡有微帶**紅色土壤**，且大多數房子的漆成白色。

text: The Hubei Museum in Wuhan can be recognised by its **palace-like** architecture with **grey roofs**.
text_zh: 武漢的湖北省博物館可以透過其帶有**灰色屋頂**的**宮殿式**建築來識別。

text: Shanghai Long Museum can be recognised by the **boxy concrete main building**.
text_zh: 上海龍美術館可以透過**方正的混凝土主建築**來識別。

text: Suzhou Museum can be recognised by the white and grey **symmetric angular architecture**.
text_zh: 蘇州博物館可以透過白灰相間、**對稱的具稜角建築**來識別。

text: The Yangzhou Museum can be recognised by the **beige rounded stone building**.
text_zh: 揚州博物館可以透過**米色圓形石造建築**來識別。

text: Colombian taxis are always this **pastel yellow** colour. As opposed to private vehicles, they have white licence plates, which are often printed on the side and roof. If unblurred, you will often see the city name.
NOTE: Ecuadorian taxis may look similar. However, they use a slightly more saturated yellow and typically have orange plates.
text_zh: 哥倫比亞計程車總是這種**粉嫩黃色**。與私人車輛相反，它們使用白色車牌，通常會印在車身側邊與車頂上。如果沒有模糊，你通常會看到城市名稱。
註：厄瓜多計程車看起來可能很像。然而，它們使用的是飽和度稍高的黃色，且通常使用橘色車牌。

text: Costa Rican architecture is less colonial than that of Panama. Few houses have proper tiled roofs, with dark red sheet metal or dark red plastic tiles being more common. Buildings typically have **pastel-coloured concrete walls** and are usually either a low **single-family** house or **boxy two-storey** structure. They are often heavily guarded with **fences **and **barred windows**, to the point that it can be hard to even see a building on many streets.
text_zh: 哥斯大黎加的建築比巴拿馬更不具殖民地風格。很少有房子使用真正的瓦片屋頂，更常見的是深紅色金屬薄板或深紅色塑膠瓦。建築物通常有**粉彩色調的混凝土牆**，通常是矮矮的**單戶**住宅或**方型的兩層樓**結構。它們通常受到嚴密的保護，裝有**柵欄**和**鐵窗**，甚至在許多街道上很難看清楚一棟建築物。

text: **San José** is the capital and by far the largest urban area in Costa Rica. Situated in a valley between multiple mountains, the roads have a noticeable incline. You will see many suburban neighbourhoods and [taller buildings](https://maps.app.goo.gl/cJGHc42e3oXrugMK8) than anywhere else in the country.
text_zh: **聖荷西**是哥斯大黎加的首都，也是遠為最大的都會區。坐落於多座山脈之間的山谷中，道路有著明顯的坡度。你會看到許多郊區鄰里以及全國其他任何地方都沒有的[更高建築物](https://maps.app.goo.gl/cJGHc42e3oXrugMK8)。

text: Houses on stilts are mostly found on the northeastern coast.
text_zh: 高腳屋大多出現在東北海岸。

text: The University of Costa Rica, in eastern San José, is fairly busy, with a lot of greenery and various medium-sized buildings strewn across the campus.
text_zh: 位於聖荷西東部的哥斯大黎加大學相當熱鬧，校園內有許多綠地和散落各處的中型建築物。

text: The coverage in Liberia can be recognised by a white building with rounded windows having brown wooden window frames. This building can be seen on all coverage in the town.
text_zh: 利比利亞的覆蓋可以透過一棟帶有棕色木製窗框、窗戶呈圓形的白色建築來辨識。這棟建築在該城鎮的所有覆蓋中都能看到。

text: Buildings in Croatia sometimes feature exposed **red brick walls**. This architecture is more common in inland areas.
NOTE: This type of architecture can also be found in Slovenia and Serbia.
text_zh: 克羅埃西亞的建築有時會採用外露的**紅磚牆**。這種建築風格在內陸地區較為常見。
注意：這種建築風格也可以在斯洛維尼亞和塞爾維亞找到。

text: Houses and walls made of **beige brick** are common on the Adriatic coast. They often feature **green **shutters.
NOTE: Similar architecture can also be found in some regions in Italy. Additionally, Croatian shutters can also be white, beige etc.
text_zh: 亞得里亞海沿岸常見由**米色磚塊**建造的房屋和牆壁。它們通常配有**綠色**百葉窗。
注意：類似的建築風格也可以在義大利的一些地區看到。此外，克羅埃西亞的百葉窗也可能是白色、米色等。

text: The town of Petrinja was severely damaged by an earthquake in 2020. As a result, many buildings can be seen **ruined** and undergoing repair.
text_zh: 佩特里尼亞鎮在 2020 年的地震中嚴重受損。因此，可以看到許多建築物**毀損**並正在進行修繕。

text: This **black car** with a **roof rack** is unique to Curaçao.
text_zh: 這輛帶有**車頂架**的**黑色汽車**是古拉索特有的。

text: Much of the architecture on Curaçao consists of **simple, one storey bungalows** that are **pastel coloured**. Metal roofs are common on smaller shacks, while tiled roofs can be seen on more expensive houses. Additionally, multi storey villas can sometimes be seen.
text_zh: 古拉索的大部分建築由**簡單的單層平房**組成，且漆成**粉彩色調**。小型木屋常見金屬屋頂，而較貴的房屋則可見瓦片屋頂。此外，有時也能看到多層樓的別墅。

text: The western half of Curaçao is characterised by a semi-arid **rural** **landscape** with green, but dry hills. Houses are spread apart, with the roads in the west quite narrow in width.
text_zh: 古拉索的西半部以半乾旱的**鄉村** **地貌**為特徵，帶有綠色但乾燥的山丘。房屋分佈散落，西部的道路寬度相當窄。

text: Most buildings are made of brightly painted stone, with either a tiled or a flat roof.
NOTE: These features are also common in Greek architecture.
text_zh: 大多數建築物都是用色彩鮮明的石材建造，配有瓦片屋頂或平屋頂。
註：這些建築特色在希臘建築中也很常見。

text: Houses in Cyprus often have a** horizontal **and **cylindrical** water tank that is **white **in colour, and has a circular access lid near one end on the top.
text_zh: 賽普勒斯的房屋通常有一個**水平**且**圓柱形**的水塔，顏色是**白色**的，且頂部靠近一端的地方有一個圓形的檢修蓋。

text: Like all of the former Eastern bloc, prefabricated panel apartment buildings are a common sight in urban areas. What distinguishes Czechia and Slovakia is the relatively good maintenance often combined with vibrant colours and patterns. Some [smaller buildings](https://goo.gl/maps/4YLfxcgfqaBqdyAz7) also adhere to this style.
NOTE: To a lesser extent, you can find this kind of architecture in neighbouring countries, like [Poland](https://goo.gl/maps/qDTiRFmn8nDkEmxYA) and [Hungary](https://goo.gl/maps/rFL2pygygEQKHmTJ6).
text_zh: 就像所有前東歐集團國家一樣，預鑄組合板公寓大樓在市區是很常見的景象。捷克和斯洛伐克的特色是維護狀況相對良好，通常結合了鮮豔的色彩和圖案。有些[較小的建築物](https://goo.gl/maps/4YLfxcgfqaBqdyAz7)也遵循這種風格。
注意：在鄰近國家（如[波蘭](https://goo.gl/maps/qDTiRFmn8nDkEmxYA)和[匈牙利](https://goo.gl/maps/rFL2pygygEQKHmTJ6)），你也能在一定程度上找到這種建築風格。

text: Roofs with **diamond shaped tiles** are common in both Czechia and Slovakia.
NOTE: This is also somewhat common in Hungary.
text_zh: 捷克和斯洛伐克都很常見**菱形磁磚**屋頂。
注意：這在匈牙利也算常見。

text: House numbers in Czechia are generally written on **blue** or **red signs** with thin white borders.
NOTE: On the contrary, Slovak house numbers are typically written on [**white signs**](https://goo.gl/maps/arqzJku5JuJJ3CcQ8)** **with a thin red or black border.
text_zh: 捷克的門牌號碼通常寫在帶有細白邊的**藍色**或**紅色標誌**上。
注意：相對地，斯洛伐克的門牌號碼通常寫在帶有細紅邊或黑邊的[**白色標誌**](https://goo.gl/maps/arqzJku5JuJJ3CcQ8)** **上。

text: Suburban houses in Czechia are commonly connected in **pairs**.
NOTE: This is less common in most neighbouring countries, including Slovakia.
text_zh: 捷克的郊區房屋通常是**兩棟相連**的。
注意：這在多數鄰國（包括斯洛伐克）較不常見。

text: **Timber framed** houses in Czechia are mostly found along the northern parts of the German border.
text_zh: 捷克的**木骨架**房屋大多位於德國邊境的北部沿線。

text: Dark wooden houses, with **white stripes** shining through the wood, are common in most of northern Czechia.
text_zh: 木造透出**白色條紋**的深色房屋在捷克北部大部分地區都很常見。

text: Town houses in Moravia typically have two distinctive features:
- Houses have the long side **parallel** to the road and are often connected in large groups.
- Front doors are **abnormally large**, similar in size and shape to barn doors.
NOTE: This is also common in northeastern [Austria](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.7559741,16.4949051,3a,72y,332.39h,86.97t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sME9cWV1NiHnfiGEqqsE0NQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192!5m1!1e4).
text_zh: 摩拉維亞的城鎮房屋通常有兩個顯著特徵：
- 房屋的長邊與道路**平行**，通常會緊密相連成一大群建築。
- 正門**異常巨大**，大小和形狀類似農場的雙扇大門。
注意：這在東北部的[奧地利](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.7559741,16.4949051,3a,72y,332.39h,86.97t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sME9cWV1NiHnfiGEqqsE0NQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192!5m1!1e4)也很常見。

text: A variant of baroque architecture called **Selské Baroko** (folk baroque) can be found in the region surrounding České Budějovice. The style is characterised by highly decorated walls, with the setting being small villages rather than towns and cities.
text_zh: 在捷克布傑約維采周邊地區可以找到一種名為 **Selské Baroko**（民間巴洛克）的巴洛克建築變體。這種風格的特徵是高度裝飾的牆壁，且場景是小村莊而非城鎮和大都市。

text: It is more common to see houses with **single pane windows** in the northwestern parts of the country.
text_zh: 在該國西北部地區，較常看到採用**單片窗戶**的房屋。

text: Cube shaped, functionalist red brick houses are found in Zlín, as a remainder of the shoemaking company Baťa’s houses for their workers. In the city centre, [high rise buildings](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ByefWZehCpE5aaTNA) are constructed in similar style.

NOTE: So-called [Bata-villes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bata_Corporation#Bata-villes) were also constructed outside of Czechia, most notably in [Slovakia](https://maps.app.goo.gl/9ZFGCsyHY2sJu4CQ9) and [France](https://maps.app.goo.gl/9gRny5QSD4eFX4JA9).
text_zh: 立方體造型的機能主義紅磚房可在茲林找到，這是製鞋公司巴塔（Baťa）為員工建造房屋的遺留痕跡。在市中心，[高樓大廈](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ByefWZehCpE5aaTNA)也採用了類似的風格建造。
注意：所謂的[巴達村](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bata_Corporation#Bata-villes)也在捷克共和國境外建造，最著名的是在[斯洛伐克](https://maps.app.goo.gl/9ZFGCsyHY2sJu4CQ9)和[法國](https://maps.app.goo.gl/9gRny5QSD4eFX4JA9)。

text: Pairs of black and white house numbers are found in Brno.
NOTE: The city district can be found written on the black house number.
text_zh: 黑白配對的門牌號碼可在布爾諾找到。
注意：行政區劃名稱會寫在黑色門牌號碼上。

text: Pilsen house numbers typically consist of two red and white octagonal plates with inverse colour schemes.
text_zh: 皮爾森的門牌號碼通常由兩個紅白相間、顏色配置相反的八角形牌子組成。

text: House numbers in České Budějovice have one red and one white plate with **underlined numbers**.
text_zh: 捷克布傑約維采的門牌號碼有一個紅牌和一個白牌，並附有**底線數字**。

text: Red house numbers with a **dividing line** and a **Roman numeral** are unique to Liberec.
The dividing line is an important identifying factor, as Roman numerals can be found on house numbers in [other cities.](https://goo.gl/maps/dS4PNxQdieaMEBxm9)
text_zh: 帶有**分隔線**和**羅馬數字**的紅色門牌號碼是利貝雷茨特有的。
分隔線是一個重要的辨識特徵，因為羅馬數字也可能出現在[其他城市](https://goo.gl/maps/dS4PNxQdieaMEBxm9)的門牌號碼上。

text: Písek uses **yellow house numbers** with a black outline.
text_zh: 皮塞克使用配有黑色外框的**黃色門牌號碼**。

text: Denmark is a generally [flat](https://goo.gl/maps/wt6BuwquwRoUX68m6) country with wide, [open fields](https://goo.gl/maps/Jb3jz3sdcsSrYGQc9) between towns. [Suburban areas](https://goo.gl/maps/17bXd4RSqqJSu26MA) are usually open, with space between buildings. Urban cores are more dense and built up.
text_zh: 丹麥基本上是一個[地勢平坦](https://goo.gl/maps/wt6BuwquwRoUX68m6)的國家，城鎮之間有著寬闊且[開闊的田野](https://goo.gl/maps/Jb3jz3sdcsSrYGQc9)。[郊區](https://goo.gl/maps/17bXd4RSqqJSu26MA)通常很開闊，建築物之間有著一定的空間。市中心則較為密集且開發度高。

text: Much of the architecture in Denmark consists of **red brick**. Roofs often have orange, dark brown or black tiles.
NOTE: Similar brick architecture is also common in the Netherlands and Belgium.
text_zh: 丹麥的大部分建築都由**紅磚**構成。屋頂通常使用橘色、深棕色或黑色的瓦片。
注意：類似的磚造建築在荷蘭和比利時也很常見。

text: Some houses in Denmark have [**thatched roofs**](https://goo.gl/maps/aDB7vcs9VXEMNan37), especially in rural areas.
You can also sometimes find grey [**corrugated roofs**](https://goo.gl/maps/nGYSiVBbLtqLsbro8). These look somewhat similar to roofs commonly found in Baltic countries.
text_zh: 丹麥的一些房屋擁有[**茅草屋頂**](https://goo.gl/maps/aDB7vcs9VXEMNan37)，特別是在農村地區。
有時你也可以找到灰色[**瓦楞屋頂**](https://goo.gl/maps/nGYSiVBbLtqLsbro8)。這些看起來有點類似波羅的海國家常見的屋頂。

text: Some older or rural buildings have **timber frame** walls.
NOTE: Timber framing can be found in other Western and Central European countries as well, but are an especially common wall type for historical buildings in Denmark.
text_zh: 有些較舊或鄉村的建築物有**木構架**牆壁。
注意：木構架也可能出現在其他西歐和中歐國家，但丹麥的歷史建築特別常使用這種牆面類型。

text: These traditional “seaweed roofs” are found on the island of Læsø. They are made from a type of seaweed known as [eelgrass](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zostera).
text_zh: 這些傳統的「海草屋頂」見於萊斯島。它們是由一種稱為[大葉藻](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zostera)的海草製成的。

text: As the capital and largest city, Santo Domingo has a **more developed downtown **area, with tall buildings and wide avenues.
text_zh: 作為首都和最大城市，聖多明哥擁有**更開發的市中心**地區，有高樓大廈和寬闊的大道。

text: Most houses are made of grey bricks and have metal roofs.
NOTE: This is not unique to Ecuador, but is very common. Countries such as Peru, and especially Bolivia, commonly use red bricks.
text_zh: 大多數房屋都是由灰磚建造並配有金屬屋頂。
注意：這並非厄瓜多獨有，但非常普遍。祕魯等國家，尤其是玻利維亞，普遍使用紅磚。

text: Many of the buildings you see in the trekker coverage are made of **sandstone**.
text_zh: 你在徒步拍攝街景中看到的許多建築都是由**砂岩**建成。

text: The trekker in and around the [Hanging Church](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hanging_Church) consists of two parts that look fairly different from each other.

Outside the church, the trekker is walking around a **normal urban Cairo street**. At most points, you will still see the church complex, its spires with crosses, and historic sandstone walls. But you will also see apartment buildings, shops, and normal pedestrian traffic.
_This trekker can be found just east of Giza, near the map label Fustat._
text_zh: [懸空教堂](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hanging_Church)內部與周邊的徒步拍攝由兩個看起來截然不同的部分組成。
在教堂外面，徒步拍攝相機正走在一條**開羅的普通市區街道**上。在多數視角下，你依然會看到教堂建築群、帶有十字架的尖頂以及歷史悠久的砂岩牆。但你也會看到公寓大樓、商店和正常的行人交通。
_這個徒步拍攝點位在吉薩正東方，靠近地圖標籤福斯塔特（Fustat）。_

text: The monastery complex of Saint Mina consists of several large, palace-like buildings in a somewhat modern, Arabic style. Most of the buildings have several **spires** crowned with **Christian crosses**.
text_zh: 聖米納修道院建築群由幾棟大型、宮殿式的建築組成，帶有某種現代的阿拉伯風格。大多數建築都有好幾個頂部飾有**基督教十字架**的**尖頂**。

text: It is fairly common to find **oval-shaped** blue house numbers in Estonia.

NOTE: This is not common in the other Baltic countries, but can also be found in [Russia](https://www.google.com/maps/@59.0913517,28.1667574,3a,15y,304.49h,91.94t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sTX_XXjOnF4tmR0_rySvAQQ!2e0!5s20130601T000000!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).
text_zh: 在愛沙尼亞經常可以找到**橢圓形**的藍色門牌號碼。
注意：這在其他波羅的海國家並不常見，但也能在[俄羅斯](https://www.google.com/maps/@59.0913517,28.1667574,3a,15y,304.49h,91.94t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sTX_XXjOnF4tmR0_rySvAQQ!2e0!5s20130601T000000!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)找到。

text: Estonian architecture generally consists of a combination of wood and white brick, typically with somewhat steep corrugated metal roofs. Painted stone walls are also somewhat common. While wooden buildings can be found in all three Baltic countries, they are more common in Estonia.
text_zh: 愛沙尼亞的建築通常由木材與白磚結合而成，一般搭配稍微陡峭的波浪狀金屬屋頂。漆過的石牆也相當常見。雖然木造建築在所有三個波羅的海國家都能找到，但在愛沙尼亞更為普遍。

text: The old town of Tallinn looks very different from any other urban area in Estonia. It is an almost perfectly preserved historic area, with lots of **medieval and renaissance-era buildings**. In places, it can look a lot like cities in central Europe.
text_zh: 塔林（Tallinn）的舊城區看起來與愛沙尼亞任何其他市區截然不同。這是一個幾乎完美保存的歷史區域，有著大量**中世紀和文藝復興時期的建築**。在某些地方，它看起來非常像中歐的城市。

text: All Generation 3 car coverage on the Faroe Islands has a black Street View car with a **plain grey roof rack**.
NOTE: No other country with a similar landscape has a car similar to this.
text_zh: 法羅群島所有第三代相機車的街景覆蓋，都配有一輛車頂架為**素灰色**的黑色 Google 車。
註記：沒有其他擁有類似地景的國家有類似的車輛。

text: Faroese houses are typically made of wood, often with an **above ground basement** made of stone which is painted in a different colour than the wooden part. Roofs will usually be either metal or have **grass on top** (turf).
text_zh: 法羅群島的房屋通常由木頭建造，經常配有**地面以上的地下室**，該地下室以不同於木造部分的顏色漆成。屋頂通常是金屬材質或**鋪有草皮**（草皮屋頂）。

text: Torshavn is by far the **biggest town** on the islands, and the only place where you will find buildings taller than three floors. The landscape is somewhat open relative to the rest of the country, particularly to the east.
text_zh: 托爾斯港（Torshavn）是群島中**最大的城鎮**，也是唯一能找到超過三層樓建築的地方。相較於該國其他地區，這裡的地景稍微開闊，特別是東部地區。

text: The village of Kirkjubøur at the southern tip of the main island can be recognised by the **black houses**, almost all having **grass roofs**. The town also has a small [church ruin](https://goo.gl/maps/iKdyAK21o3jhrJFh7).
text_zh: 主島南端的小村莊柯克朱博爾（Kirkjubøur）可以透過**黑色的房屋**來識別，幾乎所有房屋都有**草皮屋頂**。該城鎮還有一處小型[教堂廢墟](https://goo.gl/maps/iKdyAK21o3jhrJFh7)。

text: **Finnish architecture** is mostly modern and utilitarian. Downtown areas tend to be very modern, with lots of apartment buildings and use of concrete. Suburbs mostly consist of freestanding single family homes. Many houses have wooden cladding. Like Sweden and Norway, some wooden buildings, especially in the countryside, are painted in a distinctive [dark red colour](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Falu_red).
text_zh: **芬蘭建築**大多現代且實用。市中心地區往往非常現代，有許多公寓大樓並大量使用混凝土。郊區大多由獨立的單戶住宅組成。許多房屋擁有木製外牆。就像瑞典和挪威一樣，一些木造建築（特別是在鄉村地區）被漆成獨特的[深紅色](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Falu_red)。

text: You can find **Red rectangular metallic plates** with 7 golden or dark red coloured protrusions that form a rounded hexagon shape on houses, lamp posts, and signposts in Tampere.
text_zh: 你可以在坦佩雷的房屋、路燈桿和路標上找到**紅色金屬長方形牌子**，上面有 7 個金色或深紅色的突起，形成一個圓潤的六邊形形狀。

text: Each German state also has their own coat of arms. They are found on unblurred licence plates and some official buildings.
text_zh: 德國每個邦也都有自己的邦徽。它們可以在未模糊的車牌和一些官方建築上找到。

text: These brick houses are generally concentrated in **northwestern** Germany.
NOTE: This map is very approximate.
text_zh: 這些磚造房屋通常集中在德國**西北部**。
註記：這張地圖非常約略。

text: **Thatched roofs** and **rock walls** are most common on the [North Frisian Islands](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/North_Frisian_Islands), as well as mainland Schleswig-Holstein. You can also commonly find them in coastal **resort towns** in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern.
text_zh: **茅草屋頂**和**石牆**在[北弗里斯蘭群島](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/North_Frisian_Islands)以及什勒斯維希-霍爾斯坦本土最為常見。你也可以在梅克倫堡-西波美拉尼亞的沿海**度假城鎮**中常見到它們。

text: Houses with **black slate walls**, resembling fish scales, are commonly found in a large area of central Germany.
text_zh: 具有**黑色板岩牆**、外觀酷似魚鱗的房屋，常見於德國中部的一大片區域。

text: These **large**, utilitarian **apartment buildings** constructed during the socialist era, that are also known as “[Commie blocks](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Urban_planning_in_communist_countries)” are common in all of former East Germany.
text_zh: 這些在社會主義時期建造的**大型**、實用主義風格**公寓大樓**，也就是俗稱的「[共產主義街區](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Urban_planning_in_communist_countries)」（Commie blocks），在前東德地區非常普遍。

text: This type of **half-timbered** house with **arches** at the ground floor is very common in this region of Saxony.
text_zh: 這種在地面層帶有**拱門**的**半木構**房屋在薩克森的這個地區非常普遍。

text: The [**shrub** and **sand** covered hills](https://goo.gl/maps/S5iYEBFRs4prPQ5M8) are unique to the island of Sylt. And like the rest of the North Frisian Islands, rock walls, brick houses, and thatched roofs are common.
NOTE: Some parts of Sylt look [more generic](https://goo.gl/maps/YQfwxNwtUKZtoGYV9), but still very flat.
text_zh: 這些[覆蓋著**灌木**與**沙子**的山丘](https://goo.gl/maps/S5iYEBFRs4prPQ5M8)是敘爾特島（Sylt）特有的景觀。就像北弗里斯蘭群島（North Frisian Islands）的其他地方一樣，石牆、磚造房屋和茅草屋頂十分常見。
註：敘爾特島的一些地區看起來[比較大眾化](https://goo.gl/maps/YQfwxNwtUKZtoGYV9)，但地形依然非常平坦。

text: All regular road** generation 3** coverage in Ghana was made with a unique Google car. It has a visible roof rack with a piece of **black tape** on the right end of the front bar. In addition, the hood of the car is usually visible, showing a street view car wrapping that features a **red rectangle** and some other recognizable elements. Normally, this unique car is all you need to identify Ghana.
NOTE: Several natural reserves were covered with different unique cars.
text_zh: 迦納所有常規的**第三代**道路街景覆蓋都是由一台獨特的 Google 車所拍攝。它有明顯的車頂架，且前車頂架右端貼有一段**黑色膠帶**。此外，通常可以看到車頭蓋，上面有街景車身包膜，包含一個**紅色長方形**和其他容易辨識的元素。通常，這台獨特的車就是你識別迦納所需的全部線索。
註：幾個自然保護區使用了不同的獨特車輛進行拍攝。

text: The Ankasa Game Reserve has a unique Google car. The entire front of the Google car **can be seen,** with only the actual camera blurred. The roof of the car will have a street view vinyl and the ‘Ghana tape’ will be present.
text_zh: 安卡薩野生動物保護區（Ankasa Game Reserve）有一台獨特的 Google 車。整台 Google 車的車頭**都可以被看到，**只有實際的相機鏡頭被打了馬賽克。車頂上會有街景車身貼膜，且「迦納膠帶」也會出現。

text: The Boabeng Fiema Monkey Sanctuary has a unique Google car. The ‘Ghana tape’ and roof rack will **not **be visible however, the **black right side mirror** will be slightly visible just outside the blur.
NOTE: The red soil and surrounding vegetation should still be good clues for the country, despite the lack of the typical car meta associated with Ghana.
text_zh: 波本費馬猴子保護區（Boabeng Fiema Monkey Sanctuary）有一台獨特的 Google 車。「迦納膠帶」和車頂架將**不會**被看到，不過**黑色右側後視鏡**會在馬賽克外圍微微露出。
註：儘管缺乏與迦納相關的典型車輛特徵，但紅色的土壤和周圍的植被仍然是該國很好的線索。

text: The urban parts of Gibraltar are mostly fairly dense. Buildings look similar to those found in other Mediterranean countries. They have **pastel colours** and **louvered window shutters** (horizontal slats of wood set into a frame). These window shutters are usually painted green, blue or brown.
text_zh: 直布羅陀的都市地區大多相當密集。建築物看起來與其他地中海國家發現的類似。它們有著**粉彩色調**和**百葉窗**（嵌入框架中的水平木條）。這些百葉窗通常漆成綠色、藍色或棕色。

text: Greek architecture shares a lot of features with other Mediterranean countries: a lot of white and pastel-coloured stone houses with orange tiled roofs. **White houses** are very common when compared to most other Mediterranean countries.
Urban residential buildings will generally be multi-floored, light-coloured and typically have connected balconies along one or multiple walls.
Perhaps the most recognisable style of Greek architecture are the white houses with blue fences, window frames and doors. Beware that these are mainly found on islands.
text_zh: 希臘的建築風格與其他地中海國家有很多相似之處：許多白色的粉彩色石造房屋配有橘色瓦片屋頂。相較於多數其他地中海國家，**白色房屋**非常普遍。
城市住宅通常為多樓層、淺色，且通常沿著一面或多面牆壁有相連的陽台。
希臘最具辨識度的建築風格，莫過於擁有藍色圍欄、窗框和門的白色房屋。請注意，這些主要出現在島嶼上。

text: One of the most well-known types of Greek architecture; houses with completely **white walls, blue doors** **and shutters**, is mainly found on the small central Cyclade islands.
text_zh: 希臘最著名的建築類型之一：擁有完全**白牆、藍門與百葉窗**的房屋，主要分佈在中央的小型基克拉澤斯群島上。

text: **Blue taxis** with a **white roof** are found in Thessaloniki.
text_zh: 塞薩洛尼基常見**藍色計程車**搭配**白色車頂**。

text: In Thessaloniki, you will often see a **large amount** of **unusually tall antennas** on top of buildings.
text_zh: 在塞薩洛尼基，你經常會在建築物頂端看到**數量龐大**且**異常高聳的天線**。

text: Greenlandic architecture mainly consists of small, **colourful**, simple looking **wooden **houses, which even in cities are typically placed quite sparsely. The major cities have some larger buildings, which normally look fairly minimalistic.
text_zh: 格陵蘭的建築主要由小型、**色彩繽紛**、外觀簡約的**木造**房屋組成，即使在城市中通常也分布得相當稀疏。大城市有一些較大的建築，通常看起來相當簡約。

text: Unlike most houses in Greenland, the houses in Tiilerilaaq are commonly **grey** rather than colourful. The village can also be recognized by the ground, which is almost entirely made up of smooth, light grey rocks.
text_zh: 不同於格陵蘭的大多數房子，Tiilerilaaq 的房子通常是**灰色**而非色彩繽紛。這個村莊也可以透過幾乎完全由光滑淺灰色岩石組成的地面來辨識。

text: This boat, with a **white cabin** and a **red roof**, can be found by a multitude of towns and villages on the west coast. However, most of the coverage is in the general area around the city of Aasiaat.
text_zh: 這艘擁有**白色船艙**和**紅色屋頂**的船隻，可以在西海岸的多個城鎮和村莊附近找到。不過，大部分的街景覆蓋都在 Aasiaat 市周邊的一般區域。

text: A black and white boat, with a **blue roof**, is found between the towns of Kuummiit and Tasiilaq.
text_zh: 一艘黑白相間、配有**藍色屋頂**的船隻，出現在 Kuummiit 和 Tasiilaq 兩個城鎮之間。

text: The entire Google car is blurred, however an **antenna** at the front right and a tiny part of the **roof rack** can be seen.
NOTE: You will not see a roof rack on the Northern Mariana Islands Google car.
text_zh: 整輛 Google 車都有模糊處理，但在右前方可以看到一根**天線**以及**車頂架**的一小部分。
注意：在北馬利安納群島的 Google 車上你看不到車頂架。

text: LeoPalace Resort can be recognised by the white, resort buildings with **orange tiled roofs**, which looks superficially similar to tiled roofs found on [Java](https://goo.gl/maps/E6P4UxfQsHz8wZoe7).
text_zh: 李奧皇宮度假村可以透過帶有**橘色瓦片屋頂**的白色度假村建築來識別，這在表面上看起來類似[爪哇](https://goo.gl/maps/E6P4UxfQsHz8wZoe7)發現的瓦片屋頂。

text: This **grey** Street View car with a visible roof rack and side mirrors can be seen on all car coverage in Guatemala.

NOTE: The only other tropical country with a similar car is [Laos](https://maps.app.goo.gl/uMGhM4Th1yi9GsaT9). The car used in the [Dominican Republic](https://goo.gl/maps/Hjv6G6xFYJm1F38i6) may look similar, but has thick black stripes on the bars and the mirrors are not visible.
text_zh: 這輛車頂架和車側後視鏡清晰可見的**灰色** Google 車，可在瓜地馬拉的所有汽車覆蓋中看到。
注意：唯一擁有類似 Google 車的熱帶國家是[寮國](https://maps.app.goo.gl/uMGhM4Th1yi9GsaT9)。[多明尼加共和國](https://goo.gl/maps/Hjv6G6xFYJm1F38i6)使用的 Google 車看起來可能很相似，但橫桿上有粗黑條紋且後照鏡不可見。

text: Guatemalan architecture mainly consists of pastel painted stone houses, commonly with rusted sheet metal roofs. It is also somewhat common for buildings to be made out of exposed white brick.
text_zh: 瓜地馬拉的建築主要由漆成粉彩色的石屋組成，通常配有生鏽的金屬浪板屋頂。建築物使用外露的白磚也相當常見。

text: Honolulu, located on southern Oʻahu, is by far the **largest city** and urban area in Hawaii. If you are in a dense urban area and can see tall buildings, you will always be in or near Honolulu.
text_zh: 位於歐胡島南部的檀香山，是夏威夷迄今為止**最大城市**和都會區。如果你身處密集的都會區並能看到高樓大廈，你一定身處檀香山或其附近。

text: Towards the coasts of the island of Lānaʻi, hills dotted with **dry grass and shrubby vegetation** are commonly seen. These areas are very rural with few buildings.
text_zh: 朝著拉娜伊島的海岸前進，經常可以看到點綴著**乾草與灌木植被**的山丘。這些地區非常鄉村化，建築物很少。

text: Kahoʻolawe is a small island that lies just to the southwest of Maui. It only has **trekker** coverage on small gravel roads and dirt trails, and is characterised by dry, shrubby vegetation, rolling hills, and **dark red soil**. On the western end of this coverage, [several buildings](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YWKLmJiGrmEtBHTk9) can be seen.
text_zh: 卡胡奧拉韋島（Kahoʻolawe）是位於茂宜島（Maui）西南方的一座小島。它的小碎石路和泥土小徑只有**徒步拍攝**涵蓋，並以乾燥、灌木叢生的植被、起伏的山丘和**深紅色土壤**為特徵。在這個涵蓋範圍的西端，可以看到[數棟建築物](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YWKLmJiGrmEtBHTk9)。

text: There is also a plethora of rural locations that are harder to identify.

Outside the urban areas, Hong Kong is generally quite **mountainous**, with green, subtropical vegetation. There is extensive coverage in rural areas outside the city, with many roads going through the mountains. You might see low-rise rural buildings, however usually you will not need to travel far to see tall apartment blocks.
NOTE: Singapore, on the other hand, is very flat.
text_zh: 這裡也有大量較難辨識的鄉村地點。
在市區之外，香港通常相當**多山**，且擁有綠色的亞熱帶植被。市郊的鄉村地區有廣泛的街景涵蓋，許多道路穿梭於群山之間。你可能會看到低矮的鄉村建築，但通常不需要走太遠就能看到高聳的公寓大廈。
注意：相對地，新加坡非常平坦。

text: One very striking aspect of Hong Kong architecture are the many extremely **tall apartment buildings** found throughout the city.
NOTE: Apartment buildings in Singapore and Taiwan tend to be not nearly as tall as those in Hong Kong.
text_zh: 香港建築一個非常顯著的特色，是遍布全市、數量眾多且極其**高聳的公寓大樓**。
注意：新加坡和台灣的公寓大樓通常遠沒有香港的那麼高。

text: Hong Kong taxis come in two variants: sedans or station wagons, with the **sedans **most commonly seen. They can be easily identified by their silver roofs, green stickers on the front and rear bumper, and the taxi sign on the roof.

Red taxis are most common on Hong Kong Island and Kowloon, green taxis in the New Territories in the northern region and blue taxis on Lantau Island and Chek Lap Kok. Keep in mind, Hong Kong is a small city and taxis travel all around it.
text_zh: 香港計程車有兩種車型：轎車（sedan）或旅行車（station wagon），其中以**轎車**最為常見。它們的特徵很容易辨認：銀色車頂、前後保險桿上的綠色貼紙，以及車頂上的計程車招牌。
紅色的士（計程車）最常出現在香港島和九龍，綠色的士出現在北部地區的新界，藍色的士則出現在大嶼山和赤鱲角。請記住，香港是個小城市，計程車會開到各個地方。

text: Buses in Hong Kong are mostly **double-decker**, with various colour schemes and adverts on the side. Single-decker versions do exist, but are less common. Smaller minibuses can also be seen, with a green or red roof.
NOTE: Place names are sometimes visible on the front of the buses, which can be useful for region guessing.
Double-decker buses are also somewhat common in Singapore, but these will often have a recognizable light green colour scheme.
text_zh: 香港的公車大多是**雙層**公車，車身有各種配色和廣告。單層公車雖然存在，但較不常見。也可以看到車頂為綠色或紅色的較小型小巴。
NOTE: 地名有時會顯示在公車正面，這對地區猜測很有幫助。
雙層公車在新加坡也算常見，但這些公車通常會有容易辨識的淺綠色配色。

text: **Boxy **houses that are a few storeys high are a common sight in small villages, mostly to the north of Hong Kong.
text_zh: **方塊狀**、樓高數層的房屋在香港北部的小村莊中是很常見的景象。

text: Mong Kok and the surrounding districts in Kowloon can be recognized by the crowded, **busy, gridded streets**, with apartment blocks situated above the shops.
NOTE: These buildings are usually older, which means there will be a lack of glass walls (as opposed to parts of Hong Kong Island which feature more [glass](https://goo.gl/maps/hJJikEY7wqW8bii48)).
text_zh: 旺角及九龍周邊地區可以透過擁擠、**繁忙、棋盤狀的街道**來辨識，商店上方坐落著公寓大樓。
注意：這些建築通常較老舊，這意味著缺乏玻璃帷幕牆（與香港島部分地區擁有較多[玻璃](https://goo.gl/maps/hJJikEY7wqW8bii48)形成對比）。

text: The residential district of Quarry Bay has a lot of identical **white and brown** apartment blocks, and tall glass office buildings.
text_zh: 鰂魚涌住宅區有許多外觀相同的**棕白相間**公寓大樓，以及高聳的玻璃辦公大樓。

text: The residential district of Caribbean Coast and Tung Chung has **identical **apartment blocks that face the same direction, almost like a “wall” of buildings. There are a lot of planted palm trees in between and on the side of roads.
text_zh: 加州花園與東涌住宅區有朝向同一方向、**外觀相同**的公寓大樓，幾乎就像是一道建築「牆」。道路中間和兩側種植了許多棕櫚樹。

text: Lam Kam Road is similar to Fan Kam Road, however it runs in a more **east-west** direction. The road should also feel **busier **with more cars driving along the road and more houses on the sides of the road. In addition, the road is usually wider and a [median](https://goo.gl/maps/Yggjz9dCZCderyto9) containing trees can be seen separating sidewalks near the villages.
text_zh: 林錦公路與粉錦公路相似，但它的走向更偏**東西**方向。這條路應該會感覺**更繁忙**，沿途車輛更多，道路兩側的房子也更多。此外，道路通常較寬，且在村莊附近的人行道之間可以看到種有樹木的[分隔島](https://goo.gl/maps/Yggjz9dCZCderyto9)。

text: Between Hong Kong Island and Lantau Island, there are three unique islands: Peng Chau, Cheung Chau and Lamma Island, with **trekker **coverage. These islands can be identified by the **lack of cars**, narrow streets, and rural architecture. Lamma Island is also the hilliest of the three.
text_zh: 在香港島和大嶼山之間，有三座獨特的島嶼：坪洲、長洲和南丫島，設有**徒步拍攝**街景。這些島嶼的特徵是**沒有汽車**、狹窄的街道以及鄉村建築。南丫島也是三者中最多山的。

text: Hungarian houses are typically made of stone, painted in a light colour and almost always with **red tiled roofs**. Suburban houses are typically only one storeyed, while more central houses may be taller. Houses in town and city centres are often fairly old but well-kept.
text_zh: 匈牙利的房屋通常由石頭建造，漆成淺色，幾乎總是配有**紅色瓦屋頂**。郊區房屋通常只有一層樓，而較為中心的房屋可能會更高。城鎮和市中心的房屋通常相當古老但維護良好。

text: **Yellow tuk tuks** with **black roofs** are common in the southern Indian states of Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, and Tamil Nadu.
NOTE: They can also rarely be found [elsewhere](https://www.google.com/maps/@26.0016426,92.846562,3a,36.4y,218.5h,82.82t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sNm7a6dUzWhFoZT4TDVehnQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).
text_zh: **黃色嘟嘟車**配備**黑色車頂**，在印度南部的特倫 Telangana 邦、安 Andhra Pradesh 邦和 Tamil Nadu 邦很常見。
注意：它們在[其他地方](https://www.google.com/maps/@26.0016426,92.846562,3a,36.4y,218.5h,82.82t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sNm7a6dUzWhFoZT4TDVehnQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)也很少見。

text: **Rounded roof tiles** are common in central India. They often appear disorganised and are kept in rows/columns that are not completely straight.
text_zh: **圓形屋瓦**在中部印度很常見。它們通常顯得雜亂無章，並以不完全筆直的排/列存放。

text: Roofs in southern India are characterised by more organised tiles that are bright orange and flat with a ridge in the middle. It is particularly common in Tamil Nadu.
NOTE: Similarly shaped tiles with a darker brown colour are common further north.
text_zh: 印度南部的屋頂特徵是更有條理的瓦片，呈亮橘色且平坦，中間帶有脊。這在 Tamil Nadu 邦特別常見。
注意：形狀相似但呈較深棕色的瓦片在更北方的地區很常見。

text: Flat roof tiles, similar to the ones found in the south, with a small **diamond shaped protrusion** in the middle, are commonly found in and around West Bengal.
text_zh: 平屋頂瓦片類似於南部找到的瓦片，中間帶有一個小**菱形突起**，常見於西孟加拉邦及周邊地區。

text: Large [hip roofs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hip_roof) made of corrugated sheet metal are found in West Bengal and adjacent areas in Bihar and Odisha.
text_zh: 由瓦楞金屬板製成的大型[四坡屋頂](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hip_roof)見於西孟加拉邦以及比哈爾邦和奧里薩邦的鄰近地區。

text: Metal roofs, with a small triangle near the top, are common in Northeast India.
text_zh: 頂部附近帶有小三角形的金屬屋頂在印度東北部很常見。

text: Houses made of **square panels** separated by thin beams are found in Northeast India.
text_zh: 由細樑分隔的**方形面板**製成的房屋見於印度東北部。

text: Houses or huts with **thatched roofs** are mainly found along the east coast and northern plains. Large [hay mounds](https://goo.gl/maps/kzVojHKUKbsSn9hN7) are also generally more common in this region. Note that thatched roofs from Uttar Pradesh to Odisha tend to be made of [fine pieces of hay](https://goo.gl/maps/kzVojHKUKbsSn9hN7) whereas thatched roofs from Odisha to Tamil Nadu tend to be made of dried [palm fans](https://goo.gl/maps/JQrA1smY5vWAYjee9).
text_zh: 擁有**茅草屋頂**的房屋或小屋主要分佈在東海岸和北部平原。大型[乾草堆](https://goo.gl/maps/kzVojHKUKbsSn9hN7)在該地區也通常更常見。請注意，從北方邦到奧里薩邦的茅草屋頂往往由[細小的乾草塊](https://goo.gl/maps/kzVojHKUKbsSn9hN7)製成，而從奧里薩邦到 Tamil Nadu 邦的茅草屋頂往往由乾燥的[棕櫚扇葉](https://goo.gl/maps/JQrA1smY5vWAYjee9)製成。

text: **Black Taxis** with **yellow roofs** are found in Meghalaya and [Mumbai](https://goo.gl/maps/tWXnBGQDKaQm9Z3D9).
text_zh: 梅ઘ拉亞省與[孟買](https://goo.gl/maps/tWXnBGQDKaQm9Z3D9)可以見到車頂為**黃色**的**黑色計程車**。

text: The area on the border of Telangana and Karnataka often have houses with roofs made out of distinctly thin grey bricks. These grey bricks and similar coloured rocks are sometimes also seen in [walls](https://goo.gl/maps/WAmp1Zq1dGYBwaKN6) and scattered on the ground in [stockyards](https://goo.gl/maps/Kvsp5feEcroxZXNLA).
text_zh: 特倫加納省和卡納塔克省交界處的地區，房屋屋頂經常採用明顯纖薄的灰色磚塊。這些灰色磚塊和類似顏色的岩石有時也會出現在[牆壁](https://goo.gl/maps/WAmp1Zq1dGYBwaKN6)中，或散落在[堆場](https://goo.gl/maps/Kvsp5feEcroxZXNLA)的地面上。

text: You will usually find cream white buildings with black roofs in Ireland. Sometimes, the buildings feature grey corner stones. In cities, you will typically find row buildings.
NOTE: British style brick buildings can still be found in Ireland.
