text_zh: 在愛爾蘭，通常會看到奶油白色建築搭配黑色屋頂。有時，建築物會有灰色轉角石。在城市中，通常會看到連棟房屋。
注意：在愛爾蘭仍然可以找到英式風格的磚造建築。

text: Houses with **whitewashed walls** and **entrance walls** are a common sight, similar to Ireland.
text_zh: 像愛爾蘭一樣，有著**漆白牆面**與**入口牆**的房屋是常見的景象。

text: Douglas, the capital and **largest town** on the Isle of Man, can be recognized by the rows of **terraced houses**, with a higher population density.
text_zh: 都柏林是曼島的首府與**最大城鎮**，其特徵是成排的**連棟房屋**以及較高的人口密度。

text: Architecture tends to consist of bright and warm-coloured stone buildings, often with a blocky appearance. While Mediterranean-style houses with orange tiled roofs are more common than in other Middle Eastern countries, flat roofs are still just as common.
text_zh: 建築通常由明亮且暖色調的石質建築組成，外觀通常呈方塊狀。雖然地中海風格的紅瓦屋頂房屋比其他中東國家更常見，但平房依然同樣普遍。

text: The area west of Jerusalem can often look deceptively similar to northern Israel, with green forested hills and some agriculture sprinkled across the landscape.

Two things can occasionally be used to tell the two apart. Firstly, in northern Israel you may occasionally see wide, [flat valleys](https://goo.gl/maps/6TvF6u9qvM7ZGx2k8), while the Jerusalem area is always going to be hilly. Secondly, if you see houses made of [Jerusalem stone](https://goo.gl/maps/8QyM47Z1iwZCsiR9A), you are likely to be near Jerusalem.
text_zh: 耶路撒冷以西的地區看起來通常會與以色列北部有著欺騙性的相似，那裡有綠色的森林山丘，景觀中點綴著一些農業。
偶爾可以用兩件事來區分這兩者。首先，在以色列北部，你可能會偶爾看到寬闊的[平坦山谷](https://goo.gl/maps/6TvF6u9qvM7ZGx2k8)，而耶路撒冷地區則總是丘陵起伏。其次，如果你看到由[耶路撒冷石](https://goo.gl/maps/8QyM47Z1iwZCsiR9A)建造的房屋，你很可能就在耶路撒冷附近。

text: In Jerusalem and surrounding cities in the West Bank, nearly every building is built with the same type of material, called [Jerusalem stone](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jerusalem_stone). Beware that the stone will look [much smoother](https://goo.gl/maps/mXZoK6pDh3FiQcjE6) on newer buildings.
NOTE: Single houses with the same material can be found in other towns and cities.
text_zh: 在耶路撒冷和約旦河西岸的周邊城市，幾乎每棟建築都是用同一種名為[耶路撒冷石](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jerusalem_stone)的材料建造的。請注意，較新建築上的石材看起來會[光滑得多](https://goo.gl/maps/mXZoK6pDh3FiQcjE6)。
注意：在其他城鎮也可以找到使用相同材料的單棟房屋。

text: In the city of Ramallah you will generally see several **black water tanks** on most houses.

NOTE: Several other cities in both the [West Bank](https://goo.gl/maps/7Am2paYniAS5E67d8) and [Israel](https://goo.gl/maps/cRJcvcWMiSvRwLye9) can have black water tanks. What makes Ramallah stand out is the sheer number of them on most buildings.
text_zh: 在拉姆安拉市，你通常會在大多數房屋上看到幾個**黑色水塔**。
注意：在[約旦河西岸](https://goo.gl/maps/7Am2paYniAS5E67d8)和[以色列](https://goo.gl/maps/cRJcvcWMiSvRwLye9)的許多其他城市也有黑色水塔。讓拉姆安拉脫穎而出的是大多數建築物上水塔的數量極多。

text: Blue house numbers with the number written with [Arabic numerals](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arabic_numerals) in the top left and with [Eastern Arabic numerals](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eastern_Arabic_numerals) in the bottom right, with a thin **diagonal line** between them, can be found in Bethlehem. [Street signs](https://goo.gl/maps/eouNa6SnvDgD8WQr9) will generally have the same format.
text_zh: 藍色門牌號碼，左上角用[阿拉伯數字](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arabic_numerals)書寫，右下角用[東阿拉伯數字](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eastern_Arabic_numerals)書寫，兩者之間有一條細**斜線**，可以在伯利恆找到。[街道標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/eouNa6SnvDgD8WQr9)通常也會採用相同的格式。

text: House numbers in Rosh Haayin are blue, with a **G-clef** in the bottom left corner.
text_zh: 羅什阿因（Rosh Haayin）的門牌號碼是藍色的，左下角有一個**高音譜記號**（G-clef）。

text: In Ness Ziona, There is an **Israeli flag** on house numbers.
text_zh: 在尼斯錫安納（Ness Ziona），門牌號碼上有一個**以色列國旗**。

text: Blue, **shield-shaped house numbers** are unique to the city of Herzliya.
text_zh: 藍色、**盾形門牌號碼**是海爾茲利亞（Herzliya）市特有的。

text: Japanese architecture has many distinct and expressive styles, with many unique buildings. These can range from [traditional](https://goo.gl/maps/aUpwpwffnDBSAmHT6) country houses, regional designs, [modern](https://goo.gl/maps/zGecH29hE49UmfW57) large cities, [coastal](https://goo.gl/maps/EXtb15cfQano1fwK7) reinforced buildings, and anything in between.
_You can learn more about different types of architecture and styles in the region guessing section._
text_zh: 日本建築風格鮮明且變化豐富，從[傳統](https://goo.gl/maps/aUpwpwffnDBSAmHT6)鄉間民宅、各地特有樣式、[現代](https://goo.gl/maps/zGecH29hE49UmfW57)大城市建築，到[沿海](https://goo.gl/maps/EXtb15cfQano1fwK7)的強化結構建物，中間的各種型態都有。
_各種建築類型與風格的細節，可參考「都道府縣專屬線索」那一節。_

text: These unique **red-tiled** roofs are most commonly found in **Chugoku**, especially in the prefectures of Hiroshima and Shimane.
text_zh: 這種特殊的**紅瓦**屋頂以**中國地方**最常見，尤其是廣島縣與島根縣。

text: The further you are **north**, roofs generally transition from tiled to level or flat sloped in order to compensate for heavy snowfall. Northern houses often have **ladders** attached to the side, giving roof access to clear snow.
NOTE: In addition to north to south, high-elevation mountainous regions or high snowfall areas often use such roofs, even in more central or southern prefectures.
text_zh: 越往**北**，屋頂會從瓦片逐漸轉為平緩或平坦的形式，以因應大雪。北部住宅側面常裝有**梯子**，方便上屋頂剷雪。
註：除了南北差異之外，高海拔山區或多雪地帶也常用這種屋頂，即使位在中部或南部各縣。

text: Okinawa can often be recognised by the white concrete buildings with flat roofs.
text_zh: 沖繩通常可由白色混凝土平頂建築認出來。

text: You can find these ‘[Shisa](https://goo.gl/maps/q8uCFQh6YheQ7BdU8)’ guardian lions and house plaques with these [specific characters](https://goo.gl/maps/8sY6Txd3QyUTAKWG8) in Okinawa. The colour and shapes of both can vary.
text_zh: 沖繩可以看到這種[風獅爺](https://goo.gl/maps/q8uCFQh6YheQ7BdU8)（シーサー）鎮宅獸像，以及寫有[特定文字](https://goo.gl/maps/8sY6Txd3QyUTAKWG8)的門牌。兩者的顏色與造型都有變化。

text: Similarly, the local **architecture **shares many characteristics with that of northern France. This includes pastel-coloured walls and dark slate roofs. However, [British-style](https://goo.gl/maps/j6uEGrojSRmpRXPS8) terraced houses are also common.
text_zh: 同樣地，當地的**建築**與法國北部有許多共同特徵。這包括粉彩色的牆壁和深色石板屋頂。不過，[英式風格](https://goo.gl/maps/j6uEGrojSRmpRXPS8)的連棟房屋也很常見。

text: Jersey is home to large reserves of **red granite**. As a result, it is a popular building material used for the construction of many **walls **and houses throughout the island.
text_zh: 澤西島擁有大量的**紅色花崗岩**儲量。因此，它是島上許多**牆壁**和房屋建設常用的熱門建築材料。

text: Contrasting with the island’s typically rural look, the area surrounding the capital city of** St Helier** is more urbanised, featuring taller buildings, narrower streets and a more lively atmosphere.
text_zh: 與該島典型的鄉村風貌形成對比，首都**聖赫利爾**周邊地區更加都市化，擁有更高的建築、更窄的街道和更熱鬧的氣氛。

text: Most buildings in Jordan are made of **bright sandstone bricks** and have flat roofs.
NOTE: Similar sandstone bricks are also common in [Jerusalem](https://maps.app.goo.gl/asRSSgsgJHajzb9N6) and in [the West Bank](https://maps.app.goo.gl/MSSFNKXV4ux3cFhq8).
text_zh: 約旦的大多數建築物都由**明亮的砂岩磚**建造，並配有平屋頂。
註：類似的砂岩磚在[耶路撒冷](https://maps.app.goo.gl/asRSSgsgJHajzb9N6)和[約旦河西岸](https://maps.app.goo.gl/MSSFNKXV4ux3cFhq8)也很常見。

text: Street Signs in Kazakhstan are often attached to buildings and are **blue **in colour, with white intricate patterns on the top and bottom. They are usually **bilingual or trilingual** and can also contain a **QR code**.
NOTE: They are often inconsistent, with many designs being found in a single city.
text_zh: 哈薩克的路標通常固定在建築物上，呈**藍色**，頂部和底部有白色的複雜圖案。它們通常是**雙語或三語**的，並且可能包含 **QR 碼**。
注意：這些標誌通常很不一致，在同一個城市中可以找到許多不同的設計。

text: These are the most useful to learn bus stops.
- Atyrau has a **modern design**, with white and** lime/neon green** walls. The bus stop name is prominently written on top.
- Kostanay uses **simple brown bus stops**, that have a **blue and yellow crest** on one of the glass panes.
- Petropavl also has brown bus stops, with glass panes on all 3 sides not facing the road. The **roof is angled slightly upwards**.
- Karaganda uses old looking **turquoise** bus stops, which have a **curved roof**.
Zhezqazghan has **very wide blue bus stops**, which have **2 sections**; 1 indoors, and one outside. These sections are separated by a door.
text_zh: 這些是學習公車站牌最實用的部分。
- 阿特勞有一個**現代設計**的公車站，牆面為白色與**萊姆綠／霓虹綠**。公車站名稱顯眼地寫在頂部。
- 庫斯塔奈使用**簡單的棕色公車站**，其中一塊玻璃上有個**藍黃相間的徽章**。
- 彼得羅巴夫爾也有棕色公車站，背對馬路的 3 個側邊都有玻璃窗。**屋頂稍微向上傾斜**。
- 卡拉干達使用的是看起來很舊的**土耳其藍**公車站，帶有**弧形屋頂**。
傑茲卡茲甘有**非常寬敞的藍色公車站**，分為 **2 個部分**：1 個在室內，1 個在室外。這兩個部分由一扇門隔開。

text: These street signs attached to buildings are generally quite inconsistent, but there are some worth knowing.
- Aktobe has compact signs where half of the space is taken by the QR code.
- Petropavl uses white signs, with a blue semicircle below the street names.
- Astana consistently uses this fairly generic design.
- Zhetisay also uses a fairly generic design, but it is not found in Turkistan or Shymkent.
text_zh: 這些貼在建築物上的街道標示通常不太一致，但有些值得知道。
- 阿克托貝有精巧的標示，其中一半的空間被 QR 碼佔據。
- 彼得羅巴夫爾使用白色標示，街名下方有一個藍色半圓形。
- 阿斯塔納一直以來都使用這種相當通用的設計。
- 熱特阿賽（Zhetisay）也使用相當通用的設計，但在突厥斯坦或奇姆肯特找不到。

text: **Yellow boxes **connected to the gas pipes are common outside houses in Shymkent, Turkistan, and Taldykorgan.
text_zh: 奇姆肯特、突厥斯坦和塔爾迪庫爾干的房屋外牆常見連接瓦斯管線的**黃色箱子**。

text: Between Kokshetau and Atbasar, the car has a **thin coating of dirt** and dust, which is most visible near the back of the roof.
text_zh: 在科克舍套與阿特巴薩爾之間，Google 車上有一**層薄薄的泥土**與灰塵，在車頂後方特別明顯。

text: East of Aktobe, there is a **vertical line of dirt** on the right side of the roof.
text_zh: 阿克托貝以東，車頂右側有一條**垂直的泥土痕跡**。

text: Aberdare National Park** **has a **grey and brown** car that features a large snorkel. Almost all of the coverage is outside of the National Park, with only two roads within the park covered. The main road through the park has [these](https://goo.gl/maps/g4D2K3mtsHqrAwKr7) rubber bands on the roof rack, which can only be found in one other National Park in Kenya.
text_zh: 亞伯德爾國家公園有一輛**灰色和棕色**且配備大型進氣 snorkel 的車。幾乎所有的街景覆蓋都在國家公園外，公園內只有兩條道路有覆蓋。穿過公園的主幹道上車頂行李架有[這些](https://goo.gl/maps/g4D2K3mtsHqrAwKr7)橡皮筋，這點只能在肯亞的另一個國家公園找到。

text: Lake Issyk Kul is the **biggest body of water** in Kyrgyzstan. You will often be able to spot it on the roads north and south of the lake. Sometimes it will be obscured by buildings or trees, but the lack of any mountains in the direction of the lake will be a good clue.

NOTE: There are two other significant bodies of water that can be seen from the road: the [Toktogul Reservoir](https://goo.gl/maps/ay9ZJWwV3ZNPLviu6) and [Lake Song-Kul](https://goo.gl/maps/zgw4obnegxGGkWSPA). With a bit of practice, you can reliably distinguish these from Issyk Kul however.
text_zh: 伊塞克湖是吉爾吉斯 **最大的水體**。你經常可以在湖泊的南北兩側道路上看到它。有時它會被建築物或樹木遮擋，但朝著湖泊的方向沒有任何山脈會是一個很好的線索。
注意：從路上還可以看見另外兩個重要水體：[托克托古爾水庫](https://goo.gl/maps/ay9ZJWwV3ZNPLviu6)與[松湖](https://goo.gl/maps/zgw4obnegxGGkWSPA)。不過只要稍加練習，你就能穩妥地將它們與伊塞克湖區分開來。

text: As the capital city of Kyrgyzstan, Bishkek is by far the most developed city, featuring many taller **multi-story** buildings you would not see elsewhere. And on the outskirts, you can see [fancier buildings ](https://goo.gl/maps/xd7MyxMkqN71PgQs8)as well. There are also [mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/tJvLR8okRKxPUMvx6) south of Bishkek, but these can be hard to see at times.
text_zh: 作為吉爾吉斯的首都，比許凱克是遠比其他地方都還要開發的城市，擁有許多你在其他地方看不到的較高**多層**建築。而在市郊，你也可以看到[更高級的建築](https://goo.gl/maps/xd7MyxMkqN71PgQs8)。比許凱克南方也有[山脈](https://goo.gl/maps/tJvLR8okRKxPUMvx6)，但有時很難看清楚。

text: You can see the mostly **dried up** part of the Toktogul Reservoir either to the south or north of the road. There are taller mountains quite close on every side. The northern half is more desolate, while the south features more vegetation and buildings as well.
text_zh: 你可以在道路的南側或北側看到托克托古爾水庫（Toktogul Reservoir）大體上**乾涸**的部分。四面八方都有相當靠近的較高山脈。北半部更為荒涼，而南半部則有更多植被和建築物。

text: Once you get out of the valley, you will notice this area is **more vegetated**, has **more buildings**, and more animals on the now grassy fields. The landscape is still hilly, with bigger mountains to the north, south, and west. The southern mountains are especially distinct, with them being covered in snow. The hills immediately north of Naryn can get very dry, but look out for [snow](https://goo.gl/maps/E8fD9vJwmhoBrUfNA) that you can see in the shade.
text_zh: 一旦你走出了山谷，你會注意到這裡**植被更多**、**建築物更多**，且在現在長滿青草的原野上有更多動物。地貌依舊是丘陵起伏，北側、南側和西側都有更大的山脈。南側的山脈特別顯眼，上面覆蓋著白雪。納倫正北方的山丘會非常乾燥，但請留意你在陰影處可以看到的[雪](https://goo.gl/maps/E8fD9vJwmhoBrUfNA)。

text: This valley is **full of vegetation**. This area also has a lot of buildings and fences near the road. Most of the road is in poor shape, with it being unpaved and potholes littering parts of it. To the north, you can see some darker clouds, and closer to Arkit, the weather will get cloudier, and there are more dead trees.
The south to north driving direction on this road is worth noting.
text_zh: 這個山谷**充滿了植被**。這個地區在道路附近也有很多建築物和柵欄。大部分道路狀況不佳，為未鋪裝路面且部分路段佈滿坑洞。向北望去，你可以看到一些較暗的雲層，越接近阿爾基特（Arkit），天氣就會越陰沉，並且有更多枯樹。
這條路由南向北的行駛方向值得注意。

text: Street View coverage in Laos is very **limited**. Only five cities are covered: Vientiane, Vang Vieng, Luang Prabang, Savannakhet, and Pakse.
In addition, all coverage in Laos was taken by a Generation 3 camera.

All five cities have a distinct look and with some practise they are easily distinguishable from each other. The differences are discussed in more detail in the region-guessing section, but the summarized version is as follows:
- **Luang Prabang**: historical architecture, hills, palms
- **Vang Vieng**: distinct mountains
- **Vientiane**: no roof rack, large city
- **Savannakhet**: very flat
- **Pakse**: red soil, arid, hills
text_zh: 寮國的街景覆蓋非常**有限**。只有五個城市有覆蓋：永珍（Vientiane）、旺陽（Vang Vieng）、龍坡邦（Luang Prabang）、沙灣拿吉（Savannakhet）和巴色（Pakse）。
此外，寮國的所有覆蓋都是由第 3 相機世代拍攝的。
這五個城市都有獨特的外觀，經過一些練習後，它們很容易彼此區分。這些差異將在區域猜題部分進行更詳細的討論，但總結版本如下：
- **龍坡邦**：歷史建築、山丘、棕櫚樹
- **旺陽**：特異的山峰
- **永珍**：沒有車頂架、大城市
- **沙灣拿吉**：非常平坦
- **巴色**：紅土、乾旱、山丘

text: In all cities except for the capital, Vientiane, this Google car will be visible. It is silver-coloured, with a **roof rack** with two metal bars and black side mirrors.
NOTE: A similar car can be found in Guatemala, so be sure to look at the other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 除了首都永珍之外的所有城市，都可以看到這輛 Google 車。它是銀色的，配有一個帶有兩根金屬桿和黑色側視鏡的**車頂架**。
註記：瓜地馬拉也能找到類似的車輛，所以在猜測之前務必查看其他線索。

text: Luang Prabang is the former royal capital of Laos and a UNESCO heritage site. The city has a lot of **historical architecture**, including several [temples](https://goo.gl/maps/T4rVQMmiqkaFBLhy7). Many buildings make use of traditional [dark wooden](https://goo.gl/maps/E5rWvMQBr5MH7Ar86) architectural elements. There are also some buildings dating back to [French colonial](https://goo.gl/maps/G9NRBCbmvH6QVwem8) rule of Laos.
text_zh: 龍坡邦是寮國的前皇家首都和聯合國教科文組織遺產。該市擁有許多**歷史建築**，包括幾座[寺廟](https://goo.gl/maps/T4rVQMmiqkaFBLhy7)。許多建築物利用了傳統的[深色木造](https://goo.gl/maps/E5rWvMQBr5MH7Ar86)建築元素。也有一些可以追溯到[法國殖民](https://goo.gl/maps/G9NRBCbmvH6QVwem8)寮國統治時期的建築。

text: Vang Vieng is also very **touristic**: you will see a lot of signs for hotels, guesthouses, and other tourism-related enterprises. In the (very few) rounds that the distinct mountains are blocked by buildings, this is a good way to recognize the town.
text_zh: 旺陽也非常**觀光化**：你會看到大量關於飯店、民宿和其他旅遊相關企業的招牌。在特異山脈被建築物擋住的（極少數）回合中，這是識別該城鎮的好方法。

text: Latvian house numbers are often shaped like **tall rectangles** and can be found in [several colours](https://www.google.com/maps/@56.6568307,23.7457261,3a,15y,38.74h,91.25t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sP7bXCAylAr5ghFSDKp9l1g!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu).
NOTE: This is not common in Estonia or Lithuania.
text_zh: 拉脫維亞的門牌號碼通常形狀像**高矩形**，並且有[多種顏色](https://www.google.com/maps/@56.6568307,23.7457261,3a,15y,38.74h,91.25t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sP7bXCAylAr5ghFSDKp9l1g!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)。
注意：這在愛沙尼亞或立陶宛並不常見。

text: Latvian architecture generally consists of a combination of **wood** and **white brick**, typically with somewhat steep **corrugated metal roofs**. Slightly modern houses with **pastel coloured stone walls** and houses with a combination of wood with another material, particularly white brick, are also common.
text_zh: 拉脫維亞的建築通常結合了**木材**與**白磚**，一般搭配稍微陡峭的**波浪鐵皮屋頂**。帶有**粉彩色石牆**的微現代房屋，以及結合木材與其他材料（特別是白磚）的房屋也很常見。

text: The historic downtown area of Riga is characterised by majestic [**art nouveau**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Art_Nouveau)** architecture**, that is in places reminiscent of the architecture in Vienna. This is unique within Latvia, and even within the entire Baltics.
text_zh: 里加的歷史市中心區以雄偉的[**新藝術運動**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Art_Nouveau)**建築**為特徵，某些地方讓人想起維也納的建築。這在拉脫維亞乃至整個波羅的海地區都是獨一無二的。

text: While several types of architecture can be found on the Lebanese coverage, it is worth mentioning that many buildings are made of **sandstone bricks**.

NOTE: These bricks often look very similar to [Jerusalem stone](https://www.google.com/maps/@31.8956347,35.198306,3a,75y,245.85h,124.16t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s21rJNnw9rW4MmPpgX4NHNw!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu), commonly found in Israel and the West Bank.
text_zh: 雖然在黎巴嫩的街景中可以發現多種建築風格，但值得一提的是，許多建築都是由**砂岩磚**建造的。
NOTE: 這些磚塊通常看起來非常像[耶路撒冷石](https://www.google.com/maps/@31.8956347,35.198306,3a,75y,245.85h,124.16t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s21rJNnw9rW4MmPpgX4NHNw!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)，這種石頭常見於以色列與約旦河西岸。

text: Beirut is the capital of Lebanon and the only covered city with many modern **high-rise buildings**. While the city might not be clearly visible from all parts of the coverage, you will almost always be able to see urban [buildings](https://goo.gl/maps/QbcXbyAKVZ5qwiFW6) or [infrastructure](https://goo.gl/maps/uLp9kfysBxmAr5Db9) in the background.
text_zh: 貝魯特是黎巴嫩的首都，也是唯一擁有許多現代**高樓大廈**的有覆蓋城市。雖然從街景的各個角度可能無法看得非常清楚，但你幾乎總是能在背景中看到都市[建築](https://goo.gl/maps/QbcXbyAKVZ5qwiFW6)或[基礎設施](https://goo.gl/maps/uLp9kfysBxmAr5Db9)。

text: Université Saint Joseph, southeast of central Beirut can be recognised by the old, **grand-looking** **sandstone building**.
text_zh: 位於貝魯特市中心東南方的聖若瑟大學可以透過古老、**宏偉的砂岩建築**來辨識。

text: Campus Debbieh of the Beirut Arab University consists of somewhat sparsely built large **modern sandstone buildings** on top of a forested hill. [The ocean](https://goo.gl/maps/JABVUYU4L9Zztrxm8) can typically be seen far away to the west.
text_zh: 阿拉伯貝魯特大學的德比亞校區由位於森林山丘頂部的、稀疏分佈的大型**現代砂岩建築**組成。[海洋](https://goo.gl/maps/JABVUYU4L9Zztrxm8)通常可以在遠處的西方看見。

text: The Lebanese International University (LIU) can be recognised by the many large stone buildings having unpainted bottom floors while the floors above are painted beige.
text_zh: 黎巴嫩國際大學（LIU）可以透過許多大型石造建築來辨識，其底樓未上漆，而上層則漆成米色。

text: The University of Balamand has a lot of modern **white painted buildings**. The buildings often have a very cubic look.
text_zh: 巴拉曼大學有許多現代的**白色漆面建築**。這些建築通常具有非常方正的外觀。

text: The Lebanese American University, east of Byblos, has a very **urban look**, with a lot of construction work and large modern buildings.
text_zh: 位於比布魯斯以東的黎巴嫩美國大學具有非常**都市化的外觀**，有大量的施工工程和大型現代建築。

text: The ancient city of Byblos is one of the oldest cities in the world and can be recognised by the many **old historical buildings**, almost all built out of the same type of unpainted stone bricks.
text_zh: 古城比布魯斯是世界上最古老的城市之一，可以透過許多**古老的歷史建築**來辨識，幾乎全部都是用同一種未上漆的石磚建造的。

text: In rural areas, you will often see traditional **round huts** with thatched roofs.
NOTE: These are less common in the other four southern African countries, but can still be seen.
text_zh: 在鄉村地區，你經常會看到帶有茅草屋頂的傳統**圓形小屋**。
注意：這些在其他四個南部非洲國家較少見，但仍然看得到。

text: Architecture in Liechtenstein is a blend of traditional Alpine styles and more modern buildings, especially in the bigger cities.
text_zh: 列支敦斯登的建築融合了傳統阿爾卑斯風格與更現代的建築，特別是在較大的城市中。

text: Lithuanian architecture primarily consists of light coloured brick buildings, usually with somewhat steep corrugated metal roofs. Wooden buildings are also fairly common, however less so than in Estonia. Pastel painted stone buildings are somewhat common, especially in newer suburbs.
text_zh: 立陶宛的建築主要由淺色磚造建築組成，通常搭配稍微陡峭的波浪狀金屬屋頂。木造建築也相當常見，但比愛沙尼亞少。漆成粉色調的石造建築也蠻常見的，特別是在較新的郊區。

text: Lithuania's **historical state flag**, known as the _Vytis_, depicts a mounted knight on a dark red background. It can sometimes be seen on both private and public buildings.
text_zh: 立陶宛的**歷史國旗**（又稱 _Vytis_）描繪了紅底背景上的騎馬騎士。有時可以在私人和公共建築上看到它。

text: On the Curonian Spit you can also find wooden, and often red, **Scandinavian looking houses**.
text_zh: 在庫爾斯沙嘴上，你還可以找到木造且通常是紅色的**斯堪地那維亞風格房屋**。

text: Houses tend to have **dark slate roofs**.
Walls and windows tend to be plain and undecorated. Walls are usually painted white, grey, or pastel colours.
NOTE: Such architecture can also be found in the surrounding regions in Belgium and France, but is especially prominent in Luxembourg.
text_zh: 房屋通常有**深色板岩屋頂**。
牆壁和窗戶通常樸素且沒有裝飾。牆壁通常漆成白色、灰色或粉彩色。
注意：這種建築風格也可以在比利時和法國的周邊地區找到，但在盧森堡尤為顯著。

text: **Dense** apartment buildings with gridded, **narrow streets** and cars parked on both sides can be found in this region in the northern half of Macau.
text_zh: 在這個位於澳門北部半部的地區，可以找到網格狀、**狹窄街道**且兩側停滿車輛的**密集**公寓大樓。

text: A **hilly,** **rural** region of Macau can be found in the south. Roads are narrow, winding up hills with trees on both sides. A helpful clue are the lamp posts, which are commonly seen.

When this area appears in a world map, it can be confusing to newer players, as there are very few language or architecture clues available. The washed out early Generation 2 coverage can help with identifying it as being located in Macau.
text_zh: 在澳門南部可以找到一個**多山、** **鄉村風情**的地區。道路狹窄，蜿蜒上山，兩側都是樹木。一個有用的線索是經常可以看到的燈柱。
當這個地區出現在世界地圖上時，對於新玩家來說可能會感到困惑，因為可用的語言或建築線索非常少。早期褪色的第 2 代覆蓋可以幫助辨識其位於澳門。

text: The coverage on the RN8 between Andriamena and Marofandilia can easily be recognized by the large **silver roof rack** on the Street View car. The coverage is very dry and sandy.
text_zh: Andriamena 和 Marofandilia 之間的 RN8 公路上的覆蓋可以輕易透過街景車上大型的**銀色車頂行李架**來辨識。該覆蓋非常乾燥且多沙。

text: A car with a barely visible **grey metal roof rack** can be seen by Manahy. There are some locations where the car is completely [blurred out](https://www.google.com/maps/@-20.8635885,43.9144054,2a,75y,201.67h,54.09t,3.83r/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sPAQm9O3ZuaHG6QXKk1Yzfg!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3DPAQm9O3ZuaHG6QXKk1Yzfg%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D280%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i13312!8i6656), where the shape of the blur is the best indication of the area.
text_zh: 在馬納希（Manahy）附近可以看到一輛車頂行李架幾乎看不見的**灰色金屬車頂行李架**的汽車。有些地方車子被完全[模糊處理](https://www.google.com/maps/@-20.8635885,43.9144054,2a,75y,201.67h,54.09t,3.83r/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sPAQm9O3ZuaHG6QXKk1Yzfg!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3DPAQm9O3ZuaHG6QXKk1Yzfg%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D280%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i13312!8i6656)，此時模糊的形狀是該地區的最佳指示。

text: Houses are mainly painted white, grey, or pastel colours such as yellow and pink. In addition, the red tile roofs will often be in a good condition.
text_zh: 房屋主要漆成白色、灰色，或是黃色和粉紅色等粉彩色調。此外，紅瓦屋頂通常狀況良好。

text: Almost all the tripods focus on showing **historical mosques**. These tripods usually have an indoor part and an exterior part, which are sometimes not connected to each other.

These mosques have a recognizable look: they are made out of **mud bricks and adobe plaster**. The walls of the buildings are decorated with wooden sticks. Inside, you will usually see the same adobe walls, and prayer rugs on the floor.
text_zh: 幾乎所有的三腳架都聚焦在展示**歷史清真寺**。這些三腳架通常有室內部分和室外部分，有時彼此並不相連。
這些清真寺有一個好辨認的外觀：它們是由**泥磚和土坯**製成的。建築物的牆壁用木棍裝飾。在內部，你通常會看到相同的土坯牆，以及地板上的禱告毯。

text: The roads around the Sidi Yahiya mosque are a mixture of sand and **tiles** shaped like **slices of bread**, which within Mali, is unique to this coverage.

The surrounding buildings are mostly built of bricks having a peachy orange colour with a brown undertone. This can also be found around the other two mosques with coverage in Timbuktu. The area generally looks [busier](https://goo.gl/maps/Pn2Gdp6uaHQPm21Y6) than around the Djingareyber mosque.
text_zh: 西迪·葉海亞清真寺周圍的道路是沙子與形狀像**切片麵包**的**地磚**之混合，這在馬利境內是此街景獨有的。
周圍的建築大多由帶有棕色調的蜜桃橘色磚塊建成。這也可以在廷巴克圖另外兩座有街景的清真寺周圍找到。該地區通常看起來比丁加雷貝爾清真寺周圍[更熱鬧](https://goo.gl/maps/Pn2Gdp6uaHQPm21Y6)。

text: Coverage outside of the Djingareyber mosque in Timbuktu features brick buildings and a paved street with **rectangular** tiles.
text_zh: 廷巴克圖丁加雷貝爾清真寺外的街景以磚造建築和鋪有**長方形**地磚的街道為特色。

text: The inside of the Gao mosque consists of undecorated corridors with **low roofs**. You can see the **pyramid shaped structure**, with a very large number of dry branches sticking out of it, from the courtyard.
text_zh: 加奧清真寺內部由沒有裝飾、**低屋頂**的走廊組成。你可以從中庭看到**金字塔形結構**，上面有非常大量的乾樹枝突出。

text: The Djenné mosque has a very recognizable front, with some distant trees and a **clear sky**. The mosque is surrounded by low houses, making the area look fairly open.
text_zh: 傑內清真寺有一個非常好辨認的正面，配上一些遠處的樹木和**晴朗的天空**。清真寺周圍環繞著低矮的房屋，使得該區域看起來相當開闊。

text: The interior of the Djenné mosque is quite dark, with a high roof and narrow corridors with **gothic arches**. There is also a large courtyard with sandy ground and brown wooden doors along the walls.
text_zh: 傑內清真寺的內部相當昏暗，擁有高屋頂和帶有**哥德式拱門**的狹窄走廊。這裡還有一個帶有沙質地面以及沿牆排列著棕色木門的大型中庭。

text: The interior of the Mopti mosque can be recognised by the somewhat **open space,** with a high roof, no arches, and a blue carpet across the entire floor.
text_zh: 莫普提清真寺的內部可以透過帶有高屋頂、沒有拱門、且整片地板鋪上藍色地毯的**開闊空間**來辨識。

text: The vast majority of buildings in Malta consist of low storey buildings, with **white to beige** coloured walls. Buildings made of [limestone](https://maps.app.goo.gl/BMSfQdQ7rujtEErg8#extra%5Btags%5D=yes) are also fairly common.
text_zh: 馬爾他絕大多數的建築都是低樓層建築，牆壁顏色從**白色到米色**不等。由[石灰岩](https://maps.app.goo.gl/BMSfQdQ7rujtEErg8#extra%5Btags%5D=yes)製成的建築也相當常見。

text: This style of traditional **covered balconies** is very common on Maltese buildings. They are often painted in bright colours.
text_zh: 這種傳統的**加蓋陽台**風格在馬爾他建築中非常常見。它們經常被漆成明亮的顏色。

text: The **coastal southern trekker** can be recognized by a few unique things:
- [In the north](https://goo.gl/maps/pApNFF5yFbPfWrry5), the trekker starts off walking on a slightly hilly path, with other people.
- [Several houses](https://goo.gl/maps/XxD6aTzoBNrF5qPF9) with orange roofs can be seen.
- [A flatter and more open path](https://goo.gl/maps/DGkgXWthbCLEnskA7) can be seen, with the ocean slightly visible through the trees.
- [The coverage ends in the south](https://goo.gl/maps/9DxD1KWqV83XHPzh7) with a car park and some stalls.
text_zh: **南部沿海徒步拍攝**可以透過幾件獨特的事情來辨識：
- [在北部](https://goo.gl/maps/pApNFF5yFbPfWrry5)，徒步拍攝一開始是走在稍微起伏的小徑上，旁邊有其他人。
- 可以看到[幾棟](https://goo.gl/maps/XxD6aTzoBNrF5qPF9)有橘色屋頂的房子。
- 可以看到[一條更平坦、更開闊的小徑](https://goo.gl/maps/DGkgXWthbCLEnskA7)，透過樹木隱約能看到海洋。
- [覆蓋在南部結束](https://goo.gl/maps/9DxD1KWqV83XHPzh7)，有一個停車場和一些攤位。

text: **Red brick** buildings are mostly concentrated in the states west of Mexico City, specifically Jalisco, Michoacan, Guanajuato, and Aguascalientes.
text_zh: **紅磚**建築主要集中在墨西哥城以西的州，特別是哈利斯科州、米卻肯州、瓜納華托州和阿瓜斯卡連特斯州。

text: **White concrete block **buildings are highly concentrated in the states surrounding Mexico city, and are generally more common to the east. They can however still be found all over the country.
text_zh: **白色混凝土磚**建築高度集中在墨西哥城周圍的州，且通常在東部更常見。不過，它們在全國各地仍然可以找到。

text: **Mud brick** buildings are most abundant in Durango, especially full houses constructed with mud brick. However, they can essentially be found in almost all of the dry desert states.
text_zh: **土磚**建築在杜蘭戈州最為豐富，特別是用土磚建造的完整房屋。然而，它們基本上可以在幾乎所有乾燥的沙漠州找到。

text: Architecture in northern Mexico often features design elements from American style bungalows. Many houses are coloured with **light **or **pastel **colours, **gated **and commonly have front yards. **Orange tiles** inspired by Spanish colonial architecture are also typical.
text_zh: 墨西哥北部的建築通常具有美式平房風格的設計元素。許多房屋漆成**淺色**或**粉彩色**，有**圍欄**且通常有前院。受西班牙殖民建築啟發的**橘色瓦片**也很典型。

text: **Thatched roofs** are most common in the Yucatan peninsula and eastern San Luis Potosi. They can also be found elsewhere, mainly in the southeast.
text_zh: **茅草屋頂**最常見於猶加敦半島和聖路易波托西州東部。它們也能在其他地方找到，主要在東南部。

text: This **red **Street View car with a black roof can be found in the town of La Seca in Sinaloa.
text_zh: 這輛有著黑色車頂的**紅色 **Google 車可以在 Sinaloa 的 La Seca 鎮找到。

text: Monaco is a **rich** and **densely populated** city state, with a Mediterranean feel to it. The architecture is similar to cities in southern France and northern Italy, but more luxurious. You will see a lot of apartment buildings, neoclassical details, and pastel colours. There are essentially no rural areas.
text_zh: 摩納哥是一個**富有**且**人口稠密**的城邦，帶有地中海風情。其建築類似於法國南部和義大利北部的城市，但更加豪華。你會看到大量的公寓大樓、新古典主義細節和粉彩色調。這裡基本上沒有鄉村地區。

text: Mongolia very often has a visible Street View car as all of Mongolian coverage was driven with a large pickup truck. The truck can have several features such as a **tent **on top, **red** **side-view mirrors**, a **snorkel,** and **roof-racks.** All of these can be of help in identifying Mongolia.
text_zh: 蒙古經常可以看到 Google 車，因為所有蒙古的街景都是用大型皮卡車拍攝的。這台卡車可能有幾個特徵，例如頂部的**帳篷**、**紅色**的**車側後視鏡**、**呼吸管**以及**車頂架**。所有這些都有助於識別蒙古。

text: The capital city, Ulaanbaatar, is by far the biggest city in Mongolia, with about 50% of the entire country's population living in it. As such, its urban development and sheer size is unlike anywhere else in Mongolia. The cityscape is bustling with many **high rise buildings**, chain stores, travelling cars, buses, and pedestrians, as well as clean roads and sidewalks. Meanwhile, the suburbs can be recognized from the [vast yurt districts](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.9272927,107.008841,3a,29.5y,301.6h,86.46t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sYXiArLUQKXIXelnn6G9MXQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) in **hilly areas**. Generation 4 coverage is common, however Generation 3 [winter coverage](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.809762,107.161727,3a,133.2y,242.8h,87.43t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sR3u-gHu194XNWIm0UrWpZw!2e0) is also common to see in the suburbs.
text_zh: 首都烏蘭巴托是蒙古絕對最大的城市，全國約有 50% 的人口居住於此。因此，它的都市發展和規模是蒙古其他地方無法比擬的。市容繁華，有許多**高樓大廈**、連鎖店、行駛的汽車、公車和行人，以及乾淨的道路和人行道。同時，郊區可以從**丘陵地區**的[廣闊蒙古包區](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.9272927,107.008841,3a,29.5y,301.6h,86.46t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sYXiArLUQKXIXelnn6G9MXQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)中辨認出來。第四代街景很常見，但第三代[冬季街景](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.809762,107.161727,3a,133.2y,242.8h,87.43t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sR3u-gHu194XNWIm0UrWpZw!2e0)在郊區也很常見。

text: The roof racks of the Street View car are very useful as they can effectively split Mongolia in half. The presence of **rubber inlays** in the roof racks are generally found in the **west**, while **empty roof racks** are generally found in the **east**.
_You can click on the map to enlarge it._
text_zh: Google 車的車頂架非常有用，因為它們可以有效地將蒙古一分為二。車頂架上有**橡膠嵌件**的通常在**西方**，而**空車頂架**通常在**東方**。
_你可以點擊地圖來放大它。_

text: The eastern region can be further divided into several smaller areas based on the layout of the **orange** **roof rack straps**. These straps can be seen by looking straight down.
NOTE: Orange straps can be found in the west as well, this tip is only useful for the eastern car with a blue tent from the previous tip.
_You can click on the map to enlarge it._
text_zh: 根據**橘色**車頂架固定帶的配置，東部地區還可以進一步劃分為幾個較小的區域。直視下方就能看到這些固定帶。
注意：西方也會出現橘色固定帶，這個小技巧僅適用於前一個小技巧中配有藍色帳篷的東部車輛。
_你可以點擊地圖來放大它。_

text: A Street View car with a **cage** on top of the roof instead of a tent can be seen near Ulaanbaatar. West of Ulaanbaatar, the car will have a [green camouflage sleeping bag](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.8967631,105.5177786,3a,31.5y,232.36h,46.83t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1ssX7pU24XafLnwz2a_NC7ug!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) on top of the cage (coverage highlighted in green). Additionally, all coverage with this car was taken during winter, with most of it being in snowy areas.

NOTE: The cage car can very rarely appear in [Kharkhorin](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.1827252,102.803768,2a,90y,224.36h,85.24t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sap6SFr1Io_8pnFMafcbQ-g!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) and [Zuunmod](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.687993,106.94846,3a,133.2y,9.2h,93.60t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sPDrz82bCouVh_PsjAk81QQ!2e0).
text_zh: 車頂上方沒有帳篷而是放了個**鐵籠**的 Google 車可以在烏蘭巴托附近看到。在烏蘭巴托西方，該車的鐵籠上方會放一個[綠色迷彩睡袋](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.8967631,105.5177786,3a,31.5y,232.36h,46.83t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1ssX7pU24XafLnwz2a_NC7ug!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)（街景以綠色突顯）。此外，這輛車的所有街景都是在冬季拍攝的，大部分位於積雪地區。

注意：鐵籠車非常罕見地會出現在[哈拉和林](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.1827252,102.803768,2a,90y,224.36h,85.24t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sap6SFr1Io_8pnFMafcbQ-g!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)與[宗莫德](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.687993,106.94846,3a,133.2y,9.2h,93.60t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sPDrz82bCouVh_PsjAk81QQ!2e0)。

text: Generation 4 coverage in the capital uses a** **silver truck with an **ornate blue & white** **roof decal**, with a snorkel and long antenna on the front right. While the unique roof can be seen in most locations, [some locations](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.04911,107.027365,3a,78.8y,18.0h,81.16t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1spjnBE5kV7HOlw2xVG93ytQ!2e0) blur most of the car, leaving only the snorkel and antenna visible. This car can only be found **around Ulaanbaatar**.
text_zh: 首都的第 4 代街景使用**銀色卡車，車頂貼有華麗的藍白相間貼紙**，右前方配有呼吸管和長天線。雖然獨特的車頂裝飾在多數地點都看得到，但[部分地點](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.04911,107.027365,3a,78.8y,18.0h,81.16t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1spjnBE5kV7HOlw2xVG93ytQ!2e0)會將車身大部分模糊處理，只剩下呼吸管和天線清晰可見。這輛車只能在**烏蘭巴托周邊**找到。

text: Generation 4 coverage in **eastern Mongolia** uses a silver pick-up truck with a large **metal box **and shovel on the roof. The car was sponsored by Bodi Group, however camera stitching generally hides one of the letters.
text_zh: **蒙古東部**的第 4 代街景使用銀色小貨卡，車頂上有一個**大金屬箱**和圓鍬。這輛車是由 Bodi Group 贊助的，不過相機拼接通常會遮住其中一個字母。

text: Erdenet is the second largest city in Mongolia. As such, it has many multistory buildings that can be seen from across town, a large stadium, and a **ferris wheel** in the south of the city. It is surrounded by large barren hills to the south and to the north, and was covered on a **cloudy day **in the** winter**, meaning all vegetation is dead.

NOTE: Erdenet can look very similar to Darkhan and Ulaanbaatar, but the lack of snow distinguishes it from [Darkhan](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zbywjh1bcnq3uP4B6), while the cloudy skies and lack of rubber inlays on the roof racks can be used to distinguish it from [Ulaanbaatar](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Zkw6E7f774cDFPj59).
text_zh: 額爾登特是蒙古第二大城。因此，它有許多從城鎮各處都能看見的多層樓建築、大型體育場，以及位於該市南方的**摩天輪**。城鎮南北兩側都被大型的貧瘠丘陵環繞，拍攝時正逢**冬季的陰天**，意味著所有植被都已枯死。
注意：額爾登特看起來可能非常像達爾漢和烏蘭巴托，但沒有積雪這點可以將它與[達爾漢](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zbywjh1bcnq3uP4B6)區分開來，而陰暗的天空以及車頂架上沒有橡膠嵌件，則可以用來將它與[烏蘭巴托](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Zkw6E7f774cDFPj59)區分開來。

text: The city of Darkhan in northern Mongolia can be recognized by its distinct **snow coverage**. It is the third largest city in Mongolia and as such has many high-rising buildings and travelling cars.

NOTE: Other smaller towns can also have snow coverage but Darkhan is the only large city in Mongolia with snow coverage, apart from some [Ulaanbaatar suburbs](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.066512,106.883211,3a,133.2y,313.2h,92.32t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1si8RI0T_bQ1km7-FMfeqK2w!2e0).
text_zh: 位於蒙古北方的達爾漢市可以透過其明顯的**雪地街景**來辨識。它是蒙古第三大城，因此有許多高樓大廈和行駛中的車輛。
注意：其他較小的城鎮也可能有雪地街景，但達爾漢是蒙古除了某些[烏蘭巴托郊區](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.066512,106.883211,3a,133.2y,313.2h,92.32t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1si8RI0T_bQ1km7-FMfeqK2w!2e0)之外，唯一擁有雪地街景的大城市。

text: Baruun-Urt can be identified by the** towering building under construction** in the centre of town (on the map its POI is called “Smile”) combined with the dry landscape.
NOTE: Similar buildings under construction can be found in other towns such as Chinggis but they are not as large and do not feature an** **orange tower crane like the Smile building.
text_zh: 巴倫烏爾特可以透過鎮中心**正在興建的高樓**（在地圖上的地標稱為「Smile」）結合乾燥的地形來辨識。
注意：在其他城鎮（如成吉思市）也能找到類似的在建大樓，但它們沒那麼大，也沒有像 Smile 大樓那樣的**橘色塔式起重機**。

text: Sainshand is the largest town in the desert region and it has a dry climate, many buildings, and paved roads. A **dry ridge** separates the northern and southern parts of the town, distinguishing Sainshand from other desert towns that are mostly flat. In the downtown area you can find a miniature [pink eiffel tower](https://www.google.com/maps/@44.8922678,110.138733,3a,90y,124.45h,93.67t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s1HmF0u7fsDOuxWWcAchIIA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).
text_zh: 賽音山達（Sainshand）是沙漠地區最大的城鎮，擁有乾燥的氣候、許多建築物和鋪面道路。一條**乾燥的山脊**將城鎮的南北兩側分隔開來，這點讓賽音山達有別於其他多數平坦的沙漠城鎮。在市中心可以找到一座縮小版的[粉紅艾菲爾鐵塔](https://www.google.com/maps/@44.8922678,110.138733,3a,90y,124.45h,93.67t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s1HmF0u7fsDOuxWWcAchIIA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)。

text: In the westmost part of Mongolia, there is some very remote coverage showcasing the tallest mountains in Mongolia where you can see glaciers and **snow-capped peaks**. This area also has a unique Street View car with a green or black bag above the right side roof racks.
text_zh: 在蒙古的最西部，有一些非常偏遠的街景覆蓋，展示了蒙古最高的山峰，你可以看到冰川和**雪山山頂**。這個地區還有一輛獨特的 Google 車，右側車頂行李架上方有一個綠色或黑色的袋子。

text: Namibia used to be a German colony, and as such, you can still notice the German influence, most notably in their place names. Some older buildings can have a German style as well.
text_zh: 納米比亞曾是德國殖民地，因此你仍然可以注意到德國的影響，在地名中最為顯著。一些較舊的建築也可能帶有德國風格。

text: Windhoek is by far the largest city in Namibia, as well as the richest, with many [high rise buildings](https://maps.app.goo.gl/2FUr1J4JEF7QN7D96) near downtown. Affluent and often gated single family houses are a common sight on the sides of hilly streets, which are often well marked with simple white street signs.
In the northwest of the city you’ll find the [slums ](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SfddeDfHCm1tL2Ds6)dotting the hills.
text_zh: 溫荷克 (Windhoek) 是納米比亞最大且最富裕的城市，市中心附近有許多[高樓大廈](https://maps.app.goo.gl/2FUr1J4JEF7QN7D96)。山坡街道兩旁常見到富裕且通常有圍牆的獨棟住宅，這些街道通常標示明確，配有簡單的白色路名牌。
在該市的西北部，你會發現[貧民窟](https://maps.app.goo.gl/SfddeDfHCm1tL2Ds6)散布在山丘上。

text: While not as common, the same thatched architecture is present in Noordoewer, and unlike Aussenkehr, the town was built on flat land, with an [imposing cliffside](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JqoV8nVjpTkh3oq89) visible to the southwest, across the border in South Africa. Similar mountains can be seen to the north as well.
text_zh: 雖然沒那麼常見，但諾爾杜弗（Noordoewer）也有相同的茅草建築，與奧森凱爾不同的是，該城鎮建在平地上，向西南方望去across the border可見[雄偉的懸崖邊緣](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JqoV8nVjpTkh3oq89)，位於南非境內。向北也能看到類似的山脈。

text: Most buildings are either colorful blocky multi-story structures or small houses with painted concrete, red brick, or thatched looking walls, with either a tiled or tin roof. As part of the building facade, you will often spot [triangle shaped decorations](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YV9ysBvzpGBpQdwJ9).
text_zh: 大多數建築物不是色彩繽紛、呈方塊狀的多層結構，就是塗漆水泥、紅磚或茅草般外牆的小房子，並搭配磁磚或鐵皮屋頂。作為建築立面的一部分，你經常會發現[三角形裝飾](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YV9ysBvzpGBpQdwJ9)。

text: **Rounded roof tiles** are most common in the flat regions south of Kathmandu, but are also prevalent further west.
NOTE: Don’t mix this up with the [half-rounded tiles](https://maps.app.goo.gl/4WMe1LBb2TXwU1Za6), which are part of the hint below this.
text_zh: **圓形屋頂瓦片**在加德滿都以南的平原地區最為常見，但也盛行於更西邊的地區。
注意：不要把它跟[半圓形瓦片](https://maps.app.goo.gl/4WMe1LBb2TXwU1Za6)搞混了，後者是下方提示的一部分。

text: West Bengal style roof tiles, which are more organised and have small **diamond shaped protrusions**, are most common in the far west flat region. This hint also works for the [half-rounded tiles](https://maps.app.goo.gl/4WMe1LBb2TXwU1Za6).
text_zh: 西孟加拉風格的屋頂瓦片更有條理且帶有小型**菱形突起**，在極西部的平原地區最為常見。這個提示對於[半圓形瓦片](https://maps.app.goo.gl/4WMe1LBb2TXwU1Za6)也適用。

text: Roofs made from sheets of** corrugated metal** are most common between Birgunj and Janakpur.
text_zh: 由**波浪鐵皮**製成的屋頂在比爾甘傑和賈納克布爾之間最為常見。

text: Roofs that have a **railing** along the sides of the roofs, usually made of dark concrete, are found in some parts of western Nepal. They are most common in the Tulsipur valley, where the railings sometimes have a [stair shape](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ikhV9mfvD98582v9A). The easternmost region where they’re found is the plains by Kawasoti. The westernmost regions often have lower quality “railings”, sometimes consisting of a few sticks.
text_zh: 屋頂兩側有**欄杆**（通常由深色混凝土製成）的屋頂，可以在尼泊爾西部的某些地區找到。它們在圖爾西普爾（Tulsipur）山谷最為常見，那裡的欄杆有時帶有[階梯形狀](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ikhV9mfvD98582v9A)。能找到它們的最東邊地區是卡瓦索蒂（Kawasoti）的平原。最西部的地區通常用品質較差的「欄杆」，有時僅由幾根木棍組成。

text: In the far east, you will mainly see roofs made of sheet metal with a triangular "window" just below the ridge of the roof, and an outwards sloping section below it.
text_zh: 在極東地區，你會主要看到金屬鐵皮屋頂，其屋脊下方有一個三角形「窗戶」，下方則是一個向外傾斜的區段。

text: Large hip roofs made of sheet metal with a small protrusion just below the ridge are found around Biratnagar in the east.
text_zh: 東部比拉特納格爾（Biratnagar）周遭可以找到大型金屬鐵皮歇山頂，屋脊下方有一個小突起。

text: Similar to the above hint, hip roofs made of sheet metal with an even smaller protruding piece of metal at the ridge are mainly found west of and around Biratnagar.
text_zh: 與上述線索類似，屋脊處有一個更小突起金屬件的金屬鐵皮歇山頂，主要分布在比拉特納格爾以西及周遭。

text: Small** round clay huts** with **thatched roofs** are mainly found around Birgunj.
NOTE: These are also common just over the border in India.
text_zh: 帶有**茅草屋頂**的小型**圓形黏土小屋**主要分布在比爾甘傑周遭。
注意：這些在印度國界另一側也很常見。

text: The southernmost trekker coverage is situated in the town of Lukla, which can be recognised by the narrow street with relatively large buildings, combined with the **extremely dark coverage**.
text_zh: 最南端的徒步拍攝範圍位於路卡拉（Lukla）鎮，這裡的特徵是狹窄的街道搭配相對大型的建築，再加上**極度昏暗的街景**。

text: Khumjung village, situated just north of Namche Bazar, can be recognised by the **jagged mountain** towering above the village. Almost every house in the village has a **green roof**.
Beware that there is a label for Khumjung further north, which is not close to the village.
text_zh: 坤珍村（Khumjung village）位於南崎巴扎的正北方，可以透過高聳於村莊上方的高聳**鋸齒狀山峰**來辨識。村裡幾乎每棟房子都有**綠色屋頂**。
請注意，更北邊有一個坤珍的地標，但它並不在村莊附近。

text: The Netherlands has a high amount of urban planning, and as a result tends to have a **very organised look**. Road infrastructure is well-maintained. Suburbs are usually master-planned and typically feature row houses.
text_zh: 荷蘭有高度的都市規劃，因此通常具有**非常整齊的外觀**。道路基礎設施維護良好。市郊通常經過整體規劃，且多為連棟房屋。

text: **Brick architecture** is very common in the Netherlands. Many buildings feature red-brownish-coloured bricks. Roofs often have orange or dark grey tiles.
NOTE: Similar brick architecture is also common in Denmark and Belgium.
text_zh: **磚造建築**在荷蘭非常普遍。許多建築物都採用紅棕色磚塊。屋頂通常使用橘色或深灰色磁磚。
註：類似的磚造建築在丹麥和比利時也很常見。

text: As mentioned before, **row houses** are very common in the Netherlands. Almost half of the Dutch housing stock are row houses, significantly more than almost all other European countries.
text_zh: 如前所述，**連棟房屋**在荷蘭非常普遍。將近一半的荷蘭住宅都是連棟房屋，顯著多於幾乎所有其他歐洲國家。

text: Almost all of the land belonging to the province of Flevoland was reclaimed from the sea in the mid-20th century. As a result, the province has a distinct, **man-made** look: extremely straight roads and large crop fields dominate the landscape. Wind turbines are common. In urban areas, there are no historical buildings.

NOTE: The only exception to this description is the town of Urk, which is situated on a former island now surrounded by the rest of the province’s man-made [polder](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polder) landscape.
text_zh: 弗萊福蘭省幾乎所有的土地都是在 20 世紀中葉從海中填海造陸而來的。因此，該省具有鮮明的人為建造外觀：極其筆直的道路和巨大的農田主導了地景。風力發電機很常見。在市區中，沒有歷史建築。
注意：這項描述唯一的例外是烏克鎮，它坐落在一座前島嶼上，現在被該省其餘的人為 [圩田](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polder) 景觀所環繞。

text: Farms in the north of the Netherlands often have **very large roofs**.
text_zh: 荷蘭北部的農場通常有**非常大的屋頂**。

text: **Rolling shutters** on house windows are more common in the southern half of the Netherlands.
NOTE: While more prevalent in the south, rolling shutters on homes in more northern regions are not unheard of. Use this meta with some caution.
text_zh: 房屋窗戶上的**捲簾**在荷蘭南部較為常見。
注意：雖然在南部更為普遍，但在較北地區的民宅裝有防捲簾也並非聞名。使用這個 meta 時請稍微保持謹慎。

text: Buildings in the **Zaanstreek** region just north of Amsterdam often feature wooden architectural elements, usually painted green or black; with white trims. They sometimes have [tall roof spires](https://goo.gl/maps/aLs9DTJZ3e1HMasd8), usually painted white.
text_zh: 阿姆斯特丹正北方的**贊斯特雷克**地區的建築物經常帶有木造建築元素，通常漆成綠色或黑色，並配有白色飾邊。它們有時會有[高聳的尖頂屋頂](https://goo.gl/maps/aLs9DTJZ3e1HMasd8)，通常漆成白色。

text: In 2011, Christchurch was hit by an earthquake. As a result, roads on coverage from [2012](https://goo.gl/maps/8zQJgpbvKzbAUDX19) often appear in quite bad shape. Water damage caused many driveways to be cut off from streets due to large puddles of water, dirt or mud.

Due to this reason, many residential houses in the city had to be removed, leading to several districts on [newer coverage](https://goo.gl/maps/sTJGWHfVLuJmvM8n6) appearing like normal suburbs, but with almost no houses. This is noticeable when looking at where [former driveways](https://goo.gl/maps/3CRXxH6s1aYCBumS6) used to be.
text_zh: 2011 年，基督城發生了地震。因此，來自 [2012 年](https://goo.gl/maps/8zQJgpbvKzbAUDX19)街景覆蓋上的道路看起來通常狀況很差。水災導致許多車道因大水坑、泥土或泥濘而被切斷，無法通往街道。
由於這個原因，該市的許多住宅不得不被拆除，導致[較新街景覆蓋](https://goo.gl/maps/sTJGWHfVLuJmvM8n6)上的幾個區域看起來像普通的郊區，但幾乎沒有房子。當你觀察[以前的車道](https://goo.gl/maps/3CRXxH6s1aYCBumS6)曾經在哪裏時，就會發現這一點。

text: State Highway 73, located near [Arthur’s Pass](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arthur%27s_Pass), can be recognised by the almost dried out river with an **abundance of gravel **on the river bed. Additionally, the Street View car in Arthur’s Pass drove behind a black pickup truck with two ladders** **on its roof.
text_zh: 位於[亞瑟隘口](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arthur%27s_Pass)附近的 73 號國道，可以透過幾乎乾涸的河流以及河床上**豐富的碎石**來識別。此外，亞瑟隘口的 Google 車開在一輛車頂放有兩把梯子的黑色小貨車後面** **。

text: A **visible Street View car **is present in most of the coverage, being a pickup truck with the cab and bed visible. The colour of the cab and other features of it varies. In Generation 3, a **roof rack** is present. You may also find a large blur covering the entire pickup truck.
text_zh: 多數的街景覆蓋中都可以看到一台**Google 車**，為一台看得到車頭與車斗的小貨車。車頭的顏色與其他特徵會有所不同。在相機世代 3 中，配有**車頂架**。你可能也會發現一個大模糊遮蔽了整台小貨車。

text: Most Nigerian houses are **single-storey**, with **steeply pitched roofs** commonly made of metal sheets. Cinder block walls surrounding the houses are also common.
text_zh: 大多數奈及利亞的房子都是**單層**的，配有通常由金屬板製成的**陡峭斜屋頂**。環繞房屋的灰渣磚牆也很常見。

text: The vast majority of Norwegian houses are made of **wood**. Many houses are painted **red**, which is also typical for Sweden and Finland. **Black** painted houses are also quite common, more so than in Sweden or Finland.

NOTE: While the architecture is very similar to that of Sweden and Finland, there are some small, general differences. Sweden and Finland generally have more red and yellow houses, while Norway generally has more white houses. There is also a larger percentage of wooden houses in suburbs and near town centres in Norway than in Sweden and Finland, which use more brick than Norway.
text_zh: 絕大多數的挪威房屋都是**木造**的。許多房子漆成**紅色**，這在瑞典和芬蘭也很典型。**黑色**漆面的房子也相當普遍，比瑞典或芬蘭更常見。
注意：雖然建築風格與瑞典和芬蘭非常相似，但仍有一些微小的整體差異。瑞典和芬蘭通常有更多紅黃相間的房屋，而挪威通常有更多白色的房屋。與瑞典和芬蘭相比，挪威在郊區和市中心附近有更高比例的木造房屋，而瑞典和芬蘭使用的磚造建築比挪威更多。

text: Traditional houses in Norway commonly have **grass covered roofs**.
NOTE: This is far less common in Sweden and Finland.
text_zh: 挪威的傳統房屋通常有**草皮屋頂**。
注意：這在瑞典和芬蘭少見得多。

text: While completely **white wooden houses** can be found in the entire country, they’re especially common on the southern coast, where you’ll commonly see entire villages made up of them.
text_zh: 雖然全**白色木造房屋**在全國各地都能見到，但在南海岸特別常見，你常會看到整座村莊都由這種房屋組成。

text: The old mining town of Røros can be recognised by the **densely built** traditional wooden architecture.
text_zh: 舊礦城雷羅斯可以透過**密集建造**的傳統木造建築來辨識。

text: Buildings in Oman are typically made of** light-coloured stone**. The houses are **‘blocky’ **but still quite **ornate**, and they are usually surrounded by a matching fence, which often has an even more ornate gate.
NOTE: Buildings in the UAE are often very similar.
text_zh: 阿曼的建築通常由**淺色石材**建成。房屋呈**「方塊狀」**但仍相當**華麗**，周圍通常環繞著相匹配的圍欄，圍欄通常有更華麗的大門。
注意：阿拉伯聯合大公國的建築通常非常相似。

text: The road southeast of Ubar has a general northwest bound angle, along with a power line to the left of the road. You will often see signs of life in the form of farms or buildings on this road.

NOTE: Don’t mix this up with the 37, which has a similar angle, but is [more desolate](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8uU7Jw947G7wktyd7) and can have [sunset coverage](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dD63F9RyzyfugxBw9).
text_zh: 烏巴爾（Ubar）東南方的道路大致呈西北走向，道路左側有一條電線。在這條路上，你經常會看到農場或建築物等有人居住的跡象。
注意：不要把這條路跟 37 號公路搞混了，37 號公路的角度相似，但[更為荒涼](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8uU7Jw947G7wktyd7)，且可能帶有[日落街景覆蓋](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dD63F9RyzyfugxBw9)。

text: The Government College University of Lahore can be recognised by its **gothic architecture**.
text_zh: 拉合爾政府學院大學可以透過其**哥德式建築**來辨識。

text: The Patiala Block of King Edward Medical University in Lahore is a large white colonial building with large white domes having black lines going around them.
text_zh: 位於拉合爾的愛德華國王醫科大學帕蒂亞拉樓是一棟大型白色殖民風格建築，擁有大型白色圓頂，圓頂周圍有黑色線條。

text: Kinnaird College for Women University is mainly made up of traditional Pakistani red brick buildings, often combined with red brick paths.
text_zh: 金納德女子大學主要由傳統的巴基斯坦紅磚建築組成，通常搭配紅磚小徑。

text: In Pākpattan you can find a **busy market street** with a roof made of rugs.
NOTE: Like the car coverage in Lahore, this, and the rest of the coverage in Pākpattan, is hidden coverage.
text_zh: 在帕克帕坦（Pākpattan）你可以找到一條用毯子做成屋頂的**繁忙市場街道**。
註：就像拉合爾（Lahore）的車輛覆蓋一樣，這裡以及帕克帕坦其餘的覆蓋都是隱藏式街景覆蓋。

text: Peru is home to diverse and somewhat unique architecture. Here are a few examples of types of buildings commonly seen in Peru; ranging from Colonial-era buildings, contemporary “boxy” buildings, and traditional red brick buildings.
Some of these styles are broken down further in Step 2 of this guide.
text_zh: 祕魯擁有多元且獨特的建築風格。以下是祕魯常見的幾種建築類型範例；從殖民時期的建築、當代的「方塊狀」建築到傳統紅磚建築不等。
其中一些風格在本指南的步驟 2 中有更進一步的細分。

text: Low grass, a few hills, stone walls in villages and brown brick buildings are typical for the region south of **Lake Titicaca** in eastern Peru.
text_zh: 低矮的草地、幾座山丘、村莊裡的石牆以及棕色磚造建築，是祕魯東部**的的喀喀湖（Lake Titicaca）**以南地區的典型特徵。

text: As a general rule, the closer you are to Lake Titicaca in Peru, houses and buildings made out of **red brick** become more common. This type of architecture resembles the predominant type of building seen in parts of [western Bolivia](https://goo.gl/maps/qNyBR5RytYNpUZHg8), which is helpful for remembering where it is seen most commonly. Additionally, buildings with [blue tinted glass](https://maps.app.goo.gl/rS2S5g3xNuSUF9k89#extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng) can be seen most commonly in the same areas.
NOTE: Red brick buildings can be seen anywhere in the country, so use other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 作為一條一般規則，你離祕魯的的喀喀湖越近，由**紅磚**建造的房屋和建築物就越常見。這種建築風格類似於[玻利維亞西部](https://goo.gl/maps/qNyBR5RytYNpUZHg8)部分地區所見的主要建築類型，這有助於記住它最常見的地方。此外，帶有[藍色玻璃窗](https://maps.app.goo.gl/rS2S5g3xNuSUF9k89#extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng)的建築物最常在同一地區看到。
注意：紅磚建築在全國任何地方都看得到，因此在猜測之前請使用其他線索。

text: Buildings with **overhanging roofs with wooden supports** are mostly found in northern regions of Peru. These buildings are sometimes brightly coloured as well.
text_zh: 帶有**帶木質支撐的懸挑屋頂**的建築物主要見於祕魯北部地區。這些建築物有時也會漆成鮮豔的顏色。

text: The southern city of Cusco is recognizable by its prevalence of both [red brick](https://goo.gl/maps/SPo96ELYh9L8WLkX9) and [Spanish colonial style](https://goo.gl/maps/gEzLN3km1TnyiaUk8) buildings. Cusco is surrounded by **mountains on all sides** and features an [**airport in the middle of the city**](https://goo.gl/maps/Dxg9TFTNUNZZCxAVA). Due to its proximity and similar architecture, Cusco superficially resembles the Bolivian city of [La Paz](https://goo.gl/maps/4QxcjEmUPQeAFLjf9).
text_zh: 南部的庫斯科市以盛行[紅磚](https://goo.gl/maps/SPo96ELYh9L8WLkX9)和[西班牙殖民風格](https://goo.gl/maps/gEzLN3km1TnyiaUk8)建築而聞名。庫斯科**四周環山**，且[**市中心有一個機場**](https://goo.gl/maps/Dxg9TFTNUNZZCxAVA)。由於地理位置相近且建築風格相似，庫斯科表面上與玻利維亞城市[拉巴斯](https://goo.gl/maps/4QxcjEmUPQeAFLjf9)十分相似。

text: In Generation 3 you can come across a white Street View car with the **black roof** clearly visible.
You may also come across a silvery grey car, which is also found in [Bhutan](https://maps.app.goo.gl/WWXr2nyNkq8i9Gna8).
text_zh: 在第三代相機中，你會遇到一台白色 Google 車，且 **黑色車頂** 清晰可見。
你可能也會遇到銀灰色汽車，這款車也會出現在 [不丹](https://maps.app.goo.gl/WWXr2nyNkq8i9Gna8)。

text: Houses built with [amakan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amakan) walls, a traditionally woven bamboo mat, with a **diamond pattern** are almost exclusively found in the southern half of the country.
text_zh: 用[amakan](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amakan)（一種傳統編織的竹蓆，帶有**菱形圖案**）牆壁建造的房屋幾乎只在該國南部地區發現。

text: Houses built with amakan walls (referred to as Sawali in the north) with a **diagonally woven pattern** are mostly found on the island of Palawan, but can also be found throughout the northern half of the country.
text_zh: 以 amakan 牆壁（在北部稱為 Sawali）且具有**斜向編織圖案**建造的房屋主要分佈在 Palawan 島上，但也散見於該國的北部半部。

text: In and around the city of Marawi, Mindanao you can find many destroyed houses and ruins from the [Marawi siege](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Siege_of_Marawi) in 2017.
text_zh: 在 Mindanao 馬拉威市及其周邊地區，你可以找到許多 2017 年[馬拉威戰役](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Siege_of_Marawi)中被毀的房屋和廢墟。

text: You may find this **black** Street View car with a visible **roof rack** in and around the city of General Santos.
text_zh: 你可能會在桑托斯將軍城內及周邊地區找到這輛帶有明顯**車頂架**的**黑色**街景車。

text: **Polish architecture** is fairly similar to other Central European countries. Buildings usually have plain stone walls covered in [light or pastel stucco](https://goo.gl/maps/SUmW1ejjpN4hKhnp8). Frequent roofing colours are orange or red, black, and brown. Roof tiles and panes often have a tidy, almost [plastic-like look](https://goo.gl/maps/pQF5LJs2cBYABxvS8). Some rural houses have [corrugated sheet roofs](https://goo.gl/maps/1wzWLhAvvy4byjxc8) similar to those often found in the Baltics.
**Detached **[**single family homes**](https://goo.gl/maps/WW1uktU2VdF8LYop6) are common throughout Poland. They sometimes have a [blocky look](https://goo.gl/maps/tGoCqQWJZQRAQ3AGA).

In bigger towns, **apartment buildings** are common. Many date from communist times, and some of them still have a somewhat [austere look](https://goo.gl/maps/r9oZJoMjKwAWkL6Z6). However, many have been renovated and look [nice and well-kept](https://goo.gl/maps/PP5q8ytbJVbCWQKT6).
**Downtown areas** are usually [dense](https://goo.gl/maps/RM9tSBDsDoJXE67h9) and often have historic buildings.
text_zh: **波蘭建築**與其他中歐國家相當類似。建築物通常有覆蓋著[淺色或粉彩色 stucco](https://goo.gl/maps/SUmW1ejjpN4hKhnp8) 的樸素石牆。常見的屋頂顏色為橘色或紅色、黑色以及棕色。屋頂瓦片和嵌板通常有一種整潔、幾乎[塑膠般的外觀](https://goo.gl/maps/pQF5LJs2cBYABxvS8)。有些鄉村房屋有[波浪板屋頂](https://goo.gl/maps/1wzWLhAvvy4byjxc8)，類似於波羅的海國家常見的那種。
**獨棟**[**單戶住宅**](https://goo.gl/maps/WW1uktU2VdF8LYop6)在整個波蘭都很常見。它們有時帶有[方正的外觀](https://goo.gl/maps/tGoCqQWJZQRAQ3AGA)。
在較大的城鎮中，**公寓大樓**很常見。許多建於共產主義時期，其中一些仍然帶有幾分[嚴肅樸素的外觀](https://goo.gl/maps/r9oZJoMjKwAWkL6Z6)。然而，許多已經過翻新，看起來[美觀且維護良好](https://goo.gl/maps/PP5q8ytbJVbCWQKT6)。
**市中心地區**通常很[密集](https://goo.gl/maps/RM9tSBDsDoJXE67h9)，且經常有歷史建築。

text: Traditional **wooden houses** are commonly found in the east, mainly in Podlaskie Voivodeship.
text_zh: 傳統**木屋**常見於東部，主要在波德拉謝省（Podlaskie Voivodeship）。

text: **Gdańsk** is a large city in northwestern Poland. Its historic downtown features unique buildings that were inspired by Dutch Golden Age architecture. These buildings look somewhat similar to Amsterdam.
text_zh: **格但斯克（Gdańsk）**是波蘭西北部的一座大城。其歷史悠久的市中心擁有獨特的建築，靈感來自荷蘭黃金時代的建築。這些建築看起來有點像阿姆斯特丹。

text: White painted stone houses with orange tiled roofs are extremely common in Portugal.
text_zh: 漆成白色的石造房屋配上橘色紅瓦屋頂在葡萄牙極為常見。

text: Houses made of **decorative mosaic tiles** are somewhat common in Portugal.
text_zh: 由 **裝飾性馬賽克磁磚** 製成的房屋在葡萄牙相當常見。

text: Houses in northern Portugal are often made of **square concrete blocks**, which are commonly put together with white mortar.
NOTE: Very similar architecture, but typically without the white mortar, is commonly found over the border in [Galicia](https://maps.app.goo.gl/kp1QuJLF1w3t65b59).
text_zh: 葡萄牙北部的房屋通常由 **方形混凝土塊** 製成，這些混凝土塊通常是用白色水泥漿拼湊在一起的。
註：非常類似的建築風格（但通常沒有白色砂漿）常見於跨越邊境的 [加利西亞](https://maps.app.goo.gl/kp1QuJLF1w3t65b59)。

text: The Southern city of Ponce features many buildings in the style of **Ponce Creole Architecture**, which is a combination of Victorian and Spanish Revival styles. Buildings are typically made out of wood and masonry.
text_zh: 南部城市龐塞（Ponce）擁有許多 **龐塞克里奧爾建築** 風格的建築，這是維多利亞時代和西班牙復興風格的結合。建築通常由木材和石造建材建成。

text: Old Town San Juan is located at the far Northwest tip of the city of San Juan. This area has very **narrow streets, colourful buildings**, and a mix of Gothic, Renaissance, and Baroque architecture. Also, some streets in this area are made of bricks.
text_zh: 聖胡安老城位於聖胡安市的最西北端。這個地區有非常 **狹窄的街道、色彩繽紛的建築**，以及哥德式、文藝復興和巴洛克式建築的融合。此外，該地區的一些街道是由磚塊鋪成的。

text: Al Bayt Stadium can be recognized by the black and white **horizontal stripes** on the stadium along with the tent-like roof.
text_zh: Al Bayt Stadium 可以透過球場上黑白相間的**水平條紋**以及帳篷狀的屋頂來辨識。

text: The **Mall of Qatar** in Rawdat Al Jahhaniya can be recognized by the boxy appearance with many ads on the side of the building. Large [car parks](https://goo.gl/maps/HH42iSf57P7GxfVD9) are also seen next to the mall.
text_zh: 位於拉瓦達賈尼亞的**卡達購物中心（Mall of Qatar）**可以透過其方正的外觀以及建築側面的許多廣告來識別。購物中心旁也可以看到大型[停車場](https://goo.gl/maps/HH42iSf57P7GxfVD9)。

text: The Torch Tower can be seen from almost every point in the Baaya District, and can be recognized by its **hyperboloid** structure, along with it being the tallest building in Qatar.
text_zh: 在貝亞區（Baaya District）幾乎每個點都可以看到火炬塔（The Torch Tower），其**雙曲面**的建築結構以及卡達最高建築的身分讓它極具辨識度。

text: Réunion has a Street View car with visible side mirrors, a roof rack, and **black tape** at the end of the **rear right bar**.
NOTE: Make sure not to get this confused with the Ghana car, which has tape on the front right bar.
text_zh: 留尼旺的 Google 車具有清晰可見的車外後視鏡、車頂架，且**右後桿**的末端貼有**黑色膠帶**。
注意：請確保不要將其與迦納的 Google 車搞混，迦納的車是在前右桿上貼有膠帶。

text: **Sugarcane plantations** on Réunion can be found in two regions: the northeast and the southwest. The southwest is generally more built up and densely populated, meaning you will see more buildings or cars around.
text_zh: 留尼旺的**甘蔗種植園**分佈在兩個區域：東北部和西南部。西南部通常開發較完全且人口較稠密，這意味著你會看到周圍有較多建築物或車輛。

text: Romanian architecture primarily consists of single-family houses made of stone, typically painted in different pastel colours and with roofs ranging from orange tiles to grey metal. It is also somewhat common to see houses with walls made of [painted square tiles](https://goo.gl/maps/up6x7Wpuc8ovmBk7A) in different patterns.
text_zh: 羅馬尼亞的建築主要由石造單戶住宅組成，通常漆成不同的粉彩色，屋頂從橘色瓦片到灰色金屬都有。看到牆壁由不同圖案的[彩繪方形磁磚](https://goo.gl/maps/up6x7Wpuc8ovmBk7A)組成的房屋也相當普遍。

text: If you see several houses and almost all of them have **orange tiled roofs**, you are likely to be in the western half of the country.
text_zh: 如果你看到幾棟房屋，且幾乎所有房屋都有**橘色瓦片屋頂**，你很可能位於該國的西部半部。

text: Similarly, if you see several houses and almost all of them have **metal** or **plastic fake tiled roofs**, you will probably be in the eastern half of the country.
text_zh: 同理，如果你看到幾棟房屋，且幾乎所有房屋都有**金屬**或**塑膠假瓦屋頂**，你可能位於該國的東部半部。

text: Villages near the Hungarian border will often be built in the **same style** as villages in Hungary. This style can be summarised as having long, straight streets with single-storey houses being evenly spaced along the road, typically having the short side of the house facing the road. The vast majority of roofs will have orange tiles.
text_zh: 靠近匈牙利邊境的村莊，其建造**風格**通常與匈牙利境內的村莊相同。這種風格可總結為長而直的街道，單層房屋沿著道路等距排列，通常是房屋的短邊面向道路。絕大多數的屋頂都是橘色瓦片。

text: Most houses are made of wooden panels with a **boxy look** and often **vivid colours**.
text_zh: 多數房屋由木板建造，具有**方正的外觀**且通常色彩**鮮豔**。

text: Miquelon-Langlade is a small town in the north of St Pierre. It can be recognized by the houses with timber cladding painted in **bold, vivid colours**. [A shadow of the ATV](https://goo.gl/maps/QKtCCJyEA33ukUTw9) used to cover this town can also be seen.
text_zh: 米克隆-朗克拉德（Miquelon-Langlade）是聖皮埃爾（St Pierre）北部的一個小鎮。可以透過漆上**大膽鮮豔色彩**、帶有木質外牆的房屋來辨識。也可以看到用來拍攝這個小鎮的[全地形車（ATV）影子](https://goo.gl/maps/QKtCCJyEA33ukUTw9)。

text: Saint-Pierre is the capital and largest town. The coverage in this town is made with a **sidewalk trekker**. Larger buildings and more cars can be seen, with a more populated feel compared to Miquelon-Langlade.
text_zh: 聖皮耶是首都與最大城鎮。此城鎮的街景覆蓋是使用**人行道徒步拍攝**拍攝的。相較於密克隆與朗格德，這裡可以看到較大的建築物和較多車輛，給人更熱鬧的感覺。

text: A slightly **hilly, grass**y landscape with boxy houses spaced apart can be seen on Île-aux-Marins.
text_zh: 在聖保祿島（Île-aux-Marins）上可以看到稍微**起伏、長滿草**的景觀，並有著間距較遠的方正房屋。

text: A Google Car with a visible **roof rack** and the right side mirror is seen in Generation 3 coverage. **Rifts** can also be seen in the sky.
NOTE: This specific Google Car with the right side mirror visible is unique to Senegal. Roof racks and rifts however can be seen in various other countries.
text_zh: 在第 3 代相機世代的街景中可以看到一台看得見**車頂架**與右側後視鏡的 Google 車。天空中也可以看到**接圖裂縫**。
注意：這台看得見右側後視鏡的特定 Google 車是塞內加爾特有的。不過車頂架和接圖裂縫在其他許多國家也能看到。

text: The silver Generation 4 car with a **stain** at the back left and a **dirty roof** can mainly be seen on the N1 between Kaffrine and Tambacounda, and the N7 between Tambacounda and Kedougou. It can also be seen between Dahra and Diakhao.
text_zh: 車廂左後方帶有**污漬**且**車頂髒污**的銀色第 4 代車主要可以在卡夫林（Kaffrine）和坦巴昆達之間的 N1 公路上，以及坦巴昆達和凱杜古之間的 N7 公路上看到。它也可以在達赫拉（Dahra）和迪亞考（Diakhao）之間看到。

text: The white Generation 4 car but with the **antenna down**, parallel to the car’s roof, can be found on the N6 between Ziguinchor and Kolda.
text_zh: 白色第 4 代車但**天線倒下**、與車頂平行的版本，可以在濟金紹爾（Ziguinchor）和科爾達（Kolda）之間的 N6 公路上找到。

text: Dakar is the **largest** and **capital city** of Senegal. It can be recognized by the denseness of the city and taller, more modern buildings.
text_zh: 達卡是塞內加爾**最大**的城市與**首都**。它的特徵是城市密度高且有更高、更現代的建築。

text: Like all of the former Eastern bloc, prefabricated panel apartment buildings are a common sight in urban areas. What distinguishes Slovakia and Czechia is the relatively good maintenance often combined with vibrant colours and patterns. Some [smaller buildings](https://goo.gl/maps/CJeGYdbyuKZJFKMw6) also adhere to this style.
NOTE: To a lesser extent, you can find this kind of architecture in neighbouring countries, like [Poland](https://goo.gl/maps/qDTiRFmn8nDkEmxYA) and [Hungary](https://goo.gl/maps/rFL2pygygEQKHmTJ6).
text_zh: 就像所有前東歐地區一樣，預製板式公寓大樓在市區是很常見的景象。斯洛伐克和捷克的不同之處在於其相對良好的維護，通常結合了鮮豔的色彩和圖案。一些[較小的建築物](https://goo.gl/maps/CJeGYdbyuKZJFKMw6)也遵循這種風格。
注意：在鄰近國家（如[波蘭](https://goo.gl/maps/qDTiRFmn8nDkEmxYA)和[匈牙利](https://goo.gl/maps/rFL2pygygEQKHmTJ6)），你也能在一定程度上找到這種建築風格。

text: Roofs with **diamond shaped tiles** are common in both Slovakia and Czechia.
NOTE: This is also somewhat common in Hungary.
text_zh: 採用**菱形瓦片**的屋頂在斯洛伐克和捷克都很常見。
注意：這在匈牙利也算常見。

text: House numbers in Slovakia are typically written on **white signs **with a thin red or black border.
text_zh: 斯洛伐克的門牌號碼通常寫在帶有細紅框或黑框的**白色標誌**上。

text: Many Slovak houses have the short side facing the road with the roof ending in a [hip end](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hip_roof).
NOTE: This is also very common in Hungary, but less common in Czechia.
text_zh: 許多斯洛伐克的房屋短邊面向道路，屋頂以[四坡屋頂](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hip_roof)收尾。
注意：這在匈牙利也很常見，但在捷克較少見。

text: **Grey metal roofs** are very common, particularly in the eastern parts of Slovakia.
NOTE: Apart from the most mountainous areas, it is far less common in Czechia.
text_zh: **灰色金屬屋頂**非常普遍，特別是在斯洛伐克的東部地區。
注意：除了最高山區外，它在捷克的普及程度要低得多。

text: Čičmany, in the westernmost parts of the Žilina Region, is easily recognized by the dark brown wooden houses, whose walls are filled with art consisting of **white lines**.
text_zh: 位於日利納州最西部的奇奇馬尼（Čičmany），以深棕色木屋聞名，其牆面繪滿了由**白色線條**組成的藝術圖案。

text: Slovenian architecture takes much inspiration from alpine architecture, with light coloured walls, **dark wooden details** and semi-steep roofs. The most common roof shape is [half-](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hip_roof#Half-hip_roof)[h](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hip_roof#Half-hip_roof)[ipped roofs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hip_roof#Half-hip_roof).
text_zh: 斯洛維尼亞建築深受阿爾卑斯山建築風格啟發，擁有淺色牆面、**深色木質細節**以及微陡的屋頂。最常見的屋頂形狀是[半](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hip_roof#Half-hip_roof)[歇山](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hip_roof#Half-hip_roof)[頂](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hip_roof#Half-hip_roof)。

text: Slovenian street signs are most commonly white with a **metal border** attached to signposts, or **red** and attached to house walls.

NOTE: [Czech](https://goo.gl/maps/gi5f8C9LNAUumAQFA) street signs are also typically red and attached to walls. However, Czech street names will not contain the word “ulica”, which most Slovenian street names have.
text_zh: 斯洛維尼亞的街道標誌通常為白色、帶有固定在柱子上的**金屬邊框**，或是**紅色**並固定在房屋牆壁上。
註：[捷克](https://goo.gl/maps/gi5f8C9LNAUumAQFA)的街道標誌通常也是紅色並固定在牆上。然而，捷克的街道名稱不會包含多數斯洛維尼亞街道名稱中會有的「ulica」一詞。

text: Slovenian house numbers are typically **red** with white text.
NOTE: [Czech](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.7257121,15.1788819,3a,15y,1.15h,98.69t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s4rpA0yUvp4TJif4QGtcHvQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu) house numbers are also commonly red.
text_zh: 斯洛維尼亞的門牌號碼通常為**紅色**配白色文字。
註：[捷克](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.7257121,15.1788819,3a,15y,1.15h,98.69t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s4rpA0yUvp4TJif4QGtcHvQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)的門牌號碼通常也是紅色。

text: Near the coast you get a landscape similar to the rest of the Adriatic coast; **white cliffs** with bushy vegetation, vineyards and Mediterranean architecture.
text_zh: 靠近海岸處，你會看到類似亞得里亞海其他地區的景緻；帶有灌木植被、葡萄園和地中海式建築的**白色懸崖**。

text: Instead of the normal red house numbers, Ljubljana will typically feature **green house numbers**.
NOTE: [Street signs](https://goo.gl/maps/h5GSwk121qRJantj8) in Ljubljana are also occasionally green.
text_zh: 盧比安納通常會使用**綠色門牌號碼**，而不是一般的紅色門牌號碼。
註：盧比安納的[街道標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/h5GSwk121qRJantj8)偶爾也是綠色的。

text: Suburban houses in and around large cities will often be surrounded by **high walls,** fences, and gates** **to deter criminals.
text_zh: 大城市內及周邊的郊區住宅通常會被**高牆、**柵欄和大門**圍繞**，以嚇阻犯罪分子。

text: A **camouflage **car with black side mirrors and roof racks can be seen in Kruger National Park, on the Mozambique border.
NOTE: The Park now also has generation 4 coverage.
text_zh: 在莫三比克邊境的克魯格國家公園內，可以看到一台黑色的車側後照鏡和車頂架的**迷彩 **車。
注意：該公園現在也有第 4 代街景覆蓋。

text: A church and another building made of **white painted** wood can also be seen in Grytviken.
text_zh: 在格里特維肯也能看到一座教堂和另一棟由**白色塗漆**木材建造的建築。

text: Korean buildings have very distinctive **house numbers**. They are blue and usually are shaped quite literally like a house. The full address of the building is written on them, in both Hangul and Latin script.
Some places have unique house numbers, which you can use to region-guess. More information about this can be found in the spotlight section.
text_zh: 南韓建築物有非常獨特的**門牌號碼**。它們是藍色的，通常字面上就做成房子的形狀。建築物的完整地址寫在上面，包含諺文和拉丁字母。
有些地方有獨特的門牌號碼，你可以用來進行地區猜測。關於這點的更多資訊可以在焦點（spotlight）部分找到。

text: **Red brick** is a very common building material in South Korea.
text_zh: **紅磚**是南韓非常常見的建築材料。

text: Many buildings have **traditional tiled roofs** like these. These often have decorative elements on the corners, and tend to have sides that curve slightly upwards. Blue roofs are quite common.
text_zh: 許多建築物都有像這樣的**傳統瓦片屋頂**。這些屋頂的角落通常有裝飾性元素，且側面往往略微向上彎曲。藍色屋頂相當常見。

text: House numbers in the Hampyeong region can be recognised from the **large white section** at the top of the sign.
text_zh: 咸平地區的門牌號碼可以透過標誌頂部的**大片白色區域**來辨識。

text: The **Pyrenees** is a large mountain range on the border between Spain and France. Its mountains are some of the highest in all of Spain. It can be recognized by its light grey rock and abundance of pine trees. Local architecture features many [rock walls](https://goo.gl/maps/F67y544xPUyR5ypo7).

NOTE: Andorra and the French part of the Pyrenees look very similar in terms of landscape and architecture. Also consider that the exclave of [Llívia](/images/spain/spain_pyreneesllivia.png) is part of Spain.
text_zh: **庇里尼亞山脈（Pyrenees）**是位於西班牙和法國邊境的大型山脈。其群山是全西班牙海拔最高的一些山脈。它可透過淺灰色岩石和大量的松樹來辨識。當地建築特色包含許多[石牆](https://goo.gl/maps/F67y544xPUyR5ypo7)。
注意：安道爾和庇里牛斯山的法國部分在景觀和建築上看起來非常相似。同時也要考慮到[利維亞](/images/spain/spain_pyreneesllivia.png)飛地是西班牙的一部分。

text: Towns built **on a mountain face**, consisting entirely of white houses, are very common on the south coast of Spain, around Málaga.
text_zh: 建**在山壁上**、完全由白色的房屋組成的城鎮，在西班牙南部海岸馬拉加一帶非常常見。

text: There is a large part of north-west Spain where you will find almost exclusively **slate roofs** (recognisable by their almost black colour). This type of roofing can be seen sparingly all the way to the west coast of Galicia, but ends rather abruptly on the east.
Slate roofs can also be found in the [Pyrenees](https://goo.gl/maps/gEG616kL4GBMD2HV8) near Andorra, and in the [mountain ranges](https://goo.gl/maps/WF1eMyRmBBnrFF867) north east of Madrid.
text_zh: 西班牙西北部有很大一部分地區幾乎全都是**石板屋頂**（以幾乎黑色的外觀為特徵）。這類屋頂在通往加利西亞西海岸的沿途稀疏可見，但在東側卻相當突然地結束。
石板屋頂也可以在安道爾附近的[庇里牛斯山](https://goo.gl/maps/gEG616kL4GBMD2HV8)以及馬德里東北方的[山脈](https://goo.gl/maps/WF1eMyRmBBnrFF867)中找到。

text: Many houses in Galicia are built with **big concrete blocks**, sometimes textured to resemble natural stone.
Plain concrete blocks are also an extremely common material for [walls](https://goo.gl/maps/rPpmQLWq37euCkuJ9) and miscellaneous buildings like [garages](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nwbdKGLUKSJGjp7FA).
text_zh: 加利西亞的許多房屋都是用**大型混凝土塊**建造的，有時會做成仿天然石材的紋理。
樸素的混凝土塊也是[牆壁](https://goo.gl/maps/rPpmQLWq37euCkuJ9)和諸如[車庫](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nwbdKGLUKSJGjp7FA)等雜項建築極為常見的材料。

text: In Asturias, “hórreos” are bigger, generally with a square design, and are built above four pillars, with or without walls. You will sometimes find a **rectangular** variation, usually built on top of six or eight pillars called “[panera](https://goo.gl/maps/drVo2HBDcETz5TY68)”.
If you find an “horreo” with a slate roof, you will be in western Asturias.
text_zh: 在阿斯圖里亞斯，稱為「hórreos」的糧倉更大，通常為方形設計，建造在四根柱子上，可帶有或不帶牆壁。你偶爾會找到一個**長方形**的變體，通常建在六根或八根柱子頂上，稱為“[panera](https://goo.gl/maps/drVo2HBDcETz5TY68)”。
如果你找到帶有石板屋頂的「horreo」，你就會身處阿斯圖里亞斯西部。

text: **Large white houses** with wooden frames are common in the Basque Country, the Basque part of Navarra, and Cantabria.
text_zh: 帶有木造骨架的**大型白色房屋**在巴斯克地區、納瓦拉的巴斯克語區以及坎塔布里亞很常見。

text: Traditional farm houses called “[masías](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Masia)” are common in Catalonia, eastern Aragón and parts of the Valencian Community.
They are usually made of stone and stand isolated or as part of a small complex.
text_zh: 稱為“[masías](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Masia)”的傳統農舍在加泰隆尼亞、亞拉岡東部和瓦倫西亞自治區的部分地區很常見。
牠們通常由石頭建造，獨立座落或作為小型綜合建築的一部分。

text: Within the centre and south of Spain, towns made **completely** out of **white painted houses** are very common in Andalucía and Extremadura.
You can still see a fair amount of white painted houses in Castilla la Mancha but streets where every house is white will not be common.
text_zh: 在西班牙的中部和南部，**完全**由**漆成白色的房屋**組成的城鎮在安達魯西亞和艾斯特雷馬杜拉非常普遍。
你仍然可以在卡斯提爾-拉曼查看到相當數量漆成白色的房屋，但每棟房子都是白色的街道並不常見。

text: The stereotypical Balearic house is painted completely **white**. You can find flat roofs, but tiled roofs with a small incline are the most common.
text_zh: 典型的巴利阿里房屋完全漆成**白色**。你可以找到平屋頂，但帶有微幅坡度的瓦片屋頂最為常見。

text: Off the north coast of Lanzarote, you will find the small island of **La Graciosa**. The island’s landscape is completely barren, and the entire coverage features **overcast weather**. There are two towns on the south coast of the island, with white flat-roofed houses like the east Canaries.
text_zh: 在蘭薩羅特島（Lanzarote）北海岸外，你會發現一座名為**拉格拉西奧薩島**的小島。該島的地貌完全荒蕪，且整個街景覆蓋都呈現**陰天**。島的南海岸有兩個城鎮，擁有像東加納利群島那樣的白色平頂房屋。

text: Ceuta features north African architecture, consisting of mainly flat roofed houses in warm colours, ranging from pale yellow to red.
Almost all of the Generation 4 coverage in Ceuta features a **bright blue sky** in sunny weather with occasional clouds.
text_zh: Ceuta 呈現北非建築風格，主要由暖色系的平頂房屋組成，顏色從淡黃色到紅色都有。
Ceuta 的第四代街景幾乎全都有著晴朗天氣的 **明亮藍天**，偶爾伴隨一些雲朵。

text: Melilla also features similar North African architecture. The coverage in Melilla has a **hazy** look, with a significantly less saturated sky than Ceuta. Most of the coverage is cloudy or overcast.
Melilla has little rural coverage, mainly by the [Morocco-Spain border](https://goo.gl/maps/MEvyBFFYmeHYiDhw6).
text_zh: Melilla 也呈現類似的北非建築風格。Melilla 的街景帶有一種 **朦朧** 的外觀，天空的飽和度明顯比 Ceuta 低。大部分的街景都是多雲或陰天。
Melilla 幾乎沒有鄉村街景，主要分布在 [摩洛哥與西班牙邊境](https://goo.gl/maps/MEvyBFFYmeHYiDhw6)。

text: Between Almeria and Motril you can find many **greenhouses** with white roofs, in the lowland area close to the sea. They are especially common in El Ejido.
text_zh: 在阿爾梅里亞（Almeria）和莫特里爾（Motril）之間，靠近大海的低窪地區可以找到許多白色屋頂的 **溫室**。它們在埃爾埃吉多（El Ejido）特別常見。

text: In most Generation 3 coverage, you will be able to see the **front of the Google car** partially through the blur: it is visible as blue-white-red patches, reminiscent of the French flag. The red patch is usually most visually distinct.
NOTE: This car is unique to Sri Lanka. Coverage in Ghana has a similar front of the car visible, but this coverage also has a roof rack.
text_zh: 在大多數第三代街景中，你將能夠透過模糊效果部分看到 **Google 車的前方**：它顯示為藍-白-紅色的色塊，讓人聯想起法國國旗。紅色色塊通常在視覺上最為明顯。
注意：這輛車是斯里蘭卡特有的。迦納的街景也有類似可見的車頭，但該街景還帶有車頂架。

text: Houses often have **orange or red tiled roofs**. Due to wear and tear, these tiles often have an almost brown tint to them.
NOTE: Similar roofs are also common in parts of Indonesia.
text_zh: 房屋通常有 **橘色或紅色的瓦片屋頂**。由於磨損，這些瓦片通常帶有幾乎是棕色的色調。
注意：類似的屋頂在印尼的部分地區也很常見。

text: This style of **tuktuk** is common in Sri Lanka: it has a bulky shape and a black roof. They are usually coloured green, yellow or red, though other colours appear as well.
text_zh: 這種風格的 **嘟嘟車（tuktuk）** 在斯里蘭卡很常見：它具有笨重的外形和黑色的車頂。它們通常被漆成綠色、黃色或紅色，不過也會出現其他顏色。

text: These maps shows the distribution of each of Sri Lanka’s **four main religions**. This can help with region-guessing when you spot a house of worship or other symbol associated with one of the religions.
- Buddhism is found in most of the country but is mostly absent from the north and some parts of the east coast.
- Hinduism is predominantly found in the north and parts of the east, as well as around the town of Nuwara Eliya in the central mountains.
- Islam is strongest on the east coast, but not a majority in any district.
- Christianity is mostly confined to the northwest, and is strongest around the town of Mannar.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 這些地圖顯示了斯里蘭卡 **四大主要宗教** 的分布。當你發現寺廟或與其中一種宗教相關的其他符號時，這有助於進行區域猜測。
- 佛教見於該國大部分地區，但在北部和東海岸的部分地區幾乎不存在。
- 印度教主要見於北部和東部部分地區，以及中部山區的努沃勒埃利耶（Nuwara Eliya）城鎮周圍。
- 伊斯蘭教在東海岸最強勢，但在任何地區都不是多數。
- 基督教主要限於西北部，在馬納爾（Mannar）城鎮周圍最強勢。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Longyearbyen is the largest settlement on Svalbard, with many **boxy, minimalistic **buildings around the town.
text_zh: 朗伊爾城（Longyearbyen）是斯瓦巴最大的聚落，鎮上有許多 **方正、極簡** 風格的建築。

text: Houses in the Swedish countryside are most commonly wooden and often painted with a distinct **dark red** [paint](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Falu_red), which is almost exclusively found in Sweden, Norway and Finland.
Urban architecture is usually modern and made of concrete and bricks, while suburban buildings are commonly freestanding single family houses built of either wood or brick.
text_zh: 瑞典鄉村的房屋最常見的是木造的，並且通常漆上獨特的**深紅色**[油漆](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Falu_red)，這種油漆幾乎只在瑞典、挪威和芬蘭找到。
城市建築通常是現代化的混凝土和磚造建築，而郊區建築通常是獨立的單戶住宅，由木頭或磚塊建造。

text: **Grey metal roofs** on residential buildings generally get more common the further north in the country you get. Note that metal roofs on barns and sheds can be found significantly further south.
text_zh: 住宅建築上的**灰色金屬屋頂**通常越往北越常見。請注意，農場和倉庫的金屬屋頂在更南邊的地方也能找到。

text: Houses in Skåne commonly have either a white stone, or a [red brick wall](https://goo.gl/maps/5TZ5nbPgeayZtjgS9) with a **coloured wooden triangle** beneath the roof on the sides. Similar houses with other materials (such as grey brick) for the walls can be found elsewhere in the southern half of the country.
text_zh: 斯科讷的房屋通常有白石牆或[紅磚牆](https://goo.gl/maps/5TZ5nbPgeayZtjgS9)，屋頂兩側下方帶有**彩色的木製三角形**。使用其他牆壁材料（例如灰磚）的類似房屋，可以在該國南部的其他地方找到。

text: **Half-timbered houses** can be found mainly in the southern half of Skåne, but also in the northern half and southern Halland. It can also be found in Visby on rare occasions.
text_zh: **半木構房屋**主要分佈在斯科讷南部，但也分佈在北部和哈蘭南部。在維斯比（Visby）偶爾也能找到。

text: A lot of single family houses in Skåne are built out of **red brick**. They typically look slightly older than red brick houses in other parts of the country.
NOTE: Red brick architecture is also very common in Denmark.
text_zh: 斯科讷的許多獨棟住宅都是用**紅磚**建造的。它們通常看起來比該國其他地區的紅磚房還要稍舊一些。
注意：紅磚建築在丹麥也非常普遍。

text: **Corrugated square metal roof panels** with **moss** growing on them are typically found in southern Sweden, particularly in Skåne and Blekinge. It is mainly found on large barns, and the roofs are often very steep.
text_zh: 表面長有**苔蘚**的**瓦楞方形金屬屋頂板**通常見於瑞典南部，特別是在斯科讷和布萊金厄（Blekinge）。它主要見於大型農場，且屋頂通常非常陡峭。

text: Grey **diamond-tiled roofs** are mainly found in Skåne, Blekinge, Öland, and occasionally on Gotland.

NOTE: Gotland and Öland are normally more easily recognised from landscape alone. Houses in western and southern Skåne typically use a lot of stone and bricks, while houses in northeastern Skåne and Blekinge are mostly made of red painted wood.
text_zh: 灰色**菱形磁磚屋頂**主要分佈在斯科讷、布萊金厄、厄蘭島，偶爾也會在哥特蘭島上找到。
注意：哥特蘭島和厄蘭島通常單從景觀就更容易辨認。西斯科讷和南斯科讷的房屋通常使用大量石頭和磚塊，而東北斯科讷和布萊金厄的房屋大多由紅色油漆木材製成。

text: While houses in Sweden are mostly very colourful, on the west coast they are commonly **much lighter**. There are an especially large number of white and light yellow houses along the coast between Gothenburg and the Norwegian border.
text_zh: 雖然瑞典的房屋大多色彩繽紛，但在西海岸，它們通常**淺得多**。哥德堡和挪威邊境之間的海岸沿線有特別大量的白色和淺黃色房屋。

text: Central Dalarna has a strong tradition of **wooden craftsmanship**, and as a result much of the architecture has a unique, picturesque look to it. Most commonly, you may find red timbered houses, [portals](https://goo.gl/maps/wH5PidjzpWgF8LMVA) made of logs, and so-called [härbren](https://www.google.se/maps/@60.7798763,14.9657218,3a,23.7y,91.6h,95.93t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1seTaLVBDr_RiwMqw0EattNw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) which have a very distinct design.
NOTE: Similar buildings can be found elsewhere in the country, but it is by far most common in central Dalarna.
text_zh: 達拉納中部有著濃厚的**木工工藝**傳統，因此許多建築都具有獨特、風景如畫的外觀。最常見的是，你會發現紅色木屋、由圓木製成的[門廊](https://goo.gl/maps/wH5PidjzpWgF8LMVA)，以及設計非常獨特的 sogenannten [härbren](https://www.google.se/maps/@60.7798763,14.9657218,3a,23.7y,91.6h,95.93t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1seTaLVBDr_RiwMqw0EattNw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)。
注意：類似的建築可以在該國其他地方找到，但以中達拉納最為常見。

text: Houses on Gotland are commonly made of **limestone** and often have a dirty-looking white facade. Churches on Gotland are very distinct looking, with either grey walls or white walls with grey corners, a large portal around the door and small windows typically divided in two by a pillar.
text_zh: 哥特蘭島上的房屋通常由**石灰石**製成，且常常有看起來髒兮兮的白色外牆。哥特蘭島上的教堂外觀非常獨特，擁有灰牆或帶灰色角落的白牆、門周圍的大型門廊，以及通常被一根柱子分成兩半的小窗戶。

text: This type of uneven **stone brick** is typically found in houses and rock walls on Öland, and less commonly in rock walls on Gotland.
text_zh: 這種不規則的**石磚**通常出現在厄蘭島的房屋和石牆上，在哥特蘭島的石牆上則較少見。

text: Near the coast north and east of Uppsala, you can come across old factory towns called [Walloon mills](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vallonbruken).
