They typically consist of long rows of identical residential houses, which can either be made of [brightly coloured stone](https://maps.app.goo.gl/MJ9XxULNWvZVRrQo6) or [red wood](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Nr86W8fKXsjQLpco6), as well as [small belfries](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Y4PxZhdfk4n8NhAE8), [mansions](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ojJek3KArSy4vbs28) and [factory buildings](https://maps.app.goo.gl/THaS5jbw6HfsMb7x5), which are typically made in similar styles as the residential buildings.
text_zh: 在烏普薩拉（Uppsala）北部和東部的海岸附近，你會遇到被稱為[瓦隆鐵廠（Walloon mills）](https://sv.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vallonbruken)的舊工廠城鎮。它們通常由一排排相同的住宅組成，這些住宅可以是用[色彩鮮艷的石頭](https://maps.app.goo.gl/MJ9XxULNWvZVRrQo6)或[紅木](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Nr86W8fKXsjQLpco6)建造，此外還有[小鐘樓](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Y4PxZhdfk4n8NhAE8)、[宅邸](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ojJek3KArSy4vbs28)和[工廠建築](https://maps.app.goo.gl/THaS5jbw6HfsMb7x5)，這些建築通常採用與住宅相似的風格建造。

text: Buildings made fully or [partially](https://maps.app.goo.gl/NuP4BqgFvXsdcodo9) out of **blue or green slag stone** can occasionally be found in the mining region of [Bergslagen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bergslagen).
text_zh: 完全或[部分](https://maps.app.goo.gl/NuP4BqgFvXsdcodo9)由**藍色或綠色礦渣磚**建造的建築，偶爾可以在[貝爾斯拉根（Bergslagen）](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bergslagen)礦區找到。

text: Visby is the only preserved [**Hanseatic town**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hanseatic_League) in Sweden. The inner town can typically be recognised by the cobblestone streets, combined with the small, brightly painted stone houses and an abundance of roses following the house walls. It is also quite common to get a glimpse of the old Hanseatic wall surrounding the town.
text_zh: 維斯比（Visby）是瑞典唯一保存完好的[**漢薩同盟城鎮**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hanseatic_League)。其內部城鎮通常可以透過鵝卵石街道來辨認，結合了小型、色彩鮮艷的石造房屋，以及沿著房屋牆壁生長的大量玫瑰。瞥見環繞城鎮的古老漢薩同盟城牆也相當常見。

text: The old town of Stockholm can be recognised by the old stone buildings, usually painted in warm colours, towering over the **narrow cobblestone alleyways**.
text_zh: 斯德哥爾摩（Stockholm）的老城可以透過古老的石造建築來辨認，這些建築通常漆成暖色調，高聳於**狹窄的鵝卵石小巷**之上。

text: Black bus shelters with this specific design, mainly recognised by the square ridge along the back of the roof, can be found in Västerås and Umeå.
text_zh: 這種具有特定設計的黑色公車候車亭，主要特徵是屋頂背面的方形山脊，可以在韋斯特罗斯（Västerås）和于默奧（Umeå）找到。

text: Swiss and Alpine architecture in general largely consists of **stone buildings** painted in light and warm colours, often combined with wooden parts and details. Roofs are typically tiled and of a gable type. It is extremely common for windows to have wooden shutters which open horizontally in two parts.
text_zh: 瑞士乃至阿爾卑斯山的建築風格，大體上由漆成淺色與暖色調的**石造建築**組成，通常會結合木造結構與細節。屋頂通常為瓦片鋪設的人字形屋頂。窗戶裝有能從中間向兩側水平開啟的木製百葉窗，這是極為常見的特色。

text: Not unexpectedly, seeing typical **Italian architecture** in Switzerland should imply that you are in the Italian-speaking areas in the south, principally the canton of Ticino.

The architectural style is characterized by, typically very smooth, orange-yellow stone walls with multiple floors and orange or brownish tiled roofs. Green and brown Italian-style window shutters are common.
text_zh: 不出所料，如果在瑞士看到典型的**義大利建築**，通常意味著你身處南部的義大利語區，主要是提契諾州。
這種建築風格的特點通常是非常平滑的橘黃色石牆，擁有好幾個樓層以及橘色或帶棕色的瓦片屋頂。綠色和棕色的義大利風格窗戶百葉窗十分常見。

text: Large houses with thick roofs, which are shaped like an **arch** **underneath**, are common around Bern.
text_zh: 伯恩周邊常見到屋頂厚重的大型房屋，其形狀呈**下方拱起**的弧形。

text: Around Appenzell, most houses will consist of a large living house connected to a long barn, such that the roof of the living house and the barn are at a **90° angle**.
The front facade of the living house will often be divided into small squares, with each window being perfectly contained within a square.
text_zh: 在阿彭策爾一帶，大多數房屋由一棟大型住家連接一座長形穀倉組成，使得住家與穀倉的屋頂呈現 **90° 夾角**。
住家的正面外牆通常會被分割成許多小方塊，每個窗戶都完美地被包含在一個方塊之內。

text: In the canton of Graubünden, you will often come across houses entirely made of stone, with, most commonly white, **decorative painted details** around windows and the edges of the house.
text_zh: 在格勞賓登州，你經常會看到完全由石頭建造的房屋，窗戶周圍和房屋邊緣通常有白色的**裝飾彩繪細節**。

text: Downtown Bern can be recognized by this **specific architecture**. Grey toned buildings, typically with four floors and large, somewhat rounded openings lined up on the ground floor are common.
text_zh: 伯恩市中心可以透過這種**特定的建築風格**來辨識。灰色調的建築通常有四層樓，底樓則排列著大型且帶點圓弧形的開口，這點十分常見。

text: The car used on Príncipe can be recognised by the **blue** roof and silver roof rails.
NOTE: Remember that it can sometimes be blurred out.
text_zh: 普林西比島上使用的車輛可透過**藍色**車頂和銀色車頂架來辨識。
注意：記住它有時候可能會被模糊處理。

text: The car used on São Tomé is **black** with black roof rails. In most locations, it is blurred out.
text_zh: 聖多美島上使用的車輛是**黑色**的，配有黑色車頂架。在大多數地點，車子都被模糊處理了。

text: Architecture in Taiwan varies in designs, ranging from cramped, multiple-story housing to flat, single-story houses with backyards. Many residential buildings have a very **boxy** look. A lot of walls are covered in **tiles**, usually white. Sheds made out of tin are also featured, commonly painted in a light green colour.
text_zh: 台灣的建築樣式差異很大，從擁擠的多層住宅到附有後院的平房都有。許多住宅外觀呈現明顯的**方正塊狀**，牆面大量使用**磁磚**，通常是白色。鐵皮搭建的棚屋也很常見，多漆成淺綠色。

text: The **Yilan Plain** is easily identifiable by the mountain ranges that are seen in the north, west, and south. Rice paddies are also extremely common as well as houses built right next to these fields.

NOTE: While the landscape on the surface can look quite similar to the valleys of Hualien and Taitung, unlike those two, you will almost never find mountains to the **east** in the plains of Yilan. Furthermore, the flat plains of Yilan are also generally more open.
text_zh: **蘭陽平原**很好認：北、西、南三面都看得到山脈。稻田極為常見，房舍常常就緊鄰田邊而建。
註：雖然地表景觀與花蓮、台東的縱谷頗為相似，但關鍵差別在於蘭陽平原的**東側**幾乎看不到山。此外宜蘭的平原整體也更為開闊。

text: Taoyuan features these **red brick** and sometimes red tile apartment buildings.
NOTE: They can also be commonly spotted in the greater Taipei area and rarely in other urban areas but are most common in Taoyuan.
text_zh: 桃園可見這種**紅磚**、有時是紅色磁磚外牆的公寓。
註：大台北地區也很常見，其他都市區則較少，但仍以桃園最為集中。

text: White-tinged **cream coloured houses** are frequently seen in Penghu.
text_zh: 澎湖常見這種偏白的**米色房屋**。

text: You can find these small, **traditional-looking** houses in Kinmen.
text_zh: 金門可見這種小巧的**傳統式樣**房舍。

text: There is one more tripod in Tanzania, inside [Jane Goodall](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jane_Goodall)’s house. It is also located in Gombe National Park, adjacent to the normal Generation 3 trekker coverage.
text_zh: 坦尚尼亞還有另一個三腳架拍攝點，位於[珍·古德](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jane_Goodall)的故居內。它同樣位於貢貝國家公園內，鄰近一般的第三代徒步拍攝覆蓋。

text: **Gray corrugated metal roofs** are most commonly found in the north and south** **of the country, but can occasionally be found throughout the country.
text_zh: **灰色瓦楞金屬屋頂**最常出現在該國的**北部**和南部，但也偶爾會在全國各地出現。

text: The island of **Phuket **is very touristy and wealthy. You will often see modern buildings, resorts, and heavy traffic among hills.
text_zh: **普吉島**（Phuket）非常觀光且富裕。你經常會在群山之中看到現代化建築、度假村和繁忙的交通。

text: Western Rayong province features a **northeast-southwest grid** filled with modern and industrial buildings among fields of rubber trees, cassava, and pineapple.
text_zh: 羅勇府（Rayong）西部擁有一個**東北-西南走向的網格**，裡面充滿了現代化和工業建築，周圍則是橡膠樹、木薯和鳳梨田。

text: Doors, windows, gates and other architectural elements are sometimes painted with this specific traditional **shade of blue**.
NOTE: This shade of blue can be found all over the country, but is especially common on the island of Djerba, where buildings tend to be older and more traditional.
text_zh: 門、窗戶、大門和其他建築元素有時會漆上這種特定的傳統**藍色**。
注意：這種藍色在全國各地都能見到，但在傑爾巴島特別普遍，那裡的建築通常更古老、更傳統。

text: The island of Djerba can sometimes have a distinct vibe. There tend to be a lot of palm trees. Whitewashed, traditional buildings with blue doors and windows are common.
NOTE: Not all locations on the island will have this distinct vibe. A lack of a follow car is another good way to confirm that you are on Djerba.
text_zh: 傑爾巴島有時會給人一種獨特的氛圍。這裡往往有許多棕櫚樹。塗白、帶有藍色門窗的傳統建築很常見。
注意：島上並非所有地點都有這種獨特的氛圍。沒有跟拍車是確認你身處傑爾巴島的另一種好方法。

text: **Tiled roofs** are mostly found in the western two thirds of the country.
Note that for this and the following roof-related tips to be reliable, the majority of all visible roofs should preferably be of that type.
text_zh: **瓦片屋頂** 主要分佈在該國西部三分之二的地區。
請注意，為了讓這個以及接下來與屋頂相關的提示準確可靠，所有可見屋頂中的大多數最好都屬於該類型。

text: **Flat roofs** are mostly found in the southeast and to a lesser extent along the south coast.
text_zh: **平屋頂** 主要分佈在東南部，南海岸一帶則較少見。

text: **Metal roofs** are most common in the east.
text_zh: **金屬屋頂** 在東部最為常見。

text: Sheet metal roofs shaped like **low pyramids** are mainly found far east, particularly in the general area surrounding Lake Van.
text_zh: 形似 **低矮金字塔** 的鐵皮屋頂主要分佈在極東地區，特別是凡湖周邊的廣大區域。

text: Many buildings in the Nevşehir Province are built by large, light and unevenly coloured, **sandstone bricks**.
text_zh: 內夫謝爾省的許多建築都是用大型、淺色且顏色不均的 **砂岩磚** 所建造。

text: Around the city of Bodrum you will commonly find this type of **whitewashed buildings** with flat roofs, often combined with [blue details](https://goo.gl/maps/jcmMEtAFzgkLEf466) or [unpainted stone walls](https://goo.gl/maps/GvWo5wWdFEorZkaP8).
text_zh: 在博德魯姆市周邊，通常會看到這種帶有平屋頂的 **白牆建築**，常搭配[藍色細節](https://goo.gl/maps/jcmMEtAFzgkLEf466)或[未刷漆的石牆](https://goo.gl/maps/GvWo5wWdFEorZkaP8)。

text: Red street signs with a coloured bottom strip are found in several cities. In the bottom right corner, you can find a white arrow and some numbers. If this arrow is pointing in **both directions** and has a **single arrowhead**, rather than [double](https://goo.gl/maps/Fd5tuzksA3NY8YsF7), then you are almost certainly in Istanbul.

Beware that simple arrows pointing in only one direction can be found in both [Istanbul](https://goo.gl/maps/6uFmLFqcEn2bT7vL9) and in [other cities](https://goo.gl/maps/BBU6aeQ2BoBN38YH8). However, if you see such signs in combination with [red house numbers](https://goo.gl/maps/kjNkwByQZ7rNaQXdA), then you should be in Istanbul.
text_zh: 帶有彩色底條的紅色街道標誌可在多個城市找到。在右下角，你會看到一個白色箭頭和一些數字。如果這個箭頭指向 **雙向** 且只有 **單側箭頭**，而非[雙側箭頭](https://goo.gl/maps/Fd5tuzksA3NY8YsF7)，那麼你幾乎可以確定身處伊斯坦堡。
請注意，只指向單一方向的簡單箭頭既可在[伊斯坦堡](https://goo.gl/maps/6uFmLFqcEn2bT7vL9)找到，也可在[其他城市](https://goo.gl/maps/BBU6aeQ2BoBN38YH8)找到。然而，如果你看到此類標誌搭配[紅色門牌號碼](https://goo.gl/maps/kjNkwByQZ7rNaQXdA)，那你應該就在伊斯坦堡。

text: Street signs in Trabzon and [Yalvaç](https://goo.gl/maps/vZmpbacvJeyzbMWc9) are **red** and **oval-shaped**. [House numbers](https://goo.gl/maps/96X34Wg24K87jPG4A) also feature the same design.
text_zh: 特拉布宗與[亞爾瓦奇](https://goo.gl/maps/vZmpbacvJeyzbMWc9)的街道標誌為 **紅色** 且呈 **橢圓形**。[門牌號碼](https://goo.gl/maps/96X34Wg24K87jPG4A)也採用相同的設計。

text: A **unique blend of architecture** is found on the United States Virgin Islands. The primary influences are European Renaissance, Spanish Baroque, Rococo and Victorian styles. Facades with large arches are common; as well as central plazas and courtyards.
text_zh: 在美屬維京群島上可以發現**獨特的建築融合風格**。主要的影響包括文藝復興、西班牙巴洛克、洛可可和維多利亞風格。帶有大拱門的立面很常見，中央廣場和庭院也是如此。

text: Kampala is a fairly **busy-looking** city, with many signs, narrow **unpaved **roads and typically fairly small, one-storey houses. Like many African countries, houses will often be surrounded by tall walls, commonly with barbed wire on top.
text_zh: 坎帕拉是一座外觀相當 **繁忙** 的城市，有許多招牌、狹窄的 **未鋪裝** 道路，以及通常相當小的一層樓房屋。如同許多非洲國家，房屋周邊經常被高牆環繞，頂端通常帶有鐵絲網。

text: In the **city centre** of Kampala, you will see paved roads with black-and-white curbs. In contrast to the rest of the city, the city centre looks richer and very built-up, with lots of multi-storey buildings.
text_zh: 在坎帕拉的 **市中心**，你會看到帶有黑白相間路緣石的鋪裝道路。與該市其他地區相比，市中心看起來更富裕且開發完善，有許多多層樓建築。

text: The city of Entebbe, southwest of Kampala, can often be recognized by feeling slightly emptier than most of the capital, with more **greenery **and somewhat fancier houses. The area also has significantly more **street signs** than the rest of the capital.
text_zh: 位於坎帕拉西南方的恩德培市，通常可以透過比首都大部分地區略顯空曠、擁有更多 **綠化** 以及稍微高級的房屋來辨識。該地區的 **街道標誌** 也明顯比首都其他地區更多。

text: **Katwe village** is the only significant settlement outside of Kampala with Street View coverage.
NOTE: Much smaller villages, safari lodges and single houses with coverage can be found elsewhere.
text_zh: **卡特韋村（Katwe village）**是坎帕拉以外唯一擁有街景覆蓋的主要聚落。
注意：規模小得多的村莊、野生動物園度假村以及帶有街景覆蓋的單獨房屋則可在其他地方找到。

text: In bigger cities and towns, you will often see big **Soviet-era apartment blocks**. These are often made of light grey brick. They tend to look fairly rundown and poorly maintained. Some are made of [concrete prefab units](https://goo.gl/maps/rEeqXdLgQQ1kjhx39) that are stacked on top of each other.
These apartment buildings are similar to those found in Russian cities. You can also find this style of building in the Baltic countries, but these tend to look better maintained.
text_zh: 在較大的城市和城鎮中，你經常會看到大型的**蘇聯時期公寓大樓**。這些通常由淺灰色磚塊製成。它們往往看起來相當破舊且維護不良。有些是由堆疊在一起的[混凝土預製組件](https://goo.gl/maps/rEeqXdLgQQ1kjhx39)製成。
這些公寓大樓與俄羅斯城市中發現的類似。你也可以在波羅的海國家找到這種風格的建築，但這些通常維護得更好。

text: Single-family homes are very common in **suburbs and small towns**. These neighbourhoods are often heavily vegetated and tend to look rundown. Most roads are unpaved. Buildings are usually made of bricks, often have corrugated roofs, and are invariably surrounded by fences.
text_zh: 獨棟住宅在**郊區和小城鎮**非常普遍。這些社區通常有大量植被，且往往看起來很破舊。大多數道路都是未鋪柏油的。建築物通常由磚塊製成，經常有波紋屋頂，並且無一例外地被柵欄圍繞。

text: This is the **stereotypical rural round** in Ukraine:
- Generally bad road quality.
- A landscape that is usually flat or slightly hilly.
- A line of trees or bushes next to the road, with wide open agricultural fields beyond that.
- A lack of road infrastructure or buildings, until you reach the next urban area.
- Low amount of traffic.
text_zh: 這是烏克蘭**典型的鄉村街景**：
- 通常很差的道路品質。
- 通常平坦或微幅起伏的地形。
- 道路旁有一排樹木或灌木叢，再過去則是開闊的農田。
- 缺乏道路基礎設施或建築物，直到你到達下一個市區。
- 車流量低。

text: In addition, the villages in this region look similar to **Hungarian architecture**. Settlements are fairly linear and organised, with predominantly single-storey houses that are closer to the street. Many roofs have orange tiles or diamond-shaped slate tiles that are similar to roofs found in central European countries like Hungary, Czechia and Slovakia.
text_zh: 此外，該地區的村莊看起來類似**匈牙利建築**。聚落相當線性且有組織，主要是靠近街道的單層房屋。許多屋頂有橘色瓦片或菱形石板瓦，類似於中歐國家（如匈牙利、捷克和斯洛伐克）的屋頂。

text: Google sent a special car trekker to the [Chernobyl Exclusion Zone](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chernobyl_Exclusion_Zone), where the nuclear disaster happened in the 1980s. This car goes from Ivankiv all the way to the **abandoned town** of Pripyat.

On most of the road to Pripyat, you will not really be able to tell that you are inside the Exclusion Zone. However, inside Pripyat you will see completely abandoned and overgrown buildings, giving the place an eerie look.
text_zh: Google 派出一輛特殊的跟拍車前往發生於 1980 年代核災的[車諾比禁區](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chernobyl_Exclusion_Zone)。這輛車從伊萬科夫一路開到**廢棄城鎮**普里皮亞特。
在通往普里皮亞特的絕大多數道路上，你其實不會感覺自己身處禁區內。然而，在普里皮亞特內部，你會看到完全荒廢且雜草叢生的建築物，給這個地方一種詭異的外觀。

text: In almost all Generation 3 coverage, a **white car** with visible black roof racks was used.
NOTE: The UAE is the only Middle Eastern country where a white Google car can be found.
text_zh: 在幾乎所有的 Generation 3 覆蓋中，使用了一輛帶有明顯黑色車頂架的**白車**。
備註：阿拉伯聯合大公國是唯一能找到白色 Google 車的中東國家。

text: Houses in residential areas are typically made of **light-coloured stone**. Reddish stones are often used for sidewalks.
text_zh: 住宅區的房屋通常由**淺色石材**建造。人行道經常使用帶紅色的石頭。

text: **Terraced houses** (row houses) are very common in the UK. This housing type shares walls on both sides with neighbouring homes. You will also see a lot of [semi-detached houses](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Semi-detached), which share just one side wall with another house.

NOTE: [61% of the population](https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/databrowser/view/ILC_LVHO01__custom_4934075/default/table?lang=en) lives in terraced or semi-detached houses, significantly more than most other European countries. The only European countries where terraced houses are this common are Ireland and the Netherlands.
text_zh: **連棟房屋**（排屋）在英國非常常見。這種房屋類型與鄰近房屋共享兩側的牆壁。你也會看到許多[半獨立式房屋](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Semi-detached)（雙拼住宅），它們僅與另一棟房屋共享一側的牆壁。
注意：[61% 的人口](https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/databrowser/view/ILC_LVHO01__custom_4934075/default/table?lang=en)居住在連棟房屋或半獨立式房屋中，比例明顯高於大多數其他歐洲國家。連棟房屋如此普遍的唯一其他歐洲國家是愛爾蘭和荷蘭。

text: **Red brick buildings **are common in many parts of the UK.
NOTE: Red brick architecture is also common in the Netherlands, Belgium, and Denmark, as well as parts of northern France.
text_zh: **紅磚建築**在英國許多地方都很常見。
注意：紅磚建築在荷蘭、比利時和丹麥，以及法國北部部分地區也很常見。

text: **Suburbs** in UK towns tend to have a recognizable look. They typically feature near-identical houses, often semi-detached, usually with [well-manicured lawns](https://goo.gl/maps/Am191RdWfDF927Rt8). The road layout can be maze-like, with lots of cul-de-sacs and curvy roads.
text_zh: 英國城鎮的**郊區**往往有著可辨識的外觀。它們通常具有近乎相同的房屋，通常是半獨立式，通常帶有[修剪整齊的草坪](https://goo.gl/maps/Am191RdWfDF927Rt8)。道路佈局可能像迷宮一樣，有許多死胡同和彎曲的道路。

text: Many British buildings have distinct-looking chimneys with multiple so-called **chimney pots**. These pots are usually round and brick-coloured.
text_zh: 許多英國建築都有外觀獨特的煙囪，帶有多個所謂的**煙囪壺**。這些壺通常是圓形的且呈磚紅色。

text: Some buildings, both old and new, feature [black-and-white](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Black-and-white_Revival_architecture) **timber framing**.
NOTE: This is less common in Ireland.
text_zh: 有些建築（無論新舊）具有[黑白](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Black-and-white_Revival_architecture)**木造骨架**。
注意：這在愛爾蘭較少見。

text: It is common to see houses made of **large blocks of sandstone or granite **in Scotland. [Granite](https://goo.gl/maps/wYZvi7P1M195vc5N9) buildings are common in Aberdeen, [red sandstone](https://goo.gl/maps/k4HthFRKwCX4hQt8A) is common in Glasgow and Dumfries, and [yellow sandstone](https://goo.gl/maps/7TNfGv5GGmDqErA77) is common in Edinburgh.
text_zh: 在蘇格蘭，看到由**大塊砂岩或花崗岩**建造的房屋是很常見的。[花崗岩](https://goo.gl/maps/wYZvi7P1M195vc5N9)建築在亞伯丁很常見，[紅砂岩](https://goo.gl/maps/k4HthFRKwCX4hQt8A)在格拉斯哥和鄧弗里斯很常見，而[黃砂岩](https://goo.gl/maps/7TNfGv5GGmDqErA77)在愛丁堡很常見。

text: A horizontal blue, red, or green sign can commonly be seen at the ends of driveways in Wisconsin and the Michigan peninsula. The house number is present, in addition to either the **town name** and or the **road name** (usually).
NOTE: Nearby states often use [similar markers](https://goo.gl/maps/ETNAA9cvLDbB92Lw9), but typically lack any town or street name information and only feature numbers.
text_zh: 在威斯康辛州和密西根半島的車道盡頭，常可見到水平的藍色、紅色或綠色標誌。除了門牌號碼外，通常還會附上**城鎮名稱**和/或**道路名稱**。
注意：鄰近的州經常使用[類似的標示](https://goo.gl/maps/ETNAA9cvLDbB92Lw9)，但通常缺乏任何城鎮或街道名稱資訊，且僅有數字。

text: The restaurant chain ‘**Waffle House**’ is a regional chain that is primarily found in the Southern and Southeast US. Some Midwest and Mid-Atlantic states have some locations. Georgia, by far, is the state with the most Waffle House locations.
text_zh: 餐廳連鎖店「**Waffle House**」是一家主要分佈在美國南部和東南部的區域性連鎖店。一些中西部和中大西洋地區的州也有部分分店。喬治亞州無疑是擁有最多 Waffle House 分店的州。

text: ‘**Zaxby’s**,’ a fast-food chicken chain, is another restaurant that is most common in the Southeast US. There are several pockets outside the Southeast that have locations, such as Utah and Montana. Like Waffle House, Georgia has the highest number of locations.
text_zh: 「**Zaxby’s**」是一家連鎖炸雞速食店，是另一家在美國東南部最常見的餐廳。在東南部以外也有幾個零星的分店據點，例如猶他州和蒙大拿州。就像 Waffle House 一樣，喬治亞州擁有最高的分店數量。

text: ‘**Buc-ee’s**’ is a small chain of oversized gas stations located primarily in the state of Texas. These stores feature multiple rows of gas pumps, and a very large convenience store building.
NOTE: Some other nearby states have Buc-ee’s locations, but they are quite rare outside of Texas.
text_zh: 「**Buc-ee’s**」是一家大型加油站的小型連鎖店，主要位於德州。這些商店特色是擁有好幾排加油機，以及非常大型的便利商店建築。
注意：其他一些鄰近的州也有 Buc-ee’s 的分店，但在德州以外相當罕見。

text: Many **Uruguayan houses** are made out of concrete, and are somewhat cube-shaped. Walls often have drab colours and tend to look weathered. Flat roofs are relatively common.
NOTE: Architecture in Argentina often looks similar.
text_zh: 許多**烏拉圭房屋**由混凝土製成，且有點呈立方體形狀。牆壁通常顏色沉悶且看起來飽經風霜。平屋頂相對常見。
注意：阿根廷的建築風格通常看起來很相似。

text: **Punta del Este** is a seaside resort town with a recognizable look. It is an affluent and touristic place with a developed downtown that consists of many tall, modern apartment buildings. Its main attraction is its large, sandy beach.

Further away from the downtown area, you will see less highrises, but still a lot of expensive-looking villa neighbourhoods. Here, you will often see distinctive [tall pine trees](https://goo.gl/maps/9cKem7TVVuhbksbE8).
text_zh: **埃斯特角城**是一個具有獨特外貌的海濱度假小鎮。這是一個富裕且具觀光性質的地方，擁有開發完善的市中心，由許多高大的現代公寓大樓組成。它主要的吸引力在於其大型的沙灘。
離市中心較遠的地方，你會看到較少的高樓大廈，但仍然有很多看起來很昂貴的別墅社區。在這裡，你經常會看到獨特的[高大松樹](https://goo.gl/maps/9cKem7TVVuhbksbE8)。

text: The small island of **Isla de Flores** is located off the coast of Montevideo. It has a trekker where you can see abandoned buildings, and usually also the lighthouse.
text_zh: 小島**弗洛雷斯島**（Isla de Flores）位於蒙特維的亞海岸外。這裡有徒步拍攝街景，你可以看到廢棄建築，通常還能看到燈塔。

text: **Addresses on signs** are _extremely _common in Vietnam, in particular on storefronts. These addresses follow a hierarchical sequence that usually goes from specific (house/building) to general (city/province). These can be tremendously helpful to find your exact location.
Usually an address will contain all or some of the following elements, from left to right:
- House and street number
- Ward/commune:
- - Ward (urban areas): **phường**
- - Commune (rural areas): **xã**
- District:
- - Urban district: **quận**
- - Rural district: **huyện**
- - District level town: **thị xã**
- - Municipal/provincial city:** thành phố**
- Province/City
- - Province: **tỉnh**
- - Municipality: **thành phố **(a municipality in Vietnam is a city that is on the same administrative level as a province, such as Ha Noi, or Hải Phòng)

These words are often abbreviated. For example, huyện can be abbreviated as just H., thành phố as just TP., etc. Additionally, sometimes the province itself may be abbreviated, for instance [here](https://maps.app.goo.gl/jrN2XEvhZ31gQmJy5) Thái Bình is abbreviated as TB.
text_zh: 越南的**標誌上的地址**_非常_常見，特別是在店面招牌上。這些地址遵循層級順序，通常從具體（房屋/建築物）到廣泛（城市/省份）。這對於尋找你的確切位置會非常有幫助。
通常地址會包含以下全部或部分元素，由左到右：
- 房屋與街道號碼
- 坊/社：
- - 坊（市區）：**phường**
- - 市轄區：**quận**
- - 鄉級行政區：**huyện**
- - 市社：**thị xã**
- - 省轄市/直轄市：**thành phố**
- 省/市
- - 省：**tỉnh**
- - 直轄市：**thành phố**（越南的直轄市是行政等級與省相同的城市，例如河內或海防）
這些詞彙經常被縮寫。例如，huyện 可以簡寫為 H.，thành phố 簡寫為 TP. 等等。此外，有時候省份本身也可能會被縮寫，例如[這裡](https://maps.app.goo.gl/jrN2XEvhZ31gQmJy5) Thái Bình 被簡寫為 TB。

text: Thin **spires on the roofs** of houses are almost exclusively found in the northern half of the country.
text_zh: 房屋**屋頂上的細尖塔**幾乎只出現在該國的北部地區。

text: Houses in the Red River Delta (the flat, densely populated area around Hanoi) tend to have a **boxy** look, typically tall with **multiple storeys**. These houses often feature gaudy details that borrow heavily from antique Greco-Roman architecture: [pillars](https://maps.app.goo.gl/6ogDGMJHvMutZ46y9), [pediments](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pediment), [classical-looking balconies](https://maps.app.goo.gl/9Z9mSB9wJCce7LXC7), etc.
Note that similar houses are sometimes found in the direct vicinity of Ho Chi Minh City.
text_zh: 紅河三角洲（河內周圍平坦且人口稠密的地區）的房屋通常具有**方正**的外觀，通常樓層**挑高且有多層**。這些房屋經常帶有大量借鏡古代希臘羅馬建築的華麗細節：[柱子](https://maps.app.goo.gl/6ogDGMJHvMutZ46y9)、[山形牆](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pediment)、[古典風格的陽台](https://maps.app.goo.gl/9Z9mSB9wJCce7LXC7)等。
請注意，類似的房屋有時也會在胡志明市的直接鄰近地區找到。

text: Houses in the Mekong Delta also have a boxy, concrete look, but are usually much less tall: they almost always consist of just a single, ground-level storey.
text_zh: 湄公河三角洲的房屋也具有方正的混凝土外觀，但通常矮得多：它們幾乎總是只有單層的地面樓層。

text: **Traditional wooden houses** are common in the northwest. They commonly have one or several of the following features:
- Stilts holding up the house,
- corrugated metal roofs,
- triangular openings on the side of the roofs.
text_zh: **傳統木造房屋**在西北部很常見。它們通常具有以下一項或多項特徵：
- 支撐房屋的高腳柱，
- 波浪狀金屬屋頂（鐵皮屋頂），
- 屋頂側面的三角形開口。

text: The historic town of Hội An, just south of Da Nang, can be recognised by the **old yellow buildings** typically with dark brown doors and details.
text_zh: 峴港以南的歷史小鎮會安可以透過**古老的黃色建築**來辨識，這些建築通常配有深棕色的門和細節。

text: Sa Pa is a resort town deep in the northern mountains overflowing with touristy stores and restaurants with excessive signage, and palace-like grand hotels throughout the town. The architecture is a mixture of an [affluent European style](https://maps.app.goo.gl/fbuKyfSwu2fYfuVb9) and a more typical [southeast Asian style](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YuBdCAmfD2rs74it7).
text_zh: 沙壩是深山中的一個度假小鎮，充滿了遊客向的商店和餐廳、帶有過多招牌，以及鎮上各處如宮殿般的大型飯店。其建築融合了[富裕的歐洲風格](https://maps.app.goo.gl/fbuKyfSwu2fYfuVb9)和更典型的[東南亞風格](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YuBdCAmfD2rs74it7)。
